Title: Data Scientist, Adtech, Revenue
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

Vinted’s Revenue domain is growing — Ads business is on the mission to develop an advertising ecosystem within Vinted and we’re just getting started. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our cross-functional team in Ads to help us make the most of our real estate and evolve toward a high‑performance, privacy‑respectful, in‑house advertising ecosystem over time. Think: an ad of an external partner can generate euros directly but we may well advertise our own Marketplace services or newly launched categories to optimise on net revenue as well as user engagement. If you love shaping greenfield problems, balancing modeling with pragmatic coding, and turning data into decisions that scale, this role is for you.

In this position, you’ll


Drive domain objectives: Own the core Ads optimisation and modelling algorithms to drive revenue and performance.
Lead and innovate: Prototype internal and external ads optimisation and recommendation models, and validate them via experiments and simulations. You’ll be able to bring structure to an early-stage problem space.
Raise the bar on quality: Establish clear metrics for success (delivery health, incremental revenue, ad harm), instrument reliable measurement through experimentation.
Unlock impact with data: Leverage internal behavioural signals to improve impression performance while respecting user well-being. Turn insights into actionable policies that scale across campaigns and surfaces.
Ensure collaboration and alignment: Partner closely with Decision Scientists, Ads Engineering, Ad Operations, Product, and Revenue leadership teams to translate business goals into robust data and model choices. Communicate trade-offs clearly and early.
Coordinate across teams: Work with platform and data teams to access the right datasets, improve data quality, and integrate your prototypes into production systems. Bonus if you can take models to production yourself.
Build the future: Contribute to the long-term vision of a Vinted Ads Network. Start by nailing volume and reliability; then help us go deeper on relevance, efficiency, and ethical optimisation.
Continuously improve: Stay current on optimisation, experimentation, and ads tech best practices — and bring those ideas into our day-to-day.


About You


Have a strong technical background through a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
Have hands-on first experience with developing machine learning algorithms gathered in a product company or in academic research
Well-versed in Python and SQL, BigQuery is an advantage
Have a structured, meticulous way of working when trying out different approaches towards a set goal
Be a conscious team player who understands when their work touches that of other team members and proactively aligns with them
Good at explaining details of machine learning methods to lay audiences
Solid written and spoken English
Advantage: Experience with recommendation, ranking or retrieval based algorithms
Advantage: Experience working in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, or digital advertising
Advantage: Experience with productionising machine learning models in real-time use cases
Advantage: Understanding of user harm/UX impact measurement and safety guardrails in recommender/ads systems.


Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€67.700—€91.500 EUR

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Vacature Quantitative Analyst




Als Quantitative Analyst zorg je ervoor dat wij de juiste in- en verkoop beslissingen nemen voor onze energieproducten om zo onze posities te optimaliseren. Dat betekent dat je een passie hebt voor het werken met complexe gegevens en data. Wil jij duurzame impact maken op financieel gebied? We komen graag met je in contact.




Dit ga je doen

Je komt te werken op de afdeling Trading. Deze afdeling stuurt assets als wind- & zonparken en grootschalige batterijopslag aan, maar maakt ook strategische beslissingen om de aansturing op een zo gunstig mogelijk moment te doen tegen een zo laag mogelijk risico.




Als Quantitative Analyst vertaal jij deze strategie naar geautomatiseerde analyseprogramma’s en handelsalgoritmen. De focus van deze rol ligt sterk op de IT/AI-kant van de markt. Je bent een expert in het bouwen van robuuste, maar ook pragmatische oplossingen die direct kunnen leveren en snel kunnen opschalen. Je formuleert innovatieve handelsstrategieën en modellen, en bouwt en onderhoudt code die helpt bij het leveren van zowel historische als real-time inzichten en tastbare real-time resultaten. Achter jouw werk zit een groot commercieel belang. Elke optimalisatie die je doorvoert heeft direct impact op onze bedrijfsvoering en marktposities.




Je overziet complexe interacties binnen markten en systemen en weet deze te vertalen naar robuuste modellen. Daarbij bewaak je de logica en consistentie van de onderliggende algoritmes. Omdat we hard groeien, breng je daarnaast de nodige ervaring mee op het gebied van software-architectuur met een focus op real-time data. Je denkt actief na over complexe vraagstukken zoals: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat onze systemen robuust en betrouwbaar grote batterijen op seconden basis kunnen aansturen?




Hier ben je goed in

Vanzelfsprekend heb je een kwantitatieve achtergrond en ben je een expert met cijfers. Ook beschik je over geavanceerde programmeer skills en aantoonbare ervaring met gedegen software-architectuur. Je bent een ondernemend en pragmatisch persoon die verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen, juist omdat je begrijpt dat jouw analyses en modellen een direct commercieel doel dienen. Je begrijpt hoe algoritmes zich gedragen in een dynamische en real-time trading omgeving en weet data science en AI te vertalen naar betrouwbare beslissingslogica.




Daarnaast heb je ook:

Een afgeronde HBO of universitaire opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Econometrie, Wiskunde of een vergelijkbare studie gericht op Data Science of Engineering
Affiniteit met Trading producten en uitstekende analytische vaardigheden
Ervaring met programmeren in Python/SQL
Het vermogen om complexe problemen te vereenvoudigen




Het verhaal van Loes

Onze afdeling is vanwege al die uitdagingen en benodigde expertise flink gegroeid. We werken hard én kunnen ook tijdens werk ontiegelijk hard lachen. Mijlpalen vieren we en van fouten leren we samen. Drie keer per week is er een dagstart en eens per twee weken een afdelingsoverleg waarin we elkaar inspireren en kennis uitwisselen. Er is vaak vlot actie en reactie nodig. Wat nu geldt, kan morgen anders zijn, daarom moet je kunnen presteren onder druk en snel beslissingen kunnen nemen. Dat houdt me scherp.




Dit is hoe Puur werkt voor jou:

Een laptop en telefoon
29 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen en 8% vakantiegeld
Nette thuiswerkvergoeding
Dagelijks gezond en vegetarisch lunchen in ons eigen bedrijfsrestaurant
Wekelijks een uur sporten in onze eigen gym met een personal trainer
Vers fruit, fietsplan en korting op je sportabonnement
Regelmatig gezellige feestjes en sportieve uitstapjes
Doorbetaalde uren voor maatschappelijke projecten
Korting op je energierekening
Extra bijdrage voor je ziektekosten




Werken bij Pure Energie

Hoe het is om hier te werken? Dat kunnen onze collega’s het beste vertellen. Werken bij het groenste energiebedrijf van Nederland betekent, naast je bijdrage aan een duurzamer Nederland, een toffe functie in een dynamische omgeving met een gezellige en laagdrempelige cultuur. We vinden het belangrijk dat jij de ruimte voelt en krijgt om jezelf te zijn. Pas dan sta je echt in je kracht. Wil je meer weten over wat we doen op kantoor of in het veld? Lees dan ons verhaal.




We hebben in drie beloftes samengevat hoe Puur werkt:

Jezelf zijn
Samen doen
Verschil maken




Versterk ons team en solliciteer nu!

We groeien hard en hopen dat jij ons komt versterken. Voor nog meer slagkracht. Met meer dan 150 collega's maken we Nederland op eigen wijze elke dag groener. Wil jij duurzame impact make op financieel gebied? We komen graag met je in contact.

Title: Data Scientist - Internal AI
Description:
Job Description:

We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What We Value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

You'll shape the future of AI in finance at CM.com. As our Data Scientist for the Internal AI team, you'll embed intelligence into our financial workflows, apply ESSA principles (Eliminate, Standardize, Simplify, Automate), and pioneer Conversational Finance, elevating how our customers, suppliers, and internal teams interact with financial data.

You will:


Investigate and analyze financial processes to build deep business understanding, then prioritize high-impact automation opportunities with key stakeholders.
Build and deploy machine learning models that integrate with Claude Cowork, N8N, and HALO to transform end-to-end financial workflows.
Work directly with our CFO, Head of Business Finance, and Internal AI Lead (Rogier) to shape solution strategies and deliver production-ready solutions.
Own the full cycle from model development through production deployment, ensuring solutions drive real efficiency gains across finance and beyond.
Use AI tools actively to improve your own work — experiment, automate, and share what works with your team.


Requirements:


3+ years in a Data Science or ML Engineer role, with proven experience deploying models to production.
Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL skills, with experience building agentic workflows across multiple platforms.
Problem-solving mindset with ability to simplify complexity and prioritize ruthlessly in a fast-moving environment.
Genuinely curious about AI. You experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve.


Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What We Offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:


Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.
Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.
Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.
Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.
Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.
Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.
Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving
Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.
Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.


Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist

As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for delivering high-impact value through modelling and data analytics for Samsung Electronics while bringing technical excellence to our projects. You will act as a key driver within the team, translating complex business needs into data science solutions.




Role and responsibilities

Your main responsibility is to work on advanced data science and machine learning initiatives that improve business decision-making, including marketing campaign performance, audience segmentation, marketing mix modelling, and pricing strategy.

You will spend most of your time on hands-on data science while also contributing to the technical roadmap and strategy for Samsung's data science landscape.




In addition, you will:

Develop high-performance data science and machine learning models to drive revenue from marketing campaigns.
Collect and connect data from multiple sources using GCP and Azure according to business requirements and technical possibilities.
Identify key customer segments and support personalized marketing communications through precision targeting.
Contribute to the strategy and roadmap for audience segmentation and personalization across .com/app, CRM, and digital media.
Optimize the performance of .com/app, CRM, and digital media by designing and conducting A/B and multivariate testing and deploying machine learning algorithms.
Support simulation and data visualization projects that generate business insights.
Identify and support new business opportunities using advanced data science methodologies and machine learning.
Mentor Data Scientists and Analytical Engineers by providing technical guidance and peer reviews.




Your team

You will be part of the central Data Marketing team within the Corporate Marketing organization in Schiphol, the Netherlands. The team provides marketing analytics solutions together with consumer, market, and business insights. Within the Advanced Analytics team, you will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and the Data Engineering & BI and AI teams.




Skills and qualifications

The ideal Data Scientist has:

A Master's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Marketing, or an equivalent field.
Strong knowledge of statistical modelling, Machine Learning, and Data Science.
Strong SQL/BigQuery and Python skills for data processing and data mining.
Knowledge of data engineering, APIs, cloud computing (GCP and/or Azure), and Databricks.
Excellent communication, presentation, networking, and organizational skills.
Professional-level English.




Preferred qualifications

Experience with automated ETL processes.
Experience working with Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Platform, Google Marketing Platform, and related marketing technology platforms.




Interested in this opportunity? Please apply and we will be in touch with you shortly.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries.

You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment. You will partner with clients to understand their needs and develop impactful analytics solutions. You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.

Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.

You will be in Amsterdam or Brussels, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.

You’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. Title: Data Scientist (Clinical)
Description:
Do you want to help shape tomorrow’s healthcare with AI? At Pacmed, we combine technology and humanity to keep healthcare accessible and future-proof. We are a growing AI company with solutions already running in multiple hospitals, and we are actively scaling further across the Netherlands.

With our software, we help healthcare professionals make better real-time decisions, use capacity more efficiently, and ensure smooth patient flows, from the emergency department and ICU to the clinic. Our mission is to help hospitals accelerate their care transformation and digitalization goals, so that every patient receives the right care at the right time.

Does this sound exciting? Then we have the perfect role for you! We are looking for a Data Scientist (Clinical) who will strengthen the user-facing and clinical side of our data science work: not only training our models, but making sure that their output is trusted, usable, and demonstrably impactful in hospitals.

As a Data Scientist, you will sit (or stand, if you prefer) right at the point where our models meet clinical practice. You will report to our Head of Engineering & Data Science, and work closely with a group of talented and driven developers, engineers, data scientists, designers and clinical experts in the Product Engineering team. Your focus will be on connecting our models and the underlying data to the people who use them: working with clinicians to understand their workflows and needs, developing and training models, shaping how predictions are presented in the product, and demonstrating clinical impact through retrospective and impact analyses. We're looking for someone with a genuine product mindset, who builds trust with medical experts, takes ownership, and is motivated to keep learning and make our products more usable, interpretable, and valuable in the clinic.

Why Pacmed is a great place to work


We're a dynamic startup committed to improving healthcare in the Netherlands.
We're committed to creating an inclusive environment for our team.
We're a talented bunch dedicated to helping each other grow.
We foster a culture of kindness and respect.
We're a team of ambitious and fun-loving people, with regular team events!



What Would Be Expected Of You


Train machine learning models and shape how their outputs are presented in the product in collaboration with frontend, UX, product, and users.
Design and execute impact and retrospective analyses that demonstrate and improve the clinical value of our products.
Work in a structured way with internal and external medical experts, translating clinical needs into product and modeling decisions, and model behavior into clinical language.
Be the go-to person for the interpretation of clinical data, and help prioritize data science efforts from a clinical point of view.
Contribute to the data science aspects of product discovery, by carrying out your own experiments or supervising interns.
Contribute to tailoring and validating our pipelines and models in new hospital environments.
Use AI tooling wisely and responsibly to assist you in your work.
Participate in validation and verification activities, according to the latest medical and information security regulations.
Be present in the office a couple of days per week. We are flexible, and at the same time we love seeing each other regularly and working together in person.



Requirements


A minimum of 2 years of professional experience working in a clinical environment or with clinical data
Solid data science and machine learning fundamentals in Python (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn)
Strong communication skills with non-technical stakeholders, a genuine product mindset, and curiosity about clinical users and products
Professional working proficiency in Dutch, and fluency in written and spoken English
Eligible to work in the Netherlands (EU). Unfortunately we are not able to sponsor visas at the moment.



At Pacmed, we think there is strength in diversity. Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Pacmed encourages you to reconsider and apply! Building responsible AI requires diverse perspectives, equitable practices, and integrity every step of the way. This is our commitment.

Working at Pacmed

The perks our team loves

🚀 You'll get a stake in Pacmed's success through our Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR) program

💡 Development Day once a month – spend 5% of your work time for personal development!

🎪 Regular social events, with quarterly outings and yearly off-site

👵🏽 Sponsored contribution of an equivalent of 6% of your salary to a private pension fund

👶 Extra paid additional birth leave and maternity leave

🏠 Flexible working arrangements in working hours and working from abroad

…but also:

🏝 25 paid holidays per year based on full time employment

➕ The option to buy 5 extra holidays based on full time employment

🏖️ Possibility to take a 3-months sabbatical once employed with a permanent contract

🥗 Lunch provided daily at the office, with plenty of vegetarian and vegan options

🏋🏽 A ClassPass and OpenUp subscription

🙏🏻 Option to customize public holidays: swap some standard public holidays for alternative days to accommodate personal or religious observances

🖥️ Company laptop, phone allowance and home office equipment provided

Our Tech Stack

Our software is written in Python and Javascript (Typescript), with Azure as our cloud provider. On the data science side, you will work mostly in Python: we process clinical data with Pandas, Polars, and (Py)Spark, and we train and evaluate our models with scikit-learn and related libraries (e.g., scikit-survival, LightGBM). Interpretability and explainability are central to how we build: our predictions only create value when users understand, trust and use them. Around all this sits our product stack — FastAPI, SQL, VueJS, Docker — which you will encounter when your work finds its way into the product. Of course, no single person knows and uses all these tools! So don't worry if you don't know some of them. And if you are curious about any new tool, you will definitely have the chance to pick them up and learn on the job.

At the same time, we are always eager to add beneficial new technologies to our stack. If you want to contribute your expertise with a specific tool that you love, we have a Tech Funnel process to evaluate and possibly adopt anything that might be interesting and beneficial to the team and/or our product.

Growing at Pacmed

At Pacmed we are fully committed to help you grow in the direction that you envision for yourself. Together with your manager, you will craft a development path to guide you in the process. Every quarter you will review your individual growth goals, both with your manager and your team lead, to make sure that you are working on the right things and achieving the goals you have set for yourself.

As a successful Data Scientist, here's an example of what the next 5 years at Pacmed could look like. Of course, this is just a hypothetical path: everyone's professional growth looks different, and every step of the way is highly dependent on a number of factors, including but not limited to one's own performance, but also the needs of the team and the availability of positions.

In the short term (1-3 years) you could grow into a Senior position, in which you will own big(ger) parts of our data science work; design and execute complex analyses and experiments; scope and drive medium- and long-term projects; contribute to the strategic vision of the product and tech team; work closely with team leads and product managers to plan work and resources.

In the longer term (3-5 years), you would decide to follow either the Manager or Individual Contributor track. As a lead/manager, you would start leading teams and managing direct reports, contributing to the company and product strategy, helping to draft goals, manage resources, hiring, etc. As an individual contributor, you would be able to focus on leading the clinical and data science strategy of the team, being responsible for large(r) analytical and product decisions, and for delivering data science work of the highest quality.

Hiring process

Note: we will not ask you to do a take-home coding challenge for this position. We value your time, and we do not believe in asking candidates to do unpaid work.

1️⃣ ✨ Introductory chat


With whom? One of our engineers or data scientists.
How long? 15-30 mins
How? Online (MS Teams)
What? A short call to align on the fundamentals and practicalities: salary expectations (both ways), motivation, and main requirements. You will hear more about Pacmed and you will be asked some questions to check that we can proceed to the next stage.



2️⃣ 🖥️ First Interview


With whom? Two of our colleagues from the Product-Tech Team.
How long? 45 minutes
How? Online (MS Teams) or in our Amsterdam office. This could be combined with step 3. This interview will be held in Dutch.
What? This will be a way to get to know each other and to dive into your product mindset, communication style, and affinity with clinical users and UX. We'll also tell you a bit more about the company, team, way of working, and the product, and you can ask any questions you might have about Pacmed or the position.



3️⃣ ⚜️ Technical Interview


With whom? Some of our data scientists and clinical experts
How long? 1.5-2 hours, split in two sessions.
How? In person at our office, but possible to arrange it online if needed. This could be combined with step 2. (If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands and are therefore unable to make it to the office at this stage, don't worry – it will not influence your chances in any way!)
What? This is where you will be able to shine. We will go in depth on data science fundamentals, interpretability, and analysis design, working together on some fun, realistic problems. We will also work on use cases where your clinical, UX and/or product experience will play a crucial role.



4️⃣ 🤙🏻 Final chat (+ optional lunch at the office)


With whom? Michele (Head of Engineering) and/or Bas (CTO).
How long? 45min
How? In person at our office, but possible to arrange it online if needed. (If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands and are therefore unable to make it to the office at this stage, don't worry – it will not influence your chances in any way!)
What? This will be an informal chat with the CTO and your future manager, to go more in depth about your growth plans, motivation, way of working, and culture fit/add. It will also be a chance for you to ask all the questions you might still have after going through the interviews. In addition, if you are able to come to the office, we would love for you to have lunch with the rest of the team, to get to know them and have a chance to experience what it means to work from the Pacmed office.



We're looking forward to meeting you!

We partner with clients to resolve challenges and capitalize on opportunities. We believe that in today’s world of change and disruption, optimism is a force multiplier.



Job Description

The Amsterdam Data Science team is diverse, dynamic, and rapidly growing. You will collaborate closely within multidisciplinary teams, applying advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions. Our flat structure encourages initiative, entrepreneurial spirit, diversity, well-being, and knowledge sharing so that we grow together.

Responsibilities

As a Data Science Consultant, you will collaborate with our Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Consultants on various client projects in multidisciplinary teams. You will use advanced analytics, machine learning, and GenAI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions.

Responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with colleagues to identify business challenges and extract actionable insights from data.

  • Develop and implement statistical models, optimization solutions, and advanced machine learning techniques.

  • Apply Generative AI and large language models to create innovative solutions.

  • Clearly present analytical results and assist in facilitating client workshops.

Your profile

  • Motivated, analytical, and eager to learn.

  • Thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary environments.

  • Clear communicator, comfortable translating complex technical concepts into actionable recommendations.



Qualifications

  • Completed WO Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, (Energy) Engineering, or a related technical field involving substantial programming.

  • 1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience.

  • Strong coding skills in Python and at least one additional analytical language (e.g., R, SQL).

  • Solid knowledge of Machine Learning techniques, optimization methods, and Generative AI.

  • You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.

  • Previous exposure or interest in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English and Dutch, both written and oral. Additional languages are considered advantageous.

What we offer

  • Training and development opportunities to advance your expertise.

  • A supportive environment with structured mentorship and personalized training opportunities.

  • Opportunities to participate in international projects.

  • Flexible working hours and performance-based promotion.

  • Competitive salary, bonus, and benefits package (lease car, health insurance, pension).



Additional Information

We are unable to provide a work permit for this position



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Data Scientist Customer Services
Description:
Data Scientist (AI & Customer Service)



About the Role

We're expanding AI capabilities in Customer Service and are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about solving complex product problems with data. You will work on AI products, design and evaluate experiments, measure business impact, and help shape how AI improves customer and partner experiences.


What You'll Do


Explore large-scale datasets to uncover actionable insights.
Design, analyse, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments.
Measure the impact of AI products and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Apply statistical methods and causal inference to support product decisions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics to deliver measurable business impact.
Own Data Science projects from problem definition through implementation.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the Data Science community.


What We're Looking For


Master's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong Python skills for data analysis and modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Snowflake and PySpark.
Solid understanding of experimentation, A/B testing, and causal inference.
Experience working on product analytics or AI/ML products.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
POSITION: DATA SCIENTIST




Scope of Work:

The Data Scientist will play a central role in aggregating, analyzing, and presenting project data throughout all phases (from engineering design through construction and assembly) of offshore platforms. Working within an integrated Enterprise Information Management framework, this role focuses on translating complex project data into actionable insights for decision-makers across multiple teams.




Key Responsibilities:




Data Integration & Consolidation: Access and synthesize data from multiple sources including CAE systems (AVEVA E3D, DIAGRAMS), planning tools (Primavera P6), manufacturing/construction/assembly control systems, supply chain management platforms, commissioning tools, and Company enterprise systems (Financial Measurement Consolidator, EDM, RDO System, Punch List Management)
Performance Metrics & KPIs: Design and develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to track key metrics across all project phases:
Planning & Schedule Performance (Primavera P6 integration, task completion rates, critical path analysis)
Procurement Status (material supply, item traceability, inventory levels, supplier performance)
Manufacturing & Construction Progress (daily execution data, quality control metrics, safety compliance, SSOPs adherence)
Commissioning Readiness (commissionable items status, testing progress, compliance reports)
Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) metrics (incident reporting, near-misses, environmental compliance)
Daily Data Processing: Automate extraction and transformation of daily operational data from field-level systems (mobile devices, RDO entries, inspection records) into structured, consolidated formats
Trend Analysis & Predictive Insights: Perform statistical analysis to identify project risks, schedule deviations, quality issues, and resource constraints; provide early-warning indicators for delays or cost overruns
Stakeholder Communication: Present insights to diverse audiences (project managers, site supervisors, procurement, quality assurance, Company representatives) in both technical depth and executive-friendly formats
System Compliance & Audit Support: Ensure data quality, integrity, and traceability across the integrated system; support Company audits and system validation
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance data workflows, reduce manual entry, automate routine reporting, and improve data consistency across all tools




Technical & Domain Requirements:




Data sourcing from Enterprise Information Management tools (Web application platform with read-only Company access)
Correlation and mapping of data across engineering, procurement, construction/assembly, and commissioning domains
Proficiency in extracting data from multiple tool databases and APIs
experience with data warehousing and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) concepts
Ability to translate complex project information into clear, actionable visualizations and reports
Understanding of construction project lifecycle, offshore platform assembly procedures, and quality assurance frameworks

Title: Interim Data Scientist
Description:
Groenlo, Nederland

32 - 38 uur

€ 80 - € 100

Hybrid

Wat ga je doen?

Vertaal RFID-locatiedata uit echte winkels naar bewijs voor een nieuwe retailpropositie.

E-commerceteams kunnen vrijwel iedere stap in de klantreis meten en optimaliseren. In fysieke winkels hebben visual merchandising-teams veel minder objectieve feedback over waar producten worden geplaatst, hoe ze door de winkel bewegen en welke presentaties bijdragen aan commerciële prestaties. Met Money Mapping onderzoeken we of locatiedata uit overhead RFID-systemen dat meetbare en optimaliseerbare perspectief naar de fysieke winkel kan brengen.

Dit is een eenjarige discovery-opdracht volgens een proto-to-scale-model. Het doel is een gevalideerde propositie met een werkend minimum viable product (MVP), niet direct een volledig productieplatform. De huidige x,y-locatiedata is ongeveer 1 tot 5 meter nauwkeurig en wordt iedere 5 tot 15 minuten vernieuwd. Jij bepaalt welke beslissingen dit signaal kan ondersteunen, waar de grenzen liggen en wat nodig is om op te schalen. Technische haalbaarheid is een van de vier dimensies in het formele go/no-go-besluit na twaalf maanden, en jij bent eigenaar van die dimensie.

Je vervangt aannames door bewijs. Een goed onderbouwd "nee" is net zo waardevol als een "ja": succesvol zijn betekent dat beperkingen vroeg zichtbaar worden en dat de taskforce keuzes maakt op basis van wat jij hebt aangetoond.

Start je sollicitatie

Verantwoordelijkheden

Je ontsluit, verwerkt, schoont, verrijkt en modelleert overhead RFID-locatiedata samen met het Labs-team, zodat analyses en prototypes op een betrouwbare basis kunnen worden ontwikkeld.

Je ontwerpt experimenten die nauwkeurigheid, dekking, volledigheid en actualiteit meten en laten zien welke beslissingen op plaatsingsniveau de data kan dragen.

Je bouwt de analytische en ruimtelijke logica achter use cases zoals productbeweging, winkelzones, plaatsingspatronen en veranderingen in winkelindeling.

Je werkt met UX, front-end development en product management om inzichten zichtbaar te maken in toetsbare prototypes op basis van echte winkeldata.

Je brengt risico's vroeg in beeld, legt conclusies helder vast en levert het technische bewijs voor de beslismomenten van de taskforce.

Jouw team

Je werkt in een kleine, multidisciplinaire taskforce van vier tot vijf mensen. Een product manager leidt de taskforce en bewaakt prioriteiten en beslismomenten. Een UI/UX designer onderzoekt het werk en de beslissingen van visual merchandising-teams en een front-end developer maakt concepten interactief. Jij brengt het dataperspectief in en werkt vooral nauw samen met de designer om te bepalen waar gebruikerswaarde en technische haalbaarheid elkaar raken.

Het Labs-team is je belangrijkste technische partner en faciliteert de databasis en architectuur die nodig zijn om het signaal te laten stromen. Business development verbindt de taskforce met een kleine groep internationale retailpartners. Daarnaast blijf je verbonden met collega's binnen data en engineering bij Nedap voor inhoudelijke feedback en kennisdeling. Het werk blijft bewust dicht bij de praktijk: je spreekt visual merchandising-teams, winkelmanagers en winkelmedewerkers en werkt waar nodig met IT- of dataspecialisten bij klanten.

In een gemiddelde week combineer je het bouwen van pipelines en datamodellen met haalbaarheidsanalyses, ruimtelijke en time-series-experimenten en het ontwikkelen van de datakant van prototypes. Je deelt je bevindingen in de wekelijkse taskforce-sessie en neemt doorgaans één tot twee keer per maand deel aan klant- of winkelbezoeken.

Ons aanbod

Wat krijg je er voor terug?

We hebben de ambitie en de mogelijkheid om de toekomst vorm te geven. En we hebben mensen nodig met de drive om dat om te zetten in betekenisvolle impact. Je krijgt de kans om bij te dragen aan iets echt unieks, samen met meer dan 1.000 gelijkgestemde collega's.

Vanaf dag één help je ons ons doel te verwezenlijken: Technology for Life. De manier waarop jij groeit, initiatief neemt en impact maakt, brengt onze purpose tot leven. We shape what's next. Together.


Een afgebakende strategische opdracht. Je werkt naar duidelijke beslismomenten toe en beïnvloedt rechtstreeks of Money Mapping kan doorgroeien tot een schaalbare propositie.
Echt technisch eigenaarschap. Je bepaalt de analytische aanpak en bent eigenaar van het bewijs achter de technische haalbaarheidsbeslissing.
Directe klantcontext. Je werkt met echte winkeldata en retailteams, niet aan een geïsoleerde of theoretische innovatiecase.
Een multidisciplinaire uitdaging. Je bouwt, test en leert samen met product management, UX, front-end development, Labs en business development.
Voorwaarden voor de zzp-opdracht. Dit is een tijdelijke opdracht van circa één jaar, te evalueren na 6 maanden, voor ongeveer 38 uur per week. Het uurtarief is marktconform en wordt afgestemd op de scope, je ervaring en beschikbaarheid.


Alle arbeidsvoorwaarden

Benodigde vaardigheden

Je krijgt energie van een vraagstuk waarvan het antwoord nog niet vaststaat. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen rommelige brondata, zorgvuldige analyse en een prototype waarop een klant daadwerkelijk kan reageren. Je neemt brede verantwoordelijkheid, toetst aannames met bewijs en maakt technische onzekerheid begrijpelijk zonder je erachter te verschuilen.

Ervaring met geospatial-, locatie- of time-series-analytics, RFID of andere sensordata, datavisualisatie, machine learning, statistische modellering of productontwikkeling in een startup-, scale-up- of innovatieomgeving is een pre.


Je hebt hands-on ervaring met het bouwen van pipelines en datamodellen en met grote, weerbarstige datasets, zoals sensor-, streaming- of Internet of Things-data.
Je kunt reproduceerbare analyses en haalbaarheidsexperimenten ontwerpen waarmee datakwaliteit en signaalbeperkingen meetbaar worden.
Je bouwt graag analytische prototypes om snel te leren en beperkt je niet tot het ontwikkelen van productierijpe systemen.
Je kunt binnen een klein team richting bepalen, omgaan met onzekerheid en rechtstreeks werken met klantdata en de operationele context in winkels.
Je communiceert effectief met UX, product management, engineeringcollega's en klanten en vertaalt technische bevindingen naar productkeuzes.


Neem contact op!

Nieuwsgierig geworden? Ga de uitdaging aan! Stuur je CV en/of motivatie via de sollicitatiebutton naar Hjalmar Wewerinke-van Marle. En als je nog meer wilt weten of vragen hebt, neem dan vooral nog even contact met ons op via hjalmar.wewerinkevanmarle@nedap.com.

Over Nedap

Nedap is een wereldleider in Digital Twin Technology en verbindt de fysieke en digitale wereld in Retail, Healthcare, Livestock en Security. Gedreven door onze filosofie Technology for Life ontwikkelen we slimme en duurzame oplossingen die mensen en organisaties helpen te floreren in een snel veranderende wereld. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s geven we samen vorm aan de toekomst met betekenisvolle innovaties.

Title: Data & AI Specialist
Description:
Data & AI Specialist




We bouwen met Just Good People een nextgen data & AI team met leuke mensen met sterke data, AI, human & biz skills. Geen PPT-consultancy, maar datakansen kraken en echt waarde realiseren bij toffe klanten. En veel opleiding.




Zie jij in data en AI vooral kansen om organisaties slimmer te maken? Wil je die kansen liever omzetten in echte impact dan in rapporten die in een la verdwijnen?




Wil je maximaal leren door in korte tijd bij meerdere bedrijven in de keuken te kijken? Terwijl wij je helpen ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van data, AI, business en people?




Dan hebben we de uitdaging voor jou.




🟡 Just Good People

Bij JGP hebben we twee simpele regels: We nemen goede mensen aan. En we zorgen goed voor deze mensen. Dat betekent dat we samen optrekken om jou maximaal in je kracht te krijgen op een manier die bij jou past.




🌱 Unieke data & AI filosofie

"As machines get better at being machines, humans have to get better at being more human."

Deze nieuwe tijd vraagt om een nieuw soort data & AI professional. Bij Just Good People Data helpen we bedrijven versnellen met top notch professionals met goed ontwikkelde data, AI, business én human skills. En trainen je naar nog hoger niveau. Met aandacht voor:




Volgende levels in Data & AI
"Waarde denken" voor klanten en gebruikers
Stakeholder management
Communiceren & inspireren




⚡ Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt aan projecten bij mooie bedrijven zoals Bol.com, Defensie, Action, Rabo, NS, AMC, ASML en Essent.




Denk aan:




Maken van impact met data & AI

Title: Data Scientist Climate & Air Quality
Description:
About This Position

Climate change, air quality, and the energy transition play a huge role in defining, implementing, and monitoring policy. To properly design and implement policies, it is crucial to understand emissions and concentrations of gases and substances, at both regional and national level and ideally in real-time. At the Environmental Modelling, Sensing & Analysis (EMSA) department, we use measurement equipment and sensor networks to monitor the concentrations of various gases and particles in the air. As a Data Scientist, you support the researchers within EMSA by managing, processing, and analyzing measurement data. You ensure that data is accurate, accessible, and available for both internal and external use.

What will be your role?

Researchers at EMSA measure and monitor concentrations of different gases and particles in the air in various locations and regions across the Netherlands. We do this using fixed and mobile measurement systems and state-of-the-art equipment. Examples include nitrogen compounds, greenhouse gases, and particulate matter characterisation. The data are centrally collected and stored following FAIR principles. These data serve as input for calculations related to models, emission factors, and policy.

Your mission is to help professionalize our data landscape and enable our scientists to work in an increasingly data-driven way. In addition, we are looking for someone who can, over time, help maintain, improve, and expand our existing IT systems.

Your responsibilities include


Making data from the cloud available to analysts.
Supporting analysts in the analysis, visualization, and interpretation of data.
Maintaining and extending data acquisition software to read and control measurement instruments.


What we expect from you

You have a broad interest in the field of Data Science and/or Software Engineering, stay up to date with new developments, and are not afraid to dive deep into technologies to build expertise. You feel at home in a research environment, enjoy collaborating with experts and researchers, and are motivated to use your knowledge to contribute to societal impact.

As collaboration with colleagues and researchers is an important part of this role, we expect you to be present at our Utrecht and/or Petten locations on average 2 to 3 days per week.


You hold at least a bachelor's degree (HBO level), for example in Data Science, Software Engineering, Computer Science, ICT, or a related field.
You have experience with Python and Git, and are familiar with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You also have experience with SQL and working with databases.
You enjoy collaborating with researchers and subject matter experts and take the initiative to proactively support them in their work.
You have a strong interest in developments in Generative AI and can identify opportunities to apply these technologies responsibly in your work.
Knowledge of one or more of the following is considered an advantage ASP.NET, C#, FORTRAN, MQTT, networking, and serial communications. Experience with cloud solutions is also a plus; we work with Microsoft Azure.
Affinity with climate, air quality, environmental sciences, atmospheric measurements, and/or analytical laboratories is highly desirable.
You possess strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Proficiency in Dutch is considered an advantage.


What you'll get in return

Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 3.500,- and € 6.150,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself.

TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect


An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field.
The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs.
33 days annual leave on a full-time basis plus a flexible holiday (prorated) that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing.
An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various employee networks that foster connection and give advice.
We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel.
Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly.
Flexible working hours, the possibility to work parttime (32 or 36 hours) and the possibility of working from home.
Extensive relocation package for international candidates.
A good pension scheme.


Benefits

Read more about tailoring your benefits package.

TNO as an employer

Our people are at the heart of TNO. Their curiosity, expertise and entrepreneurial mindset make it possible to deliver high-impact research and innovations that contribute to society’s sustainable wellbeing and prosperity. That is why we invest in an inspiring and inclusive working environment where colleagues can excel, have autonomy and continue to grow.

Your talent and ambition have every opportunity to flourish at TNO. You work with experts (both within and beyond TNO), have access to advanced technology and the freedom to explore, experiment and innovate. Our strength lies in independence, reliability and collaboration. We find each other in wonder and ingenuity. We are driven to push boundaries. By working with businesses and government, and by connecting different perspectives, we strengthen our innovative capability and create responsible, meaningful results.

At TNO, we believe this is our time to help society, government and business move forward faster. Together with driven colleagues, you turn knowledge into concrete innovations or ventures that truly make a difference by combining the power of science and entrepreneurship. And in doing so, you make your mark on our time.

The selection process

Please apply before Sunday August 23, 2026. The selection process comprises two interview rounds. The preliminary interview round will take place on Wednesday September 2nd, 2026 and Thursday September 3rd, 2026 and will take place at our Petten office. The second interview round has been scheduled for Thursday September 10th, 2026 and will also take place at our Petten office. In a final meeting we will discuss the terms of employment and your tailored benefits package. We aim to finalize the entire process within four weeks.

The selection process may include an online assessment and a reference check.

A certificate of Conduct (VOG) is required before starting a new job at TNO.

Title: Applied Data Scientist - Intelligent Document Processing
Description:
In het kort

Heb jij een Data Science-achtergrond, maar haal je minstens zoveel energie uit het begrijpen van een probleem als uit het schrijven van code? Wil jij echte impact maken en begrijp je dat een AI-systeem groter is dan alleen een model? Spreek jij de taal van zowel business stakeholders als IT? Lees dan verder!

Binnen het Doc2Data-programma werk je samen met business stakeholders om document-intensieve hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller, en betrouwbaarder te maken voor onze klanten en medewerkers. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen die documenten classificeren en informatie extraheren om beschikbaar te maken voor onze processen. Hiervoor gebruik je bestaande componenten, maar denk je ook mee over lange termijn behoeftes en het verbeteren van het raamwerk.

Ben jij inhoudelijk sterk én comfortabel in een complex stakeholderveld? Dan is het AI team van Home Financing de plek voor jou!

Je werk

Als Data Scientist binnen het Doc2Data-programma draag je bij aan het verbeteren en opschalen van Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) binnen hypotheekprocessen. Je werkt aan toepassingen voor documentclassificatie, data-extractie, handmatige validatie en monitoring. Binnen het Doc2Data programma bouw je doorgaans geen complexe machine-learningmodellen vanaf nul. De uitdaging zit vooral in het begrijpen van documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes, en in het vertalen daarvan naar werkende AI-oplossingen met aantoonbare impact.

In deze rol ben je van begin tot eind betrokken:


Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete IDP-oplossingen die hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder maken.
Je verdiept je in documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes en bepaalt welke informatie herkend, geëxtraheerd of gevalideerd moet worden.
Je ontwerpt oplossingen met bestaande AI-componenten en stuurt daarbij op impact en praktische toepasbaarheid, niet op modelcomplexiteit.
Je definieert en verbetert trainingsdata, beoordeelt extractiekwaliteit en helpt oplossingen stap voor stap beter te maken.
Je onderbouwt keuzes met analyses, experimenten en prototypes en vertaalt inzichten naar een vorm die past bij de ontvanger, zoals een advies aan een proceseigenaar of een user story voor een IT-implementatieteam.
Je werkt nauw samen met IT-teams, proceseigenaren, business analisten en domeinexperts in een complex stakeholderveld.
Je denkt actief mee over implementatie, monitoring, beheer en doorontwikkeling, zodat AI-oplossingen robuust onderdeel worden van end-to-end processen.



Werkomgeving

Het Center of Expertise Advanced Analytics & AI is onderdeel van de afdeling CDTO (Data & Technology) binnen Home Financing van ABN AMRO. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor data science- en complexe analytics-initiatieven binnen Home Financing.

Je komt terecht in een team met een mix van startende en ervaren Data Scientists. Wij vinden het binnen het team belangrijk om kennis te delen, van elkaar te leren en het gezellig te hebben met elkaar. Dit zal je in de praktijk continu ervaren!

In je dagelijkse werkzaamheden voor het Doc2Data programma werk je intensief samen met collega’s van onder andere IT, businessteams en Operational Excellence (OPEX), die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het initiëren en realiseren van procesverbeteringen. Binnen deze multidisciplinaire samenwerking worden data‑ en AI‑oplossingen ontwikkeld die direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van processen en klantbediening.

Je profiel


Je bent een hands-on Data Scientist die energie krijgt van analyseren, verbeteren en samenwerken.
Je vindt het leuk om toegewijd op een inhoudelijk domein te werken en daarin echt meters te maken.
Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en voelt eigenaarschap voor de kwaliteit en impact van je oplossingen.
Een academisch werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur een kwantitatieve opleiding).
3-6 jaar professionele werkervaring in Advanced Analytics / Data Science / Machine Learning.
Kennis van Python en SQL.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Affiniteit met het werken in een omgeving waar je nauw samenwerkt met business stakeholders en engineers.



Wij bieden

De uitdaging om het beste uit jezelf te halen! Je hebt de mogelijkheid om flexibel te werken, krijgt direct verantwoordelijkheid en wij geven je de ruimte om te groeien in een leuk, enthousiast en ambitieus team. Wij garanderen je dat dit een team is waar je veel van kan leren!

Daarnaast bieden wij:


Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36‑urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget. De vacature staat uit in Schaal 9, maar inschaling in Schaal 10 is mogelijk op basis van skills en ervaring.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar, dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privé gebruik.



 

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze CAO die van toepassing is op deze vacature.

Interesse?

Ben je geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan nu online op deze vacature. Voor meer informatie kan je altijd contact opnemen met Tim Claessens (Data Scientist CoE AA&AI Home Financing) op +31 6 39582244 of tim.claessens@nl.abnamro.com. We maken graag kennis met je.

Proficiency Of The Dutch Language Is Required.

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. In je dagelijkse werkzaamheden voor het Doc2Data programma werk je intensief samen met collega’s van onder andere IT, businessteams en Operational Excellence (OPEX), die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het initiëren en realiseren van procesverbeteringen. Binnen deze multidisciplinaire samenwerking worden data‑ en AI‑oplossingen ontwikkeld die direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van processen en klantbediening.

Je profiel

  • Je bent een hands-on Data Scientist die energie krijgt van analyseren, verbeteren en samenwerken.
  • Je vindt het leuk om toegewijd op een inhoudelijk domein te werken en daarin echt meters te maken.
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en voelt eigenaarschap voor de kwaliteit en impact van je oplossingen.
  • Een academisch werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur een kwantitatieve opleiding).
  • 3-6 jaar professionele werkervaring in Advanced Analytics / Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Kennis van Python en SQL.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Affiniteit met het werken in een omgeving waar je nauw samenwerkt met business stakeholders en engineers.


Wij bieden

De uitdaging om het beste uit jezelf te halen! Je hebt de mogelijkheid om flexibel te werken, krijgt direct verantwoordelijkheid en wij geven je de ruimte om te groeien in een leuk, enthousiast en ambitieus team. Wij garanderen je dat dit een team is waar je veel van kan leren!

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36‑urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget. De vacature staat uit in Schaal 9, maar inschaling in Schaal 10 is mogelijk op basis van skills en ervaring.

Title: Data Science Consultant
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group born digital, augmented by data, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We partner with clients to resolve challenges and capitalize on opportunities. We believe that in today’s world of change and disruption, optimism is a force multiplier.





Job Description



The Amsterdam Data Science team is diverse, dynamic, and rapidly growing. You will collaborate closely within multidisciplinary teams, applying advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions. Our flat structure encourages initiative, entrepreneurial spirit, diversity, well-being, and knowledge sharing so that we grow together.



Responsibilities



As a Data Science Consultant, you will collaborate with our Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Consultants on various client projects in multidisciplinary teams. You will use advanced analytics, machine learning, and GenAI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver impactful solutions.



Responsibilities include:



Collaborate with colleagues to identify business challenges and extract actionable insights from data.



Develop and implement statistical models, optimization solutions, and advanced machine learning techniques.



Apply Generative AI and large language models to create innovative solutions.



Clearly present analytical results and assist in facilitating client workshops.



Your profile



Motivated, analytical, and eager to learn.



Thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary environments.



Clear communicator, comfortable translating complex technical concepts into actionable recommendations.





Qualifications



Completed WO Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, (Energy) Engineering, or a related technical field involving substantial programming.



1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience.



Strong coding skills in Python and at least one additional analytical language (e.g., R, SQL).



You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.



Solid knowledge of Machine Learning techniques, optimization methods, and Generative AI.



Previous exposure or interest in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.



Fluent in English and Dutch, both written and oral. Additional languages are considered advantageous.



What we offer



Training and development opportunities to advance your expertise.



A supportive environment with structured mentorship and personalized training opportunities.



Opportunities to participate in international projects.



Flexible working hours and performance-based promotion.



Competitive salary, bonus, and benefits package (health insurance, pension).





Additional Information



We are unable to provide a work permit for this position.



Non-Dutch speakers will unfortunately not be accepted.

Wij geloven dat data science de toekomst heeft. Een vakgebied dat technologie en domeinkennis combineert; wat leidt tot mooie resultaten en soms nog indrukwekkendere mislukkingen. Wil je blijven groeien in dit domein en ben je net zo gepassioneerd over data science als wij (e.g. overenthousiast uitleggen hoe Bayesian Probability werkt op een festival?); dan zoeken we jou als Data Scientist bij Kramp in Varsseveld!

Wat ga je doen?


Dataproducten bouwen met behulp van Cloud Build en Docker.
Pipelines ontwikkelen die gebruikmaken van duizenden CPU's met Kubeflow.
Specialiseren in een van de volgende domeinen: Recommenders, Search of Operations/Supply Chain.
Business Problems vertalen naar Data Science oplossingen.
Minimaal 2 dagen per week fysiek werken vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Varsseveld, met de overige dagen (optioneel) remote.


Waarom bij ons werken?


Innovatieve omgeving: We gebruiken de nieuwste technologieën && AI-tools, en valideren alles door middel van AB testen / experimentation.
Empowerment: Wij geloven in zelfregie over je groei && toekomst, uiteraard met de juiste begeleiding.
Werk-privébalans: We geven prioriteit aan een goede werk-privébalans en bieden flexibele werkregelingen.


Wie ben jij?


Een afgeronde masteropleiding, bij voorkeur in Data Science of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse && Engelse taal.
Sterke vaardigheden in SQL en Python.
Ervaring met werken in CI/CD-omgevingen & Git is een pre.
Ervaring met Google Cloud, LightGBM en Kubeflow is een pre.
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden.
Medior ervaring heeft de voorkeur; we moedigen echter ook uitstekende junior kandidaten aan om te solliciteren.

Je Krijgt Een Plek Waar Jouw Invloed Echt Zichtbaar Is, Bij Een Financieel Gezond, Ambitieus En Succesvol Familiebedrijf. Een Prachtige Rol Met Veel Ruimte Om Data Scientist Verder Te Ontwikkelen. Daar Horen De Volgende Arbeidsvoorwaarden Bij


een goed salaris met winstdeling
een prima pensioenregeling
25 vakantiedagen + 12 ATV-dagen (die je ook kunt laten uitbetalen)
reiskostenvergoeding
volop ruimte voor opleiding en professionele ontwikkeling
korting op het hele Kramp-assortiment.


Wil je bij ons komen werken?

Word jij enthousiast van bovenstaande beschrijving en herken je jezelf hierin, dan willen we graag kennis met je maken! Gebruik de sollicitatiebutton en upload je cv.

Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig; in plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag een bondig antwoord op de volgende vraag: op welk afgerond Data Science project ben je het meest trots, en waarom?

Title: Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant – Strategy & Consulting
Description:
The work

If you’re looking for an exciting career working in a vibrant environment where you will be supported by a global network of experts, this could be the role for you!

As a Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant, you will be in our AI & Data team, which is part of the Strategy & Consulting practice. You will work directly with our clients in the Netherlands and sometimes also abroad to advise them on their data challenges. Your work can vary from advice on the big data platform and architecture they (need to) work on, to building scalable AI solutions by making use of state-of-the art technologies. As part of your day to day activities, you will be working with the largest big data vendors in the world and the top clients in the Netherlands and abroad.

People:



Partner with clients to identify the most suitable data solutions and understand their specific needs to define solution architecture designs.

Build long-term relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment of objectives.

Collaborate closely with clients to define solution architecture designs that meet their business requirements.



Processes:



Analyze large, complex datasets and prepare them for various data science use cases, ensuring data quality and relevance.

Develop scalable data pipelines and machine learning solutions, optimizing data flow, and ensuring efficient processing.

Drive the productionization of machine learning models in cloud environments, following established best practices.

Build GenAI-powered applications or intelligent AI agents that support decision-making or automate processes.



Technology and Data:



Design and build scalable data pipelines and machine learning solutions using appropriate technologies and frameworks.

Apply a diverse array of machine learning techniques to extract insights and deliver value from data.

Develop production-ready code for machine learning models and ensure successful deployment and management in cloud platforms.



With all our roles, there is in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

Who We Are

In today’s world, business leaders want to reinvent rapidly and confidently to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Strategy & Consulting comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialized skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.

Accenture Applied Intelligence is driving these exciting changes across 40 industries and in more than 120 countries, covering skills that range from strategy development to data science professionalization. Our advice is based on best practice and situational analysis and enables our clients to act with speed and confidence. Whether we are investigating complex issues or identifying new opportunities, our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impact.

Strategy & Consulting is one of five services that make up one Accenture – the others are Operations, Technology, Song and Industry X.

Here’s What You’ll Need



Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering or Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Information Management) with a specific emphasis on data.

3+ years of professional experience in creating and maintaining data pipeline architectures, identify data related process improvements and build tools that enable data science activities.

You know your way around relevant programming languages (SQL, Python, R, etc.), Machine Learning techniques (Neural Networks, Random Forest, etc.), Cloud computing (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, Tenserflow, etc.).

Familiar with Git, DevOps principles, command line, Spark, Docker and API frameworks

You have proven affinity with data.

You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

You have good communication skills.

You can translate business requirements into data solutions.

You have excellent stakeholder management skills.



Practical information

To consider your application, please submit your CV along with a motivation letter. You can upload all of these documents under the CV section.

What’s in it for you?

Accenture is a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:



Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust.

Embrace a sustainable growth mindset.

Live a human-led culture of Inclusion & Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.

Lead and transform our clients with technology.

Connect with our global network of 700.000 colleagues.



These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:



Flexible working hours (4x9) & work location

Paid leave: Parental leave, Partner leave for all non-birthing parents, Bereavement leave, and Gender affirmation leave.

Paid transport (budget for electric bicycle or car, NS-Business card)

Pension scheme, Accenture shares, annual bonus, collective health insurance scheme

Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties



What We Believe

Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

Als Data Scientist werk je aan diverse use cases binnen de luchtvaart, zoals operationele optimalisatie, voorspellende analyses en procesverbeteringen. Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders, data engineers en IT-teams om waardevolle en schaalbare oplossingen te realiseren.

Je bent een hands-on data scientist met een sterk analytisch vermogen en een pragmatische instelling. Je weet business en technologie met elkaar te verbinden en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving.
