Vi letar efter dig som är analytisk och problemlösningsorienterad. Du är en lagspelare som både kan driva egna initiativ och samarbeta med kollegor från olika delar av organisationen. Som person är du kommunikativ och duktig på att göra komplexa koncept begripliga för en bredare publik. Du trivs i en roll där du kan inspirera andra, både genom att stötta juniora kollegor och genom att bidra till företagets långsiktiga strategi. Vi söker någon som har en stark vilja att äga sina projekt och som ser värdet i att driva förändring genom teknik.

Kvalifikationer

Din akademiska bakgrund inkluderar en master eller civilingenjörsexamen inom Data Science, Matematisk Statistik, Datavetenskap eller ett närliggande område. Alternativt Master i Finans med kompletterande studier inom matematik och datateknik.

Tekniska Färdigheter

  • Erfarenhet av Python, R, eller andra programmeringsspråk som används inom data science.
  • Kunskaper i ramverk och bibliotek som TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn eller liknande.
  • Förståelse för databashantering (SQL, NoSQL) och molnteknologier (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med verktyg för datavisualisering som Tableau, Power BI eller Matplotlib.
  • LLM Integration (via API) och Prompt Engineering.

Önskvärda Kompetenser

  • Erfarenhet av att implementera NLP, bildigenkänning eller andra specifika AI-teknologier.
  • Kunskap om MLOps och DevOps-principer för maskininlärning.
  • Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska koncept till icke-tekniska intressenter.
  • Intresse av finans.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka företagets tekniska riktning och vara en del av ett innovativt och framåtblickande team. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till vidareutbildning, deltagande i konferenser inom AI och maskininlärning, samt flexibla arbetsförhållanden och konkurrenskraftiga förmåner.

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan omgående då vi går igenom urvalet löpande.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
Description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.

Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.

With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.

About The Role 

In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing



Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.



What You’ll Bring To The Role



Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.



Bonus points if you have



Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.



What is in it for you?



Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.



At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Would you like to play a key part in Toca Boca’s Data & Research engine? With over 60 million monthly active users and terabytes of daily data, as a Senior Data Scientist, you will play an integral role in understanding how kids and families engage with our play ecosystem, directly shaping fantastic, safe, and imaginative play experiences.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into narrow corporate silos or endless maintenance tasks. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will enjoy broad end-to-end ownership across the entire product lifecycle—from exploratory data science, advanced modeling, and experimentation to product strategy and monetization dynamics.

You’ll join our Data & Analytics team while partnering seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner. Together, we blend big data behavioral telemetry with qualitative player research, working closely with cross-functional game teams to unlock the full value of our play ecosystem.

What You’ll Be Doing


Uncover Deep Player Insights: Analyze complex player datasets to understand behavioral patterns, feature engagement, and retention drivers across our games, informing overall product and commerce strategy.
Apply Advanced Statistical Methods: Apply statistical models, regression analysis, predictive segmentation, and experimental methods (A/B testing) to optimize product performance at scale.
Bridge Quantitative & Qualitative Insights: Partner seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner, connecting the "what" (big data trends) with the "why" (qualitative research) to deliver a 360-degree understanding of our players.
End-to-End Ownership & Influence: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous game product questions. Partner directly with PMs, Designers, and Engineers to translate complex datasets into clear, data-backed recommendations.
Innovate & Evolve Workflows: Continuously refine our analytics capabilities by leveraging modern data science workflows, predictive modeling, and AI tools to accelerate discovery and analysis.


What Success Looks Like


Trusted Co-pilot: You become a trusted analytical partner to game teams, shaping product decisions through rigorous data science, experimentation, and player empathy.
Broad Impact: You thrive with the freedom to influence multiple product areas—from core play loops and feature design to commerce and top-of-funnel engagement—without being pigeonholed.
Holistic Insights: You successfully bridge quantitative behavioral data with qualitative user research to create unified narratives that inspire game design.
Autonomy & Momentum: You help teams move quickly by surfacing key facts, reducing ambiguity, and solving open-ended problems that don't have predefined playbooks.


,

Is This You?


3+ years of experience (or equivalent senior-level impact) in user-focused Data Science or Advanced Product Analytics within Gaming, Mobile Apps, or Interactive Digital Products.
Empathy & Product Sense: Deep curiosity and intuition for player experience, engagement, and kids' digital environments.
SQL Mastery & Data Exploration: Outstanding SQL skills querying cloud data warehouses (experience with Google BigQuery and DBT is a huge plus).
Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.


This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Lylli and Originator, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Are you our new Lead Data Scientist?




As a market-leading credit management company, Intrum has broad competence in debt collection services and we do business in 20 countries in Europe. We have more than 10,000 experienced employees in our group.




Our business is about helping others. Helping indebted individuals to get out of difficult situations. Helping businesses get paid so they can grow, hire and prosper. Which in turn is positive for the entire economy. You become an essential part of this circle with us, which gives your job at Intrum a deeper meaning. Regardless of your role or title.

Being at the forefront is everyone's job. As the market leader, it is up to us to be at the forefront. Shaping the industry. Setting new standards. And wherever in the world your Intrum career path takes you, whatever role you play, you will contribute to growth, innovation and impact that makes a real difference.

To have the opportunity to grow. In our organization there are many opportunities to advance, specialize and rotate. Or even try your wings abroad. It's up to you to make it happen. The fact that our business is about helping others – individuals and companies, means that your work also develops on a more personal level. Simply put, you will grow by making a difference.

The role




We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist who is skilled at applying financial analysis, statistics and machine learning to meaningful business challenges. Your work may include predicting payment behaviour, grouping customers based on their needs and behaviour, estimating future recoveries and supporting the evaluation of debt portfolios. You will work closely with colleagues from business, operations, finance, technology, risk and compliance. and turning complex analysis into recommendations that people can understand and use.




The role will report to Head of Data, AI, & Automation

Location for this position is Stockholm (Sickla)

Hybrid work. We see that hybrid work, where we as employees can work either from home or from the office, creates opportunities to perform and work effectively in virtual and real environments.




Responsibilities of role

Develop models that predict customer behaviour and financial outcomes.
Create customer and case segments that support more relevant treatment strategies.
Analyse payment patterns, recovery trends and portfolio performance.
Build forecasts that support planning and investment decisions.
Identify opportunities to improve recovery, customer experience and operational efficiency.
Translate business questions into clear analytical approaches.
Test different modelling methods and recommend practical solutions.
Work with data and technology teams to put models into use.
Monitor model performance and improve models over time.
Explain findings, assumptions and limitations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Document your work and contribute to responsible use of data and AI.




Your Background




You have a university degree, or equivalent experience, in a quantitative field such as finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, data science, engineering or computer science.




We believe you also have:

Experience working as a data scientist, quantitative analyst, financial analyst or in a similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience developing statistical or machine-learning models.
Good working knowledge of Python and SQL, or similar tools.
Experience analysing financial, customer or behavioural data.
The ability to connect analytical results to business decisions.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
An understanding of how models should be tested, documented and monitored.
Experience from credit, banking, payments, insurance, debt collection or portfolio analysis is valuable, but it is not essential.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, Databricks, Azure or model deployment is also an advantage.




Who are you

We at Intrum want to contribute to an inclusive and diverse working life. We accept our differences and know that this is a strength. We know that we are all a resource for society, regardless of age, functional ability, gender, religion, ethnicity or sexual orientation. Therefore, we encourage everyone to apply for a job with us. Come as you are.

You act according to our values. Our values are not words. They are everything.

Behind our global expansion and major digital transformation are four simple but powerful values. Ethics. Devotion. Solutions. Empathy. It is the value that drive our everyday life, regardless of how big we become. Others may think they are small things. But for us, they are everything.




Are you curious or have questions?

You are welcome to contact the recruitment manager for more information: Misbah Uddin.

Only applications received through our online system will be considered.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and help shape the future of data and AI at Bokadirekt.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, and AI across the company. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and AI, ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and ready to support everything from reporting and experimentation to LLM-powered features and machine learning pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to create high-quality data products and enable data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on both our technical platform and how data and AI are used to create value for millions of users every month.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and optimise scalable ELT pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the company
Build a reliable, trusted and well-documented source of truth for company KPIs
Work on the integration of AI capabilities into our data infrastructure
Collaborate on the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and AI-powered features
Identify and carry out data platform cost optimization initiatives


Who you are


Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics or related field
Proven experience (4-6 years) as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
Solid data engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI experience
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Gemini Agent Platform, Looker), Airflow, dbt and Cube is a plus. Bonus points for prompt engineering, LLM APIs, NL querying and RAG
Professional fluency in English


What We Offer


The opportunity to build and scale the data platform behind one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The chance to work with modern data and AI technologies, helping shape the foundations for analytics, machine learning, and LLM-powered solutions
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application deadline: August 14

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.

Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

Are you passionate about advancing the data science craft and leading work that drives measurable business impact across teams?

Join Mentimeter as a Senior Data Scientist, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping how data science supports our Enterprise go-to-market motions and helps Mentimeter make better strategic decisions.

Data is central to how Mentimeter succeeds. At Mentimeter, the Catalyst department is on a mission to realise our company strategy and drive innovation, growth, and impact throughout the company by using data, automations and generative AI. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams, senior stakeholders, and company leaders to identify high impact opportunities and turn them into data science solutions that improve decision making, customer outcomes, and revenue growth.

You will join the Revenue Analytics team, working at the intersection of analytics, data science, revenue operations, and business. Your work will not only influence team and functional outcomes, but also contribute to broader cross functional goals across our go-to-market organisation.

What You’ll Do


Lead data science initiatives and workstreams for our Enterprise go-to-market motions, from opportunity discovery and problem framing through to delivery, adoption, and impact measurement.
Design, build, and productionise machine learning models and data products such as predictive scoring, clustering, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, and prioritisation models.
Identify and shape high impact opportunities across retention, engagement, revenue growth, sales efficiency, customer lifecycle, and go-to-market performance.
Partner with Revenue Operations, Product Analytics, Analytics Engineers as well as senior business stakeholders and company leaders to align priorities and drive impact.
Set and evolve data science craft standards, including best practices for modelling, code quality, deployment, monitoring, documentation, automation, and responsible use of AI.
Mentor and guide data scientists, analysts, and cross functional partners, helping raise the quality and impact of data science work across the function.
Communicate recommendations and complex analyses in a way that influences decisions across different levels of the organisation.



We believe you have


A minimum of 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, machine learning, or a closely related field.
A proven track record of leading data science projects or workstreams end-to-end, including problem framing, stakeholder alignment, technical delivery, adoption, and impact measurement.
Deep expertise in data science methodologies, with strong proficiency in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistics, and applied modelling.
Experience using AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar to improve productivity, automation, and delivery quality.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect data science opportunities to strategic business objectives across sales, marketing, product, revenue operations, customer engagement, retention, or growth.
Experience navigating ambiguous or complex business problems, identifying the right analytical approach, and driving alignment across multiple teams.
Strong software and ML engineering practices, including git, code reviews, testing, versioning, monitoring, documentation, and writing performant, maintainable code for production use.
Experience setting or improving technical standards, best practices, reusable patterns, or ways of working within a data science, analytics, or engineering team.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in influencing senior stakeholders priorities and decisions through clear narratives, visualisations, and recommendations with clear business impact.
A track record of mentoring others, providing technical guidance, and fostering a culture of high standards, continuous learning, and collaboration.
Experience collaborating closely with data engineers or analytics engineers on data pipelines, model deployment, monitoring, and scalable data foundations.



Nice to have


Familiarity with modern data tools such as Snowflake, Hex, dbt, or similar.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Experience working in a SaaS environment, especially with enterprise go-to-market, revenue, customer lifecycle, product usage, or retention data.
Experience influencing company-level priorities through data science, analytics, or strategic insight work.



Not required


Swedish is not required (as daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities)
A traditional cover letter is not required as part of your application



📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process


Introduction interview
Competence interview, including a live case.
Personality & Logical ability test
Culture interview
References & Offer



Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 70,000–SEK 86,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.


AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.



AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As a Data Scientist at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to, but the underlying instrumentation and platform belong to our data engineering team. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a Small, Centralised Team Supporting The Whole Company, Hiring For The Person, Not The Seat. Depending On Your Strengths And Where We Have The Biggest Gap When You Join, You Could Be Embedded Primarily With


Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.
Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.
Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.
GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.


You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What You Will Be Doing


Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.
Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.
Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.
Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.


What You'll Need


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.
Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.
Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:
Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)
Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)
Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)
Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

Nice to have


Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.
Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster.
Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.


Most Importantly, You Are Someone Who


"Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.
Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.


Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As a Data Scientist at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to, but the underlying instrumentation and platform belong to our data engineering team. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a Small, Centralised Team Supporting The Whole Company, Hiring For The Person, Not The Seat. Depending On Your Strengths And Where We Have The Biggest Gap When You Join, You Could Be Embedded Primarily With

  • Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.
  • Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.
  • Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.
  • GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.
  • Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.
  • Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.

What You'll Need

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.
  • Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:
    • Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)
    • Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)
    • Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)
    • Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)
Nice to have

  • Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.
  • Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster.
  • Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.

Most Importantly, You Are Someone Who

  • "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.
  • Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Optimisation Engineer
Description:
About us

Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.




The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.




Watch our film




About the team

At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine to maximise battery efficiency within the grid. We also focus on creating a data-driven culture by building data pipelines and a Business Intelligence layer to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. Our team plays a key role in driving strategic decision-making and overall company success, and we work closely together to ensure a smooth transition of ideas from concept to reality. At Ingrid, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued. We believe in empowering our team members to make a real impact.




About the role

As our Optimisation Engineer at Ingrid, you'll lead efforts in optimising battery storage to support the grid and transition to renewable energy. You'll be key in improving our battery optimisation algorithms, ensuring they operate at peak efficiency. This role requires strong mathematical skills and a mix of optimisation techniques. The impact of your work on our revenue is substantial, with an annual output that continues to grow. You'll collaborate across teams to incorporate diverse data into our models and translate insights into actions.




Location: Stockholm (on-site)




What you'll do

Contribute to the evolution of our battery system optimisation algorithms. Craft and refine them to maximise efficiency and economic performance, leveraging multi-stage optimisation strategies.
Apply your mathematical expertise to real-world energy challenges. Apply deep mathematical knowledge and cutting-edge problem formulation techniques to tackle intricate energy storage challenges using stochastic optimisation, linear programming, and reinforcement learning.
Bridge the data gap. Collaborate closely with your team to seamlessly integrate forecasts and other crucial data into our optimisation models.
Champion innovation. Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by actively contributing to the advancement of our data science and optimisation approaches.
Collaborate to optimise. Work closely with stakeholders to align business goals with tailored optimisation solutions.




Who we think you are

Ideally, you have experience from the energy sector, particularly battery storage or renewable energy systems, and experience in battery optimisation or hydro optimisation is, of course, very meritorious. You have a track record of innovation and a problem solving mindset, in complex, data-driven projects.




Here's what will set you up for success:

Experienced Optimiser: You have proven experience in optimisation, data science, operations research, applied mathematics, or other related field, with a strong foundation in optimisation algorithms and/or machine learning.
Math Mastermind: Solid foundation in mathematical concepts essential for optimisation modeling, including linear programming and scenario analysis.
Technical Expertise: You're comfortable applying various optimisation methods, including linear programming. Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language for optimisation tasks is required.




For this role, we think you have an educational background in mathematics, engineering physics, data science, energy systems, computer science or similar.




Why join us?

At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.




Next step

We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.




We look forward to hearing from you!

/Team Ingrid

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Forecasting, Solna
Description:
Forecasting sits at the heart of how PostNord runs - every volume we plan for, every route we optimize, every shift we staff starts with a forecast. We're now strengthening our Forecasting team and looking for a Senior Data Scientist to be a central pillar in building something stronger.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. The team already has a Tech Lead and a Product Owner, so you won't be carrying out the roadmap or line management. Instead, your seniority shows up in the quality of your models, the judgement behind your decisions, and your ability to lift the people around you.

Join us

The Technology Acceleration area within Group IT is responsible for establishing the future IT landscape - the foundation for PostNord's continued AI- and data-driven journey. In the Forecasting team you'll combine deep machine learning craft with real business understanding to deliver forecasts that operations actually trust and act on, across the logistics domain.

You won't just build models. You'll help decide where forecasting creates the most value, what's worth improving, and what's better rebuilt from scratch.

Job Duties


Develop, improve, and maintain forecasting models for core logistics use cases - volumes, routes, staffing, and beyond.
Evaluate what we already run and make pragmatic calls: optimize, replace, or redesign from the ground up.
Get close to the operation - translate messy operational reality and business challenges into robust, scalable forecasting solutions.
Ensure that the forecast holds up in production: data quality, feature engineering, and reconciling planning horizons and cadences.
Collaborate with data engineers, domain teams, and the wider analytics community on our Databricks platform.
Raise the bar around you - share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and help establish forecasting and model-lifecycle best practices.
Communicate insight, trade-offs, and uncertainty clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


,


Extensive experience as a Data Scientist with a strong focus on machine learning and forecasting, and a track record of models running in production.
Strong grounding in time-series modelling, statistical methods, and modern ML approaches.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience with modern data platforms - Databricks is highly relevant.
A genuine ability to connect technical solutions to business impact, and the maturity to work hands-on while helping shape technical direction alongside the Tech Lead and Product Owner.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.


Meritorious Experience


Experience in logistics, supply chain, or other operational forecasting domains - though we equally value strong forecasting craft brought in from any data-heavy domain.
Probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical forecasting, or optimization.
MLOps practices and model lifecycle management.
Scaling models in cloud environments, preferably Azure.
Experimentation frameworks and model evaluation techniques.
Mentoring or informally leading other data scientists.
Comfort working in an engineering organization that leans heavily on AI tooling to move faster.


Language requirement

Fluent English in speech and writing. Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language is meritorious.

Why this role matters

Better forecasts mean better decisions - fewer surprises in the network, smarter staffing, and capacity planned where it's needed. As a senior member of the team, you'll be a key reason our forecasting capability gets stronger, faster, and more trusted across the business.

Your profile

You're a senior, mature data scientist who pairs technical excellence with a strong business mindset. You're pragmatic - able to improve what exists and know when to start over. You're comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders, and you instinctively lift the people around you without needing a title to do it.

Most of all, you want to help build something stronger: a high-performing forecasting team that delivers real operational impact at scale.

We offer


A cutting-edge analytics environment built on Databricks and Azure
A central role in accelerating PostNord's AI- and data-driven journey
The freedom to shape how forecasting is done at scale in a leading logistics company


Apply

Welcome with your application! We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis. Please note that due to the summer holiday period, the earliest feedback will be provided in mid-August.

Title: Lead Data Scientist / Analytics Engineer to TxB Analytics in Nordea
Description:
Job ID: 5146

The banking industry is undergoing a period of dynamic change and Transaction Banking (TxB) – the Payments, Cards and Trade Solution area – is at the heart of the digital, instant and open revolution. We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist / Analytics Engineer with high stakeholder management skills to create actionable customer insights, identify new revenue opportunities, improve execution on strategies utilising data and further develop or analytical platform.

About Our Team

Welcome to the TxB Analytics team; the data science team that enables TxB and our customers to become more data driven. We add value by creating actionable customer insights to optimise existing business while at the same time exploring new revenue opportunities and improving efficiency. To be successful we need a tech savvy and analytical mind with great business understanding. We aim to be courageous and explorative in our approach which means you’ll have many opportunities to learn and grow as you build your career with us. Will you help us take the next step with our use of data?

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Work closely with our most important stakeholders, understand their needs, capture requirements and conduct workshops with them.
Functional leadership of the area software engineering and ML/AI to strengthen the team in the area.
Utilise data analytics to build analytics products so our stakeholders can make important strategic decisions, grow income, improve operational efficiency and develop Nordea’s product offering.
Identify business opportunities (e.g. sales leads, merchant intelligence opportunities, etc) utilising internal and external data.
Apply data science techniques such as statistical modelling, machine learning and Artificial Intelligence.
Be responsible for the development of our technical analytical platform to make it fit for purpose for Data Science.
Support and collaborate closely with other team members.


Who You Are

Your background and skills include:


You have experience working as a Data Scientist or similar where you have experiences with analytical and quantitative problem solving using advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods and AI.
You have a business consulting mindset and are proactive working with stakeholders to understand their needs and how analytics can help them.
You have good end-to-end software engineering skills.
You have deep knowledge in SQL and programming, e.g. Python.
Solid experience in Airflow, dbt and Snowflake (or similar tools).
You are familiar with Power BI (or similar business intelligence tools).
You have data/analytics engineering experience.
You are business minded, analytical and have excellent communication skills in English (both in text and spoken).
You are a social, curious and a pragmatic team player.
Experience in Requirements Management and workshop facilitation would an advantage.
Experience in Transaction Banking or Payments/Cards would be an advantage.
You have a MSc/BSc/BA degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, physics or related quantitative degree.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 07/08/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Mikael Simonsson at mikael.simonsson@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Scania Asset Management
Description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Scania is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we understand, value, price, and manage electric vehicle assets over time.

This role is for someone who wants to own complex analytical problems, not only build models. You will work with imperfect operational data, commercial tradeoffs, and decisions that matter: residual value, pricing, lifecycle planning, asset risk, and long-term value creation.

Role Summary

You will join a small team with broad responsibilities and close contact with business, finance, product, engineering, and data colleagues. Your work will connect data science with real asset decisions, from assumptions and analysis to model services and recommendations that others can rely on.

Prior experience with electric vehicles, batteries, finance, fintech, pricing, risk, or asset valuation is valuable, but not required. We are looking primarily for seniority in judgement, ownership, and the ability to create clarity in complex problem areas.

Job Responsibilities



Develop models for battery-electric vehicle usage, remaining useful life, residual value, pricing, lifecycle forecasting, and portfolio risk.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Forecasting, Solna
Description:
Forecasting sits at the heart of how PostNord runs - every volume we plan for, every route we optimize, every shift we staff starts with a forecast. We're now strengthening our Forecasting team and looking for a Senior Data Scientist to be a central pillar in building something stronger.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. The team already has a Tech Lead and a Product Owner, so you won't be carrying out the roadmap or line management. Instead, your seniority shows up in the quality of your models, the judgement behind your decisions, and your ability to lift the people around you.

Join us

The Technology Acceleration area within Group IT is responsible for establishing the future IT landscape - the foundation for PostNord's continued AI- and data-driven journey. In the Forecasting team you'll combine deep machine learning craft with real business understanding to deliver forecasts that operations actually trust and act on, across the logistics domain.

You won't just build models. You'll help decide where forecasting creates the most value, what's worth improving, and what's better rebuilt from scratch.

Job Duties


Develop, improve, and maintain forecasting models for core logistics use cases - volumes, routes, staffing, and beyond.
Evaluate what we already run and make pragmatic calls: optimize, replace, or redesign from the ground up.
Get close to the operation - translate messy operational reality and business challenges into robust, scalable forecasting solutions.
Ensure that the forecast holds up in production: data quality, feature engineering, and reconciling planning horizons and cadences.
Collaborate with data engineers, domain teams, and the wider analytics community on our Databricks platform.
Raise the bar around you - share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and help establish forecasting and model-lifecycle best practices.
Communicate insight, trade-offs, and uncertainty clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Extensive experience as a Data Scientist with a strong focus on machine learning and forecasting, and a track record of models running in production.
Strong grounding in time-series modelling, statistical methods, and modern ML approaches.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience with modern data platforms - Databricks is highly relevant.
A genuine ability to connect technical solutions to business impact, and the maturity to work hands-on while helping shape technical direction alongside the Tech Lead and Product Owner.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.


Meritorious Experience


Experience in logistics, supply chain, or other operational forecasting domains - though we equally value strong forecasting craft brought in from any data-heavy domain.
Probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical forecasting, or optimization.
MLOps practices and model lifecycle management.
Scaling models in cloud environments, preferably Azure.
Experimentation frameworks and model evaluation techniques.
Mentoring or informally leading other data scientists.
Comfort working in an engineering organization that leans heavily on AI tooling to move faster.


Language requirement

Fluent English in speech and writing. Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language is meritorious.

Why this role matters

Better forecasts mean better decisions - fewer surprises in the network, smarter staffing, and capacity planned where it's needed. As a senior member of the team, you'll be a key reason our forecasting capability gets stronger, faster, and more trusted across the business.

Your profile

You're a senior, mature data scientist who pairs technical excellence with a strong business mindset. You're pragmatic - able to improve what exists and know when to start over. You're comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders, and you instinctively lift the people around you without needing a title to do it.

Most of all, you want to help build something stronger: a high-performing forecasting team that delivers real operational impact at scale.

We offer


A cutting-edge analytics environment built on Databricks and Azure
A central role in accelerating PostNord's AI- and data-driven journey
The freedom to shape how forecasting is done at scale in a leading logistics company


Apply

Welcome with your application! We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis. Please note that due to the summer holiday period, the earliest feedback will be provided in mid-August.

Description:
På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Som ML Engineer hos Sogeti blir du en del av vårt lokala team inom Data & AI. I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla, produktionssätta och vidareutveckla AI- och machine learning-lösningar i moderna molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS.

Du hjälper våra kunder att gå från idé, data och experiment till robusta lösningar som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Rollen kan omfatta allt från modellutveckling och MLOps till generativ AI, RAG-lösningar, AI-agenter och integration av AI-funktionalitet i befintliga system.

I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:


Utveckling, träning, utvärdering och optimering av machine learning-modeller.
Produktionssättning av AI- och ML-lösningar som API:er, batchflöden eller integrerade delar av kundens system.
Arbete med MLOps, modellversionering, deployment, monitorering och retraining.
Utveckling av data- och feature pipelines tillsammans med Data Engineers.
Användning av teknologier som Python, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, Docker, CI/CD och moderna molnplattformar.
Utforskande av generativ AI, LLM:er, RAG, embeddings, vektordatabaser och AI-agenter.


Din profil


Flerårig erfarenhet av Python-programmering och machine learning.
Erfarenhet av modellutveckling, modellutvärdering, feature engineering och produktionssättning av ML- eller AI-lösningar.
God förståelse för MLOps och modellens livscykel från träning till produktion.
Erfarenhet av Git, CI/CD, Docker, SQL och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
Erfarenhet av molnbaserade AI-, ML- eller datalösningar i Azure och/eller AWS.
Förmåga att samarbeta med Data Scientists, Data Engineers, utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhet.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt god professionell kunskap i engelska.


Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas.


En kultur som präglas av närhet, samarbete och ett genuint kunskapsutbyte mellan kollegor
Möjlighet att utvecklas inom data, AI och moderna dataplattformar – i uppdrag och genom tillgång till både lokala och globala kompetensnätverk
Ett team där du får arbeta nära andra specialister inom data, analys och AI, i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad för kund och samhälle

Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.

Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.

We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.

About The Role

This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.

Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.

The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers

Some of the things you'll be up to:


Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


So, who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.

You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.

At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.

Besides the above, we believe you've got:


Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:


An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


Some of our benefits:


30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week


About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.

Vacation period!

As we are heading out for the vacation period, feedback on your application might take a little longer than usual. Don't hesitate to send in your application, though; we'll do our best in getting back to you as soon as possible! 🌴

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.
