As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.

We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.

About The Role

This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.

Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.

The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers

Some of the things you'll be up to:

  • Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
  • Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
  • Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
  • Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
  • Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
  • Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities

So, who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.

You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.

At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.

Besides the above, we believe you've got:

  • Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
  • Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
  • Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
  • Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery

Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:

  • An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
  • Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
  • Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
  • An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.

Some of our benefits:

  • 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
  • Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
  • Breakfast buffet on Fridays
  • Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
  • A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
  • 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
  • Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
  • A wellness hour you can use every week

About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.

Vacation period!

As we are heading out for the vacation period, feedback on your application might take a little longer than usual. Don't hesitate to send in your application, though; we'll do our best in getting back to you as soon as possible! 🌴

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Consumer Product Analytics
Description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About Consumer Analytics At Wolt

The team partners closely with Wolt's product organization and business partners to make sure the right insights reach the right people at the right time, building a culture where data is a natural part of how we work, not a bottleneck or an afterthought.

The Core Experience team sits at the heart of this, covering the full customer journey from opening the app to completing an order – browsing, search, in-venue experience, cart and checkout. Data Scientists here work hand in hand with product teams, combining rigorous experimentation with sharp business judgment to move fast without sacrificing confidence.

About The Consumer Data Science Team

The team partners closely with Wolt's product organization and business partners to make sure the right insights reach the right people at the right time, building a culture where data is a natural part of how we work, not a bottleneck or an afterthought.

The Core Experience team sits at the heart of this, covering the full customer journey from opening the app to completing an order – browsing, search, in-venue experience, cart and checkout. Data Scientists here work hand in hand with product teams, combining rigorous experimentation with sharp business judgment to move fast without sacrificing confidence.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational and actionable data-driven experience that requires a good mix of technical and stakeholder engagement skills. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics or data science role. Data Scientists at Wolt take ownership of the business outcomes.

If you enjoy finding patterns amidst the chaos, are excited to build from 0 to 1, and have experience using data science skills to solve business problems, we're looking for someone like you.

Our humble expectations


5+ years of experience in an analytics or data science position
Experience working with product funnels and user journeys
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Hands-on experience in designing and analysing A/B testing
Experience in using AI in your work to accelerate work velocity, automate repetitive tasks, and generate SQL queries and experiment readouts
Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Tableau, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar


What we offer


The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics!
You have the chance to decide the ways of working: hybrid, at the office, or remote within Berlin, Stockholm, or Helsinki. 💙
You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.


Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
About the Role




Our client is building AI capability on top of our payments data platform. The foundation is Looker/LookML, with custom AI agents built on top to generate recommendations from payments data.




This is a greenfield role with significant influence over both the technical direction and delivery approach. Rather than implementing a predefined architecture, you will assess the available options, define the target architecture and establish the technical strategy for this new capability.




Tech Stack

You'll be working across:




Backend: NestJS, Node.js, .NET API, Python (FastAPI)
Frontend: React, Next.js
Data platforms: Looker + LookML, BigQuery, MySQL, MongoDB
Cloud: GCP
AI: Gemini model APIs, designing and building custom agents on top of the BI layer




What You'll Do




Define the technical strategy and architecture for a custom AI agent layer sitting on top of Looker/LookML to produce recommendations from payments data
Design and build an anomaly detection system for payments and KYC data
Lead design decisions on how these agents integrate with our existing stack (NestJS/Node, .NET, Python/FastAPI, GCP, BigQuery, MySQL, MongoDB)
Own the big data pipeline and modelling work needed to support the AI layer
Set direction where none currently exists, this is a build-it-from-scratch mandate, not execution against a pre-defined spec
Lead the project end-to-end, from strategy through implementation
Design the statistical layer that decides whether and how confidently a recommendation should be made — significance/sample-size thresholds, baseline and cohort comparison, anomaly detection, and confidence scoring — before it's handed to an LLM to explain




What You'll Need




Proven experience in finance/payments data
Strong background in big data architecture and large-scale data platforms
Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered agents or applications
Experience with BI/analytics tooling, ideally Looker/LookML
Applied statistics / data science background, anomaly detection, significance testing, time-series baselining, confidence/scoring models.
Track record of leading a technical project from ambiguous requirements through to a concrete solution and delivery
Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, given this is a new area for the business

Title: Product Manager, Data Insights
Description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You think like a product manager and work like a data scientist. You have shipped ML-powered products to real customers and can point to the decisions you made, not just the ones made around you. Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.

You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.

You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.

Purpose of role

The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.

The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.

About Justera Group

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in Linear Programming (LP) and Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) to develop, maintain, and scale production-grade optimization solutions. This role requires a solid foundation in optimization, analytics, statistics, and machine learning, along with the ability to build robust, production-ready data science solutions in a cloud environment.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Python developer who writes clean, modular, and maintainable code, possesses strong SQL skills, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities:


Maintain, optimize, and enhance existing optimization models by identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing scalable solutions.
Develop, deploy, monitor, and maintain production-grade optimization and machine learning solutions in a cloud environment.
Build and improve data preparation, transformation, and aggregation pipelines while integrating new data sources to enrich model performance.
Analyze model outputs and communicate insights and recommendations to business stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Implement and support MLOps best practices, including deployment, monitoring, automation, and model lifecycle management.
Perform ad hoc data analysis and create visualizations to support data-driven decision-making.
Ensure solution reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency through continuous monitoring and performance improvements.


Requirements:


Strong experience with Discrete Optimization, including Linear Programming (LP), Integer Programming (IP), and Mixed Integer Programming (MIP).
Proven experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions in production cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Advanced Python programming skills with experience writing clean, modular, testable, and production-ready code.
Strong SQL skills for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with MLOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience building scalable data wrangling, transformation, and aggregation pipelines.
Familiarity with dbt for data transformation workflows.
Experience working in Agile, cross-functional environments.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to thrive in complex, fast-paced, and evolving business environments.


What We Offer:


A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Digital Sales Personal Banking
Description:
Job ID: 5575

Would you like to empower business to unlock the potential of data? We are growing our team in Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) Sweden. We are now looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can help us to utilise more data and insight to engage with customers in different interactions.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

In Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) we are a group of specialists in various fields: everything from digital marketing and content production to web analysis and data science. Collectively, we are responsible for engaging new and existing personal customers in digital channels and driving sales via online/mobile banking and nordea.se. We are building the omnichannel customer journey experience and for that we need to connect different data sources across our platforms and applications. Right product, right process, right message, right channel, at the right time for the right customer.

The role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a curious and driven Senior Data Scientist who will play a key role in implementing our omnichannel customer journey strategy. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with stakeholders in Personal Banking. In this role, you will enable Digital Sales to leverage data and analytics to enhance the customer experience. You will deliver insights and recommendations, drive automation through model-based solutions, simplify processes, and identify new data sources. Together with the team, you will develop advanced AI models to predict customer needs and behaviours in digital channels.

In addition you will be:


Analysing how our omnichannel business is developing including e.g. sales, activity performance, customer behaviour, pricing, process steps and demand
Designing and developing customer engagement activities: suggest target group, evaluate data availability, support utilizing sufficient control groups, monitor the outcome of activities, and evaluate the results
Participating actively in the work of digital customer journey teams, training and coaching the team to utilize data & analytics
Enabling data for analytics, reporting and marketing automation tool(s)
Recommending and performing analysis of different data sources to spot development trends and pain points
Together with a wider data analyst community and take part into building analytics & tools needed for business development


Who You Are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.

We are looking for someone passionate about data and analytics, with the ability to turn data into insights, ideas and opportunities that support strong customer experiences. You take ownership of the full data science lifecycle—from data gathering and engineering to modelling—while keeping a clear business focus.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are/have:


Interest in business and customer behaviour
Good at collaboration in practice - work closely with other Subject Matter Experts, involve stakeholders and always asking questions and investigating alternative solutions
Can drive tasks on your own but equally skilled in facilitating collaboration around tasks while maintaining the customer centric mindset
Innovative, openminded and excited about bringing your ideas to the table. You strive for continuous improvement and love learning and trying out new things. You're dependable, willing to speak up even when it's difficult, and committed to empowering others
A proactive, innovative and can-do oriented mind-set with the ability to convert new ideas into concrete actions, share “make it happen attitude”
A passion to share your knowledge and a ability to clearly communicate complex issues in an easy and understandable manner to a wide range of stakeholder


Your experience and background:


At least 3-5 years of experience in data analytics/data science
You are comfortable in using one or more data science programming language e.g. Python, R, SQL
You know your ways around tools like Hive, Snowflake, visualization tool such as Power BI
You understand the principles of working with an Agile development approach
Academic degree in highly quantitative discipline or specialisation such as Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Finance, and you have understanding of statistical concepts (e.g. Hypothesis Testing) and machine learning models
Proficient in written and spoken Swedish and English


What We Offer

By joining Nordea you can impact on the life of 11 million customers. Our team has an important role in helping to inspire and educate business teams on effectively utilizing data to drive informed decision-making. Joining the team will provide you with opportunities to use your experience with data management, data analysis and data engineering to support business developers, leaders, digital marketing specialists & other stakeholders.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Please submit your application no later 16/08/2026. Remember that we don´t accept applications via email. Interviews will be held continuously. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Sebastian Kovacs, Head of PeB analytics SE, +46 76-8239114, Sebastian.kovacs@nordea.se.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
Description:
Hos Capgemini får du möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt som passar dig, med stöd från en gemenskap av experter som inspirerar och stärker dig. Vi tror på att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt genom att använda teknik för att bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld. Våra team inom Insights & Data ligger i framkant i denna resa och levererar heltäckande Data & AI-lösningar inom olika branscher. Med över 550 specialister i Norden använder vi strategiska partnerskap med Google, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks och Snowflake för att skala Data & Analytics i molnet. Här spelar din kompetens och ditt perspektiv roll – var med och driv innovation samt transformera industrier med banbrytande datalösningar!

Om rollen

Som Data Engineer med fokus på Databricks kommer du att bygga skalbara och säkra dataplattformar. Du använder din kunskap inom Databricks, Apache Spark samt Azure för att designa, utveckla och implementera datalager, data lakehouses och AI/ML-modeller som driver våra datadrivna verksamheter.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:


Att designa och bygga robusta datapipelines: använda Databricks och Apache Spark för att extrahera, transformera och ladda data till Azure Data Lake Storage och andra Azure-tjänster.

Att samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team: arbeta nära affärsanalytiker, data scientists och DevOps-ingenjörer för att säkerställa framgångsrika implementationer av dataplattformar.


Din profil

Vi vet att många, särskilt kvinnor, tenderar att bara söka roller där de uppfyller alla krav. Om du tror att rollen kan passa dig men inte uppfyller allt – sök gärna ändå!


Yrkeserfarenhet inom data engineering
Erfarenhet av, eller intresse för att arbeta med Databricks, Apache Spark och utveckling av datapipelines samt god förståelse för datalagerkoncept och praxis
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure-plattformen, inklusive Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks och Azure Data Factory
Kunskap i SQL och skriptspråk som Python samt praktisk erfarenhet av AI/ML-koncept och verktyg
Meriterande om du talar och skriver flytande svenska

Vi förstår vikten av flexibla arbetsformer. Oavsett om det handlar om distansarbete eller flexibla arbetstider får du en miljö som stödjer en god balans mellan arbete och privatliv.
Din karriärutveckling står i centrum. Våra olika karriärprogram och yrkesroller är utformade för att hjälpa dig att utforska en värld av möjligheter.
Vi samarbetar med bolag som Google, Microsoft, Amazon och Databricks, vilket ger dig möjlighet att ta värdefulla certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken – om det är något du eftersträvar.
Vi arbetar aktivt för en inkluderande och trygg arbetsmiljö där olika perspektiv värdesätts och där du kan vara dig själv.


Ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Vi strävar efter en jämnare könsfördelning och ser gärna fler kvinnor och icke-binära sökande till den här rollen.

Just nu har vi semesterperiod och hoppas även du njuter av en fin sommar! Vi kommer jobba löpande i denna rekryteringsprocess men vill nämna att det under semesterperiod kan dröja lite längre än vanligt i återkopplingen till dig som valt att söka. Stort tack för ditt tålamod!

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som


har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.


Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av


Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar


Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken? Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.

We’re now looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve real business problems. You’ll combine broad engineering capability with hands-on delivery, moving fast from idea to working prototypes to production-ready value. This role is about creative engineering, co-creation with users, and shaping how enterprises adopt AI in practice. You will also be part of Norrin’s AI Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.

In this role, you will


Work closely with customers to understand their problems and rapidly design practical AI solutions
Implement end-to-end AI/ML workflows, from agents and RAG setups to traditional ML where needed
Build and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure
Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase


What We’re Looking For


4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)
Strong cloud development background (Azure preferred)
Strong skills in Python and modern engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, testing mindset)
Experience with deploying and operating ML systems in production
Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL
Ability to frame problems, design pragmatic solutions, and work directly with end-users
Strong English and Swedish skills (written & spoken)
Educational background in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or similar


Nice to have


Experience with IaC and containerization (Terraform, Docker)
Familiarity with PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, deep learning, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Experience working with data platforms (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, event streams, data warehouses)
Background in structured testing approaches to ensure robustness
Prior consulting or customer-facing engineering experience
Prior leadership or consulting experience, with the ability to guide teams and advise stakeholders


Why Norrin? 

At Norrin, you'll join an international team of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect, with psychological safety at its core. We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer wellbeing benefits like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our competitive compensation model offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

  • Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
  • Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
  • Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
  • Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
  • Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase

  • 4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
  • Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)

  • Experience with deploying and operating ML systems in production
  • Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL

What you'll actually do

You’ll work closely with our clients on high-impact initiatives where data is critical to the business. Many of our engagements involve greenfield builds or major platform transformations. This role suits engineers who enjoy creating structure from complexity and taking end-to-end ownership.

Design and build modern data platforms from scratch.
Ingest, model, and structure data so it’s usable for analytics, AI and ML workloads.
Work close to production, with growing responsibility for operating, evolving, and improving platforms over time.
Contribute internally by improving how we work, helping build and manage our data engineering frameworks, shaping our technical approaches, being part of presales and supporting Playground’s continued growth.


You’ll never sit idle, there’s always something meaningful to build, improve, or untangle.

Who are you?

You’ve been building data platforms for a few years and know that data doesn’t magically organize itself. Python and SQL are part of your daily toolkit, and you’ve wrestled with at least one modern data stack (AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake etc.) and lived to tell the tale.

Understands data engineering in practice: You know how data needs to flow, scale, and hold up in production for analytics and AI and ML workloads.

Enjoys building from scratch: Greenfield work doesn’t scare you, it motivates you.

Stays calm when things are unclear: You don’t panic when requirements are fuzzy and the system diagram needs three whiteboards.

Is comfortable in a consultant role: You handle customer dialogue well, can contribute in presales, and help guide clients through difficult decisions.

As a person, you’re humble, genuinely curious about technology, and motivated, while knowing that asking for help is a strength, not a weakness. Friendly, curious, and playful.

You must be based in the Stockholm area and have a valid work permit for Sweden (no visa sponsorship or relocation).

Applying to us is a breeze!


Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us


Note

Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support.

For this role applicants must have a swedish citizenship

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.

Vi söker en person som trivs i en teknisk roll och vill bygga datafundamentet för att:


Bygga datamodeller i dbt och BigQuery. Basmodeller som hela organisationen konsumerar. Tydliga namn, dokumentation och tester.
Få in och modellera event-data. Du tar Kafka backend-events och Piwik frontend-events hela vägen in i BQ/dbt och bygger affärslogiken ovanpå: aktivering, inloggning och hur kunder rör sig genom produkterna.
Äga produktdomänen i dataplattformen. Du ansvarar för struktur, standards och kvalitet för allt som rör produkt, så att andra team kan lita på modellerna.
Göra datan användbar för både människor och AI. Vi bygger en AI-driven pipeline för mätning. Du säkrar att modeller och events är dokumenterade så att relevanta stakeholders förstår dem, och så att en AI-agent svarar rätt på frågor om dem.
Hjälpa team hjälpa sig själva. Du bygger verktygen och kontexten som låter produktteam lägga till mätning och hämta data på egen hand.



Om dig

Du har erfarenhet av att bygga dbt-modeller i produktion, med SQL som primärt verktyg. Det som gör dig intressant för oss är att du vet skillnaden mellan en modell som råkar vara korrekt och en som faktiskt är användbar, för en analytiker, en produktägare eller en AI-agent.

Du har jobbat med event-data och vet hur stökig den kan vara: många events som triggas olika, och sällan dokumentation som reder ut det. Du förstår affären bakom datan och frågar "vilken affärsfråga besvarar den här modellen?" innan du bygger den.

Du kan förklara vad du byggt för någon som inte jobbar med data varje dag, och säga nej när det behövs.

Du bryr dig om kvalitet och reagerar när namngivning är inkonsekvent, dokumentation saknas eller en definition inte hänger ihop.

Du kommunicerar flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.

Vi ser det även som positivt om du har: erfarenhet av BigQuery/GCP. Nyfikenhet på att bygga BI-as-code, istället för att klicka i ett BI-verktyg. Vi tittar på verktyg i den riktningen, som Lightdash eller Evidence, och på rapportering direkt via Claude. Vana att jobba med AI-verktyg på riktigt: bryta ner uppgifter, ge kontext, validera resultat. Lust att läsa i kodbasen för att förstå var events triggas och var datan kommer ifrån.

Vi jobbar med dbt, BigQuery, Piwik Pro och AI-verktyg för kodning och analys.

Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet

Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.

Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.

Urvalsprocessen beräknar vi påbörja i mitten av augusti, därför kan återkoppling på din ansökan dröja.

Behandling av personuppgifter

Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:

https://apps.fortnox.se/api/eula/document-v1/privacy-policy-recruiting

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
HiQ växer inom data, AI och cloud - och vi letar nu efter Data Engineers som vill bygga moderna dataplattformar, skapa smarta dataflöden och göra det möjligt för våra kunder att fatta bättre beslut och utveckla nya tjänster.

Som Data Engineer på HiQ kommer du att bygga och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i molnet, från datainhämtning och transformering till realtidsanalys och vidare till användning i analys, rapportering och AI. Du designar och optimerar datamodeller och dataflöden, inklusive streaminglösningar med till exempel Apache Kafka eller motsvarande, och du arbetar med robusta CI/CD processer samt IaC i moderna cloudmiljöer. Du blir en viktig del i hur våra kunder samlar, strukturerar och använder sin data för att skapa verkligt affärsvärde.

Utöver detta kommer du att vara med i den AI satsning som HiQ gör, med möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt för hur data blir navet i våra AI lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har:


Minst 3 års erfarenhet av data engineering och molnbaserade dataplattformar
Erfarenhet av molnlösningar i Azure, AWS eller GCP
Goda kunskaper i Python och SQL för att bygga, automatisera och optimera dataflöden
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datamodellering, prestandaoptimering och kvalitetssäkring av data
Högskole eller universitetsexamen i datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant inriktning
Svenskt medborgarskap samt är flytande i svenska och engelska


Meriterande:


Erfarenhet av Databricks, Snowflake eller liknande plattformar
Erfarenhet av AI eller ML workflows, till exempel att ta modeller i produktion i en dataplattform
Förmåga att designa dataarkitektur och göra tekniska vägval i komplexa miljöer
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med ETL eller ELT verktyg och ramverk som till exempel Airflow eller dbt
Vana av att sätta upp och underhålla CI CD pipelines för data och molnprojekt
Vana av att jobba kundnära i tekniska projekt


Vi tror att du är en person som älskar att bygga stabila lösningar som gör data enkel att använda. Du trivs när du får kombinera struktur med kreativitet, du gillar att dela med dig av din expertis och du har en naturlig förmåga att driva arbetet framåt tillsammans med andra.

Varför HiQ

Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar, det är vad som driver oss framåt. Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.  

I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och tillsammans forma framtidens dataintensiva och AI drivna lösningar. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Just nu tankar vi energi på semestern och är därför lite långsammare på bollen än vanligt. Vi är tillbaka i början av augusti och hör av oss då – tills dess hoppas vi att du njuter av en riktigt skön sommar! 🌞

Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar, det är vad som driver oss framåt. Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.  

I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och tillsammans forma framtidens dataintensiva och AI drivna lösningar. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Just nu tankar vi energi på semestern och är därför lite långsammare på bollen än vanligt. Vi är tillbaka i början av augusti och hör av oss då – tills dess hoppas vi att du njuter av en riktigt skön sommar! 🌞

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Would you like to play a key part in Toca Boca’s Data & Research engine? With over 60 million monthly active users and terabytes of daily data, as a Senior Data Scientist, you will play an integral role in understanding how kids and families engage with our play ecosystem, directly shaping fantastic, safe, and imaginative play experiences.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into narrow corporate silos or endless maintenance tasks. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will enjoy broad end-to-end ownership across the entire product lifecycle—from exploratory data science, advanced modeling, and experimentation to product strategy and monetization dynamics.

You’ll join our Data & Analytics team while partnering seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner. Together, we blend big data behavioral telemetry with qualitative player research, working closely with cross-functional game teams to unlock the full value of our play ecosystem.

What You’ll Be Doing


Uncover Deep Player Insights: Analyze complex player datasets to understand behavioral patterns, feature engagement, and retention drivers across our games, informing overall product and commerce strategy.
Apply Advanced Statistical Methods: Apply statistical models, regression analysis, predictive segmentation, and experimental methods (A/B testing) to optimize product performance at scale.
Bridge Quantitative & Qualitative Insights: Partner seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner, connecting the "what" (big data trends) with the "why" (qualitative research) to deliver a 360-degree understanding of our players.
End-to-End Ownership & Influence: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous game product questions. Partner directly with PMs, Designers, and Engineers to translate complex datasets into clear, data-backed recommendations.
Innovate & Evolve Workflows: Continuously refine our analytics capabilities by leveraging modern data science workflows, predictive modeling, and AI tools to accelerate discovery and analysis.


What Success Looks Like


Trusted Co-pilot: You become a trusted analytical partner to game teams, shaping product decisions through rigorous data science, experimentation, and player empathy.
Broad Impact: You thrive with the freedom to influence multiple product areas—from core play loops and feature design to commerce and top-of-funnel engagement—without being pigeonholed.
Holistic Insights: You successfully bridge quantitative behavioral data with qualitative user research to create unified narratives that inspire game design.
Autonomy & Momentum: You help teams move quickly by surfacing key facts, reducing ambiguity, and solving open-ended problems that don't have predefined playbooks.


,

Is This You?


3+ years of experience (or equivalent senior-level impact) in user-focused Data Science or Advanced Product Analytics within Gaming, Mobile Apps, or Interactive Digital Products.
Empathy & Product Sense: Deep curiosity and intuition for player experience, engagement, and kids' digital environments.
SQL Mastery & Data Exploration: Outstanding SQL skills querying cloud data warehouses (experience with Google BigQuery and DBT is a huge plus).
Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.


This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Lylli and Originator, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
Description:
Hos Capgemini får du möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt som passar dig, med stöd från en gemenskap av experter som inspirerar och stärker dig. Vi tror på att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt genom att använda teknik för att bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld. Våra team inom Insights & Data ligger i framkant i denna resa och levererar heltäckande Data & AI-lösningar inom olika branscher. Med över 550 specialister i Norden använder vi strategiska partnerskap med Google, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks och Snowflake för att skala Data & Analytics i molnet. Här spelar din kompetens och ditt perspektiv roll – var med och driv innovation samt transformera industrier med banbrytande datalösningar!

Om rollen

Som Data Engineer med fokus på Databricks kommer du att bygga skalbara och säkra dataplattformar. Du använder din kunskap inom Databricks, Apache Spark samt Azure för att designa, utveckla och implementera datalager, data lakehouses och AI/ML-modeller som driver våra datadrivna verksamheter.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:


Att designa och bygga robusta datapipelines: använda Databricks och Apache Spark för att extrahera, transformera och ladda data till Azure Data Lake Storage och andra Azure-tjänster.
Att utveckla och underhålla säkra datalager och data lakehouses: implementera datamodeller, datakvalitetskontroller och styrningsprinciper för att säkerställa tillförlitlig och korrekt data.
Att bygga och driftsätta AI/ML-modeller: integrera maskininlärning i datapipelines, använda Databricks ML och Azure ML för att utveckla prediktiva modeller och skapa affärsinsikter.
Att samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team: arbeta nära affärsanalytiker, data scientists och DevOps-ingenjörer för att säkerställa framgångsrika implementationer av dataplattformar.


Din profil

Vi vet att många, särskilt kvinnor, tenderar att bara söka roller där de uppfyller alla krav. Om du tror att rollen kan passa dig men inte uppfyller allt – sök gärna ändå!


Yrkeserfarenhet inom data engineering
Erfarenhet av, eller intresse för att arbeta med Databricks, Apache Spark och utveckling av datapipelines samt god förståelse för datalagerkoncept och praxis
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure-plattformen, inklusive Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks och Azure Data Factory
Kunskap i SQL och skriptspråk som Python samt praktisk erfarenhet av AI/ML-koncept och verktyg
Meriterande om du talar och skriver flytande svenska


Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas


Vi förstår vikten av flexibla arbetsformer. Oavsett om det handlar om distansarbete eller flexibla arbetstider får du en miljö som stödjer en god balans mellan arbete och privatliv.
Din karriärutveckling står i centrum. Våra olika karriärprogram och yrkesroller är utformade för att hjälpa dig att utforska en värld av möjligheter.
Vi samarbetar med bolag som Google, Microsoft, Amazon och Databricks, vilket ger dig möjlighet att ta värdefulla certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken – om det är något du eftersträvar.
Vi arbetar aktivt för en inkluderande och trygg arbetsmiljö där olika perspektiv värdesätts och där du kan vara dig själv.


Ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Vi strävar efter en jämnare könsfördelning och ser gärna fler kvinnor och icke-binära sökande till den här rollen.

Just nu har vi semesterperiod och hoppas även du njuter av en fin sommar! Vi kommer jobba löpande i denna rekryteringsprocess men vill nämna att det under semesterperiod kan dröja lite längre än vanligt i återkopplingen till dig som valt att söka. Stort tack för ditt tålamod!

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

We are looking for experienced Data Engineers who love solving problems with data. You will work closely with our clients to understand their needs, design and implement solutions, and help them use data to make better decisions.




You will also have the chance to contribute to internal development, improving how we work, shaping our data engineering frameworks, and helping Playground grow.

Challenging projects with great clients

Competitive compensation

You must be based in the Stockholm area
Valid work permit for Sweden (no visa sponsorship or relocation).

Title: Optimisation Engineer
Description:
About us

Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.




The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.




Watch our film




About the team

At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine to maximise battery efficiency within the grid. We also focus on creating a data-driven culture by building data pipelines and a Business Intelligence layer to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. Our team plays a key role in driving strategic decision-making and overall company success, and we work closely together to ensure a smooth transition of ideas from concept to reality. At Ingrid, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued. We believe in empowering our team members to make a real impact.




About the role

As our Optimisation Engineer at Ingrid, you'll lead efforts in optimising battery storage to support the grid and transition to renewable energy. You'll be key in improving our battery optimisation algorithms, ensuring they operate at peak efficiency. This role requires strong mathematical skills and a mix of optimisation techniques. The impact of your work on our revenue is substantial, with an annual output that continues to grow. You'll collaborate across teams to incorporate diverse data into our models and translate insights into actions.




Location: Stockholm (on-site)




What you'll do

Contribute to the evolution of our battery system optimisation algorithms. Craft and refine them to maximise efficiency and economic performance, leveraging multi-stage optimisation strategies.
Apply your mathematical expertise to real-world energy challenges. Apply deep mathematical knowledge and cutting-edge problem formulation techniques to tackle intricate energy storage challenges using stochastic optimisation, linear programming, and reinforcement learning.
Bridge the data gap. Collaborate closely with your team to seamlessly integrate forecasts and other crucial data into our optimisation models.
Champion innovation. Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by actively contributing to the advancement of our data science and optimisation approaches.
Collaborate to optimise. Work closely with stakeholders to align business goals with tailored optimisation solutions.




Who we think you are

Ideally, you have experience from the energy sector, particularly battery storage or renewable energy systems, and experience in battery optimisation or hydro optimisation is, of course, very meritorious. You have a track record of innovation and a problem solving mindset, in complex, data-driven projects.




Here's what will set you up for success:

Experienced Optimiser: You have proven experience in optimisation, data science, operations research, applied mathematics, or other related field, with a strong foundation in optimisation algorithms and/or machine learning.
Math Mastermind: Solid foundation in mathematical concepts essential for optimisation modeling, including linear programming and scenario analysis.
Technical Expertise: You're comfortable applying various optimisation methods, including linear programming. Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language for optimisation tasks is required.




For this role, we think you have an educational background in mathematics, engineering physics, data science, energy systems, computer science or similar.




Why join us?

At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.




Next step

We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.




We look forward to hearing from you!

/Team Ingrid

Understands data engineering in practice: You know how data needs to flow, scale, and hold up in production for analytics and AI and ML workloads.

Stays calm when things are unclear: You don’t panic when requirements are fuzzy and the system diagram needs three whiteboards.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As a Data Scientist at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to, but the underlying instrumentation and platform belong to our data engineering team. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a Small, Centralised Team Supporting The Whole Company, Hiring For The Person, Not The Seat. Depending On Your Strengths And Where We Have The Biggest Gap When You Join, You Could Be Embedded Primarily With


Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.
Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.
Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.
GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.


You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What You Will Be Doing


Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.
Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.
Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.
Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.


What You'll Need


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.
Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.
Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:
Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)
Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)
Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)
Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

Nice to have


Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.
Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster.
Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.


Most Importantly, You Are Someone Who


"Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.
Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.


Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
