Title: Senior Data Scientist – Optimization & MLOps
Description:
Providing Value & Impact – SwedQ

SwedQ is a consultancy company for people who want to grow, take ownership, and solve challenges that create real business value. We work with clients across a wide range of industries and help them turn technology, data, and ideas into tangible results.

We are now looking for an experienced and versatile Data Scientist who is comfortable working across data science, analytics, optimization, software engineering, and MLOps.

One of our current opportunities has a strong focus on mathematical optimization, production-grade AI, and Google Cloud Platform. However, as a consultant at SwedQ, you should enjoy applying your skills to different industries, technical environments, and business problems over time.

You do not need to fit into a narrow box. We value specialists with broad technical curiosity—the kind of person who can understand a complex business problem, explore the data, develop the solution, deploy it, and clearly explain the outcome.

What You Will Do

Depending on the assignment, you will:


Develop, maintain, and improve advanced data science and optimization solutions.
Build and enhance discrete optimization models, including Integer and Mixed Integer Programming models.
Productionize, deploy, monitor, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions in cloud environments.
Identify weaknesses in existing models and proactively implement improvements.
Build robust data preparation, aggregation, and feature engineering pipelines.
Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources.
Write clean, modular, tested, and maintainable Python code.
Implement MLOps and CI/CD practices for model deployment and lifecycle management.
Conduct exploratory and ad hoc analyses to support business decisions.
Present model outputs and analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Translate business requirements and stakeholder feedback into scalable technical solutions.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders.


Who are you?

We believe you have:


Several years of professional experience within data science, machine learning, optimization, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of discrete optimization, such as Integer Programming or Mixed Integer Programming.
Experience taking models beyond notebooks and operating them in a production environment.
Strong Python skills and experience building modular, production-ready software.
Strong SQL skills for data analysis, transformation, and data pipeline development.
Hands-on experience with MLOps, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and model monitoring.
Experience working with cloud-based data and machine learning platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.
A solid understanding of software architecture and maintainable codebases.
Experience building data wrangling and aggregation pipelines from diverse data sources.
The ability to understand business problems and turn them into analytical or technical solutions.
Strong communication skills and confidence presenting complex findings in a clear and actionable way.
A proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to take ownership in complex and sometimes ambiguous environments.
Experience working in Agile and cross-functional teams.


Nice to have

It is an advantage if you have experience with:


Optimization frameworks or solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or Pyomo.
GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, or Cloud Composer.
dbt or similar data transformation frameworks.
Containerization and orchestration using Docker or Kubernetes.
Experiment tracking, model registries, and automated model validation.
Data visualization and communicating analytical findings through dashboards or decision-support tools.
Additional areas such as forecasting, simulation, recommendation systems, or applied machine learning.


What’s in it for you?

At SwedQ, we want to understand what motivates you.

Some people value stability, a fixed salary, pension, and strong benefits. Others want greater flexibility, more responsibility, or the opportunity to share in the value they help create. We shape the setup together based on your ambitions and what makes sense for both sides.

You will be surrounded by technically skilled and entrepreneurial colleagues who are happy to share knowledge, challenge ideas, and learn from one another.

You will also have the opportunity to influence SwedQ, contribute to internal initiatives, and develop your own ideas alongside your client assignments.

SwedQ culture

SwedQ is built around independence, accountability, and creating genuine value.

We are a diverse group of consultants, engineers, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers with different backgrounds and perspectives. We support one another as colleagues and friends, while giving people the freedom to take ownership of their work.

We also make time to enjoy the journey together through dinners, activities, trips, competitions, and celebrations of both the big and small wins.

Perks & Benefits


Competitive compensation with different salary models available.
Occupational pension and additional pension contributions.
Private health insurance and private healthcare.
Wellness and gym allowance.
A generous professional development budget.
Time and support for personal development and open-source initiatives.
Company car or car allowance depending on your setup.
Benefits that can make everyday life easier, including home cleaning and childcare options.
A centrally located Stockholm office close to public transport and restaurants.
Daily breakfast at the SwedQ office.
Skilled colleagues and mentors who will both support and challenge you.


Does this sound like the kind of challenge you are looking for?

Let’s talk.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Data Vault

Title: Lead Data Scientist / Analytics Engineer to TxB Analytics in Nordea
Description:
Job ID: 5146

The banking industry is undergoing a period of dynamic change and Transaction Banking (TxB) – the Payments, Cards and Trade Solution area – is at the heart of the digital, instant and open revolution. We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist / Analytics Engineer with high stakeholder management skills to create actionable customer insights, identify new revenue opportunities, improve execution on strategies utilising data and further develop or analytical platform.

About Our Team

Welcome to the TxB Analytics team; the data science team that enables TxB and our customers to become more data driven. We add value by creating actionable customer insights to optimise existing business while at the same time exploring new revenue opportunities and improving efficiency. To be successful we need a tech savvy and analytical mind with great business understanding. We aim to be courageous and explorative in our approach which means you’ll have many opportunities to learn and grow as you build your career with us. Will you help us take the next step with our use of data?

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Work closely with our most important stakeholders, understand their needs, capture requirements and conduct workshops with them.
Functional leadership of the area software engineering and ML/AI to strengthen the team in the area.
Utilise data analytics to build analytics products so our stakeholders can make important strategic decisions, grow income, improve operational efficiency and develop Nordea’s product offering.
Identify business opportunities (e.g. sales leads, merchant intelligence opportunities, etc) utilising internal and external data.
Apply data science techniques such as statistical modelling, machine learning and Artificial Intelligence.
Be responsible for the development of our technical analytical platform to make it fit for purpose for Data Science.
Support and collaborate closely with other team members.


Who You Are

Your background and skills include:


You have experience working as a Data Scientist or similar where you have experiences with analytical and quantitative problem solving using advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods and AI.
You have a business consulting mindset and are proactive working with stakeholders to understand their needs and how analytics can help them.
You have good end-to-end software engineering skills.
You have deep knowledge in SQL and programming, e.g. Python.
Solid experience in Airflow, dbt and Snowflake (or similar tools).
You are familiar with Power BI (or similar business intelligence tools).
You have data/analytics engineering experience.
You are business minded, analytical and have excellent communication skills in English (both in text and spoken).
You are a social, curious and a pragmatic team player.
Experience in Requirements Management and workshop facilitation would an advantage.
Experience in Transaction Banking or Payments/Cards would be an advantage.
You have a MSc/BSc/BA degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, physics or related quantitative degree.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 07/08/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Mikael Simonsson at mikael.simonsson@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Only for candidates in Sweden: For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Only for candidates in Finland: A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position

Title: Data engineer
Description:
Vill du bidra till att lösa en av vår tids största samhällsutmaningar? Trivs du i en miljö som präglas av handlingskraft och samhällsengagemang?



Utbetalningsmyndigheten är en innovativ myndighet under utveckling. Genom att jobba hos oss får du vara med och forma en verksamhet som upptäcker, förhindrar och förebygger välfärdsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar från statliga myndigheter och kommuner. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får stort ansvar och mandat att påverka. Hos oss kommer ditt engagemang och din kompetens göra skillnad.



Ansvar och arbetsuppgifter



Inom Utbetalningsmyndighetenär arbete med data och analys centralt. Nu söker vi dig som vill utöka myndighetens förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys.



I rollen som data engineer kommer du att arbeta med utveckling av it-lösningar med fokus på datahantering, datalagring och dataanalys. Du kommer arbeta i ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam och samarbeta med olika roller såsom andra data engineers, systemutvecklare, data analytiker och DevOps engineers. I rollen är det huvudsakliga uppdraget att utveckla lösningar för datahantering med direkt verksamhetsvärde. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att förbättra och effektivisera våra utvecklingsmiljöer samt utforma interna standarder kring kod och livscykelhantering.



Rollen som data engineer är placerad på avdelningen data och utveckling.



Vi söker dig som har



• Akademisk utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant



• Minst tre års aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemutveckling i Python



• Minst tre års erfarenhet av att bygga och underhålla stabila data pipelines i olika miljöer



• Goda kunskaper i SQL och arbete med komplexa datamängder



• Erfarenhet av att arbeta med öppna källkodslösningar



• Vana av kodhantering i GIT och tillhörande arbetsflöden



• God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska



Det är meriterande om du även har



• Erfarenhet av Linux



• Erfarenhet av DevOps/MLOps



• Erfarenhet av arbete med on-premises system



• Erfarenhet av containerbaserade lösningar



Efterfrågade förmågor och färdigheter



För att trivas och lyckas i rollen har du en analytisk problemlösningsförmåga och god samarbetsförmåga. Vidare är du strukturerad,  initiativtagande och flexibel.



Den statliga värdegrunden sammanfattar och synliggör de viktigaste kraven som gäller för statsanställda, att arbeta i staten innebär att följa den. Vi ställer också höga krav på säkerhetsmedvetenhet.



Övrigt



Myndigheten är placerad i Stockholm i moderna lokaler i närheten av Gullmarsplan. Säkerhetsprövning kan bli aktuellt. Befattningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Sex månaders provanställning kan bli aktuellt.



På Utbetalningsmyndigheten ska alla medarbetare ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö och balans mellan jobb och fritid. Vi eftersträvar ett nära ledarskap och du som chef har ett rimligt antal medarbetare, administrativt stöd och möjlighet till kompetensutveckling. Vi erbjuder många förmåner för dig som anställd.



I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV. Istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev vill vi att du svarar på några frågor kring din kompetens kopplat till jobbet. Vi ber dig svara utförligt på dessa frågor. Läs mer om hur rekryteringsprocessen går till här. Arbetspsykologiska tester är en del av urvalsprocessen. Utbetalningsmyndigheten arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.



Är du intresserad?



Vill du veta mer om tjänsten, kontakta avdelningschef: Niclas Cederberg på telefon 010-572 7576. Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet, men tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.



Kontaktpersoner för de fackliga organisationerna är Anna Frängsmyr (Saco-S) 010-572 75 78 och Michael Ohlsson (ST) 010-5727512.

Title: Data Engineer

På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknologi, AI-drivna ansats, start-up-kultur och fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, ger vi dig förutsättningarna att nå din fulla potential och skapa värde för våra kunder. Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.

Om rollen

Som Data Engineer hos Sogeti blir du en del av vårt lokala team inom Data & AI. I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla, automatisera och vidareutveckla moderna datalösningar i Azure eller AWS. Du bygger robusta datapipelines, integrerar data från flera källor och skapar skalbara lösningar som gör data tillgängligt för analys, AI och verksamhetsnära beslut.

I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:


Utveckling av skalbara datapipelines och dataintegrationer.
Datatransformationer, ETL/ELT-flöden och automatisering i moderna molnplattformar.
Utveckling och förvaltning av robusta datalösningar för analys, AI och verksamhetsnära behov.
Användning av teknologier som Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory och AWS data services.

Flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna dataplattformar och molnbaserade datalösningar i Azure och/eller AWS.

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av SQL, Python, PySpark, ELT, GIT, CI/CD och utveckling av robusta datapipelines i moderna molnplattformar.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt god professionell kunskap i engelska.
Meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med Azure AI Search och Microsoft Foundry.

En kultur som präglas av närhet, samarbete och ett genuint kunskapsutbyte mellan kollegor

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Data Engineer




Build products with data, not just pipelines.




Most Data Engineering roles focus on moving data from A to B.

This one is about deciding what to build with it.




We're partnering with one of the Nordics' most exciting technology businesses as they continue investing heavily in their data platform, AI capabilities and engineering function. They're looking for a curious Data Engineer who enjoys solving problems with technology and wants to build complete solutions rather than spend every day maintaining ETL pipelines.




If you enjoy working across data engineering, software engineering and automation, this could be exactly the kind of challenge you're looking for.




The Opportunity:

The business has already built the foundations of a modern cloud-native data platform. Now they're entering the exciting phase.




Rather than focusing on collecting data, the team is building intelligent services, internal products and AI-enabled solutions that help the business make smarter decisions every day.




You'll work in a small, collaborative engineering team where ideas move quickly, ownership is encouraged and engineers are trusted to take solutions from concept through to production.




What you'll be doing:

Your work will span far more than traditional data engineering, including:

Designing scalable data models using SQL and dbt
Building Python services and automation tools
Developing REST APIs that expose trusted data
Creating integrations where off-the-shelf tools aren't enough
Improving data quality, testing and platform reliability
Building cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
Working closely with stakeholders to translate business problems into technical solutions
Helping shape the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tooling




The philosophy is simple:

Use technology to solve business problems.




Sometimes that's a data model.

Sometimes it's an API.

Sometimes it's a lightweight application.

Whatever delivers the greatest value.




What they're looking for:

You'll have strong experience in modern Data Engineering, including:

SQL
Python
dbt
Cloud data platforms
Modern data architecture and engineering best practices




You'll also ideally have experience building some combination of:

REST APIs
Backend services
Internal tooling
Automation solutions
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
Data integrations




Experience with Google Cloud is helpful but not essential. Engineers from Azure or AWS environments are equally encouraged to apply.




More important than the exact tech stack is your mindset. They're looking for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems and building whatever is needed to create value.




Tech Stack:

Python
SQL
dbt
BigQuery
Google Cloud Platform
Docker
Terraform
Airbyte




You don't need experience with every technology. Strong engineering principles and a willingness to learn are far more important.




Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a business at exactly the right stage.

The platform has been built.




Now the focus is on creating products that power self-service analytics, intelligent automation and AI across the organisation.




You'll work in a highly visible engineering team where your work has a genuine impact, collaborate directly with business stakeholders and have the autonomy to shape solutions rather than simply deliver tickets.




If you're the kind of engineer who enjoys ownership, variety and building things that matter, you'll thrive here.




Salary & Benefits

55,000–70,000 SEK per month
Hybrid working (Tuesday–Thursday in the Stockholm office)
Comprehensive benefits package
Permanent position




Interview Process

Hiring Manager conversation
Technical discussion and problem-solving case study (no live coding)
Final technical and cultural interview

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

What You’ll Do

We are building a next-generation steel plant - and data is a core part of how we operate, optimize, and scale. We believe the best data solutions are created close to the business, by teams who understand both the context and the technology. We are now looking for a Data Engineer to join our Digital Domain supporting Finance and HR.

Here’s what makes this role unique:


Breadth, not silos: You’ll work across multiple technical areas - data, architecture, infrastructure and backend - gaining deep understanding of our digital ecosystem.
Ownership from day one: You’ll support a specific domain and act as a bridge between operations and tech, and drive solutions all the way from need to implementation and iteration.
Close to the action: You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders, understand their workflows, and ensure your digital solutions create real value in their day-to-day operations.


Responsibilities:


Build and maintain the data pipelines that power Finance and HR - the numbers people actually rely on to make decisions.
Sit with stakeholders and analysts, understand what they need, and turn it into data models that make sense.
Make data easy to find, understand, and reuse.
Shape how the team works with data: better standards, better patterns, fewer headaches down the line.
Decide the trade-offs yourself - batch or near-real-time, how much history to keep, how metrics should be defined so people actually trust them.
Own data quality, documentation, and access - the unglamorous stuff that makes everything else work.
Try out AI-assisted tools where they genuinely help you build and test faster.
Share what you know - mentor teammates, raise the bar for the team.


What You’ll Bring

You enjoy solving real problems and are motivated by building data solutions that are actually used. You are curious about how data platforms should be designed - and how those designs need to evolve as technology and business needs change.

We believe you bring many of the following:


Hands-on experience building and maintaining data systems.
Strong SQL skills and a talent for turning messy data into clear, useful information.
Experience moving data from source systems through storage and processing to reports or other tools.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, automated infrastructure, testing, code reviews and deployment.
Good judgement when choosing technical solutions - you focus on what works, not on a particular brand or tool.
A collaborative approach and the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to colleagues in Finance, HR and other teams.


Nice to have:


Experience with, or interest in, industrial/operational (OT) data and how data from physical processes can be used for analytics and optimization


Benefits At Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

Read More About Benefits At Stegra Here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Stockholm Office

Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

Founded in 2020, Stegra (formerly H2 Green Steel) was created with the purpose to decarbonize hard-to-abate industry. Construction of our first project – an integrated plant producing green hydrogen, green iron and green steel – is well underway in Boden, Sweden. Slashing emissions using green hydrogen and renewable electricity, we’re starting a clean industrial revolution. Steel is just the beginning. Together, we focus on delivering green impact – for our people, customers, investors, society and planet.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.
A background in data roles within the financial sector.
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.


Our Offer To You


Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.

Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ.

We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.

Read more about how we handle your personal data here.

If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

Title: Product Manager, Data Insights
Description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You think like a product manager and work like a data scientist. You have shipped ML-powered products to real customers and can point to the decisions you made, not just the ones made around you. Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.

You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.

You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.

Purpose of role

The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.

The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.

The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and own the data driven product strategy


Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.



Build and validate before engineering commits


Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.



Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams


Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.



Govern the data responsibly


Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?



What You'll Bring

Must-have


Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.



Nice to have


Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Digital Sales Personal Banking
Description:
Job ID: 5575

Would you like to empower business to unlock the potential of data? We are growing our team in Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) Sweden. We are now looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can help us to utilise more data and insight to engage with customers in different interactions.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

In Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) we are a group of specialists in various fields: everything from digital marketing and content production to web analysis and data science. Collectively, we are responsible for engaging new and existing personal customers in digital channels and driving sales via online/mobile banking and nordea.se. We are building the omnichannel customer journey experience and for that we need to connect different data sources across our platforms and applications. Right product, right process, right message, right channel, at the right time for the right customer.

The role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a curious and driven Senior Data Scientist who will play a key role in implementing our omnichannel customer journey strategy. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with stakeholders in Personal Banking. In this role, you will enable Digital Sales to leverage data and analytics to enhance the customer experience. You will deliver insights and recommendations, drive automation through model-based solutions, simplify processes, and identify new data sources. Together with the team, you will develop advanced AI models to predict customer needs and behaviours in digital channels.

In addition you will be:


Analysing how our omnichannel business is developing including e.g. sales, activity performance, customer behaviour, pricing, process steps and demand
Designing and developing customer engagement activities: suggest target group, evaluate data availability, support utilizing sufficient control groups, monitor the outcome of activities, and evaluate the results
Participating actively in the work of digital customer journey teams, training and coaching the team to utilize data & analytics
Enabling data for analytics, reporting and marketing automation tool(s)
Recommending and performing analysis of different data sources to spot development trends and pain points
Together with a wider data analyst community and take part into building analytics & tools needed for business development


Who You Are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.

We are looking for someone passionate about data and analytics, with the ability to turn data into insights, ideas and opportunities that support strong customer experiences. You take ownership of the full data science lifecycle—from data gathering and engineering to modelling—while keeping a clear business focus.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are/have:


Interest in business and customer behaviour
Good at collaboration in practice - work closely with other Subject Matter Experts, involve stakeholders and always asking questions and investigating alternative solutions
Can drive tasks on your own but equally skilled in facilitating collaboration around tasks while maintaining the customer centric mindset
Innovative, openminded and excited about bringing your ideas to the table. You strive for continuous improvement and love learning and trying out new things. You're dependable, willing to speak up even when it's difficult, and committed to empowering others
A proactive, innovative and can-do oriented mind-set with the ability to convert new ideas into concrete actions, share “make it happen attitude”
A passion to share your knowledge and a ability to clearly communicate complex issues in an easy and understandable manner to a wide range of stakeholder


Your experience and background:


At least 3-5 years of experience in data analytics/data science
You are comfortable in using one or more data science programming language e.g. Python, R, SQL
You know your ways around tools like Hive, Snowflake, visualization tool such as Power BI
You understand the principles of working with an Agile development approach
Academic degree in highly quantitative discipline or specialisation such as Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Finance, and you have understanding of statistical concepts (e.g. Hypothesis Testing) and machine learning models
Proficient in written and spoken Swedish and English


What We Offer

By joining Nordea you can impact on the life of 11 million customers. Our team has an important role in helping to inspire and educate business teams on effectively utilizing data to drive informed decision-making. Joining the team will provide you with opportunities to use your experience with data management, data analysis and data engineering to support business developers, leaders, digital marketing specialists & other stakeholders.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Please submit your application no later 16/08/2026. Remember that we don´t accept applications via email. Interviews will be held continuously. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Sebastian Kovacs, Head of PeB analytics SE, +46 76-8239114, Sebastian.kovacs@nordea.se.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Du ser mönster i det komplexa, drivs av att hitta nya lösningar och är tillräckligt nyfiken för att ifrågasätta dina egna svar. Med några års relevant erfarenhet inom teknik, data, systemutveckling, analys eller integration kan du här ta nästa steg som Data Engineer. I rollen hjälper du etablerade företag att förstå, strukturera och använda sin data för att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan teknik, data, AI och affär på ett expansivt specialistbolag där du får utvecklas nära seniora kollegor, med möjlighet till delägarskap på sikt.




Om tjänsten:

Som Data Engineer hjälper du några av Sveriges mest datadrivna företag att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan data, teknik, AI och affär, där fokus ligger på att göra information tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar för verksamheten.




Vi söker dig som tidigare arbetat nära data, system eller informationsflöden och där du ställt dig frågan: "Hur kan den här datan användas på ett bättre sätt?"




Din arbetsgivare är ett specialistkonsultbolag inom Data Analytics, Data Engineering och AI. De hjälper sina kunder att bygga moderna dataplattformar, utveckla analysförmåga och skapa bättre beslutsunderlag med hjälp av data.




Bolaget är i stark tillväxt, har stabil lönsamhet och en tydlig plan framåt. De är fortfarande tillräckligt små för att varje person ska kunna påverka, men tillräckligt etablerade för att arbeta med stora och spännande kunder. Möjlighet till delägarskap finns.




Kulturen präglas av hög kompetens, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning. Här arbetar du nära seniora kollegor som är starka problemlösare och som gärna delar med sig av sin erfarenhet.




Arbetsuppgifter:

Du arbetar nära kunder för att förstå deras verksamhet, utmaningar och målbild. Rollen passar dig som är analytisk, kommunikativ och affärsmässig, och som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem med hjälp av modern teknik och AI-stödda arbetssätt. Uppdragen varierar i både omfattning och innehåll.




I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Kartlägga data, system och informationsflöden
Strukturera och konsolidera data från flera källor
Designa och vidareutveckla moderna dataplattformar
Arbeta med datamodellering och datapipelines
Integrera data mellan olika system
Använda AI-stödda arbetssätt och moderna verktyg
Översätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar




Vem vi söker:

Relevant civilingenjörsexamen, exempelvis inom datateknik, industriell ekonomi, teknisk fysik, systemvetenskap, matematik, maskinteknik, elektro eller liknande
Cirka 3–7 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet där du kommit i kontakt med data, system, integrationer, analys eller informationsflöden
Förmåga att förstå hur data kan användas som beslutsunderlag
God kommunikativ förmåga och trygghet i dialog med kunder eller andra intressenter
Nyfikenhet på AI, moderna utvecklingsverktyg och nya arbetssätt
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Som person söker vi dig med rätt grundförmågor: skärpa, nyfikenhet, konsultmässighet och förmåga att lära sig snabbt.

Du tycker om att möta kunder, förstå deras verklighet och hjälpa dem framåt. Du kan förklara komplexa saker på ett enkelt sätt och bygga förtroende i dialog med både tekniska och icke-tekniska personer.




Samtidigt gillar du problemlösning. Du är inte rädd för otydliga frågor, komplexa system eller data som inte är perfekt från början. Du tycker snarare att det är intressant att reda ut, strukturera och hitta vägen framåt.

Title: Data engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla vår centrala analys- och dataplattform? Vi etablerar Microsoft Fabric som kärnan i vår dataplattform och söker nu en data engineer som vill bidra till nästa steg i utvecklingen. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens, arbeta med modern teknik och skapa värde genom data. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!



Om avdelningen/enheten



Vi på verksamhetsstödet utvecklar kontinuerligt arbetssätt, processer och digitala stöd för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för universitetets utbildning och forskning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till denna utveckling och samtidigt utvecklas professionellt.



Teamet



Du kommer att ingå i ett mindre team där du har stor möjlighet att ta ansvar, komma med idéer och utveckla såväl den egna som verksamhetens kompetens. I teamet ingår data engineers, objektledning, kravanalytiker samt arkitekter. Du kommer därtill ha nära samarbete med verksamheten i planerings- och leveransarbetet. 



Arbetsuppgifter



KTH etablerar Microsoft Fabric som kärnan i sin dataplattform och söker nu Data Engineers som vill vara med och utveckla plattformen vidare.



Som Data Engineer hos oss är du med i ett tidigt skede och formar KTH:s centrala analys- och dataplattform i Microsoft Fabric. Du arbetar i en miljö där forskning, utbildning och samhällsnytta står i centrum, och du får stort ansvar och frihet att påverka samt bidra till den framtida utvecklingen.



I rollen kommer du att: 

Du kommer att vara med och forma, vidareutveckla och framtidssäkra KTH:s dataplattform i Microsoft Fabric tillsammans med teamet.
Du är med och utvecklar integrationer för att hämta in data från olika källor och lär dig hur man designar stabila och skalbara lösningar.
Tillsammans i teamet arbetar ni med att utforma vår Lakehouse-struktur enligt Medallion-arkitekturen och utveckla transformationer i PySpark.
Du bygger semantiska modeller och Power BI-rapporter och lär dig koppla ihop tekniska lösningar med verksamhetsbehov.
Du versionshanterar din kod i Git och lär dig hur CI/CD-flöden fungerar i Azure DevOps. 

 



Kvalifikationer



Krav

Relevant akademisk utbildning eller på annat sätt förvärvade motsvarande kunskaper som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdiga.
Data Engineering & kod: Grundläggande erfarenhet av Python och SQL.
Grundläggande kunskap om databaser, datamodellering och ETL/ELT-processer.
Erfarenhet, från utbildning eller annat, av att fånga upp och lyssna in verksamhetens behov - och förmågan att översätta dessa till tekniska lösningar.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift. 

Personliga egenskaper 



Tjänsten passar dig som är nyfiken och vill växa in i en viktig roll i en miljö där lärande är en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi söker dig som är kvalitetsmedveten och vill bidra till hållbara lösningar. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Vi ser även att du är strukturerad och självgående samt har förmåga att ändra fokus och prioritera om vid behov.



Meriterande

Kännedom om Microsoft Fabric, Azure eller annan data- och molnplattform.
Erfarenhet av datavisualisering, t.ex. Power BI eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att jobba med API:er.
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) och/eller Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
Kännedom om versionshantering med Git och ett intresse för ett strukturerat arbetssätt med verktyg som Azure DevOps eller liknande CI/CD-lösningar.

Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.



Bli en del av KTH  



KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.



Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.



Fackliga representanter



Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.



Ansökan



Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har ansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in och att de kvalifikationer vi efterfrågar i annonsen framgår i ditt CV.



I denna rekrytering söker du endast med ditt CV. I stället för ett personligt brev kommer du i rekryteringssystemet att få besvara en eller flera frågor. Det är viktigt att du besvarar frågorna noggrant och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din kompetens och erfarenhet. Vi baserar vårt urval på kvalifikationerna som framgår av annonsen.



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (CentralEuropean Time/Central European Summer Time).



Om anställningen 



Anställningen gäller tillsvidare enligt avtal.



Anställningen inleds med sex månaders provanställning.



Övrigt



För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.



Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.



Tester kan komma att tillämpas i denna rekryteringsprocess.



Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och förändra pensionsbranschen?

Är du en kreativ problemlösare med en passion för att strukturera och organisera information? Brinner du för att skapa affärsvärde utifrån data? Då är du den vi söker!

Om tjänsten🚀

Att effektivt använda data operationellt och för analys är centralt för att lyckas i SPPs kommande utveckling. I rollen som data engineer spelar du en avgörande roll i att effektivt skapa värde ur data genom att bygga vår nya dataplattform tillsammans med resten av teamet.

Förutsättningarna finns för att du ska kunna göra stor skillnad. Vi är i en förändringsfas där vi bygger nya tekniska lösningar samt förändrar kulturen kring hur data produceras och konsumeras. Du kommer vara med att sätta denna grund. Satsningen inom datadomänen samt förståelse för utmaningen är väl förankrad i SPPs ledningsgrupp.

Hos SPP Tech får du en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation och utveckling. Du kommer att vara en del av ett engagerat team och ha stora möjligheter att påverka och utvecklas i din roll. Du kommer rapportera till Head of Data och vara en del av ett team på totalt tio personer.

Vem är du?👋

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi du är nyfiken på att utforska nya tekniska lösningar och att utveckla nya arbetssätt tillsammans med andra. Du behöver kunna balansera utforskande av nya lösningar med att samtidigt skapa ordning och reda. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt där du bidrar till andras utveckling och gärna erfarenhet av att ta en tech/development lead roll. Vi tror du har:


Flera års erfarenhet av liknande roller, gärna att viss erfarenhet är inom bank- eller försäkringsbranschen.
Erfarenhet av dimensionsmodellering. Vår tech stack bygger på Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DLT och programmering i Python.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD och DevOps samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar inom data samt ersätta gammal ETL-kod med ELT.
Förmågan och drivet att agera på eget initiativ och få saker att hända.
God samarbetsförmåga.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


Varför välja SPP? 💚

SPP är en del av den nordiska finanskoncernen Storebrand. Tillsammans skapar vi en framtid att glädjas åt genom att vägleda till ekonomiska beslut som gynnar individen, samhället och planeten långsiktigt på ett enkelt sätt. Vi sitter i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation och erbjuder en hybrid arbetsvardag, med majoriteten av tiden på kontoret. På SPP värdesätter vi de perspektiv och erfarenheter som en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald bidrar med, och välkomnar därför sökande oavsett kön, bakgrund eller livserfarenhet.

Ansökan

Du är varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 23 augusti. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV, men i stället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig svara på några urvalsfrågor kopplat till tjänsten.

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen får du gärna höra av dig till Kim Wedenberg, Head of Data, kim.wedenberg@spp.se eller Clairy Zhao, Rekryteringsansvarig, clairy.zhao@spp.se.

Kontaktuppgifter till våra lokala fackförbund

Mattias Thunström, Finansförbundet, tel 070-864 41 11

Anna Peltovuori, Akademikerföreningen, tel 070-648 17 55

Med kandidatens samtycke görs en bakgrundskontroll under anställningsprocessens slutskede som innebär kontroll av personalia, ekonomiska förhållanden och juridiska frågor. Även CV och annan ansökningsdokumentation kan komma att verifieras.

Vem är du?👋

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi du är nyfiken på att utforska nya tekniska lösningar och att utveckla nya arbetssätt tillsammans med andra.   • Erfarenhet av dimensionsmodellering. Vår tech stack bygger på Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DLT och programmering i Python.
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD och DevOps samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
  • Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar inom data samt ersätta gammal ETL-kod med ELT.

  • God samarbetsförmåga.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.

SPP är en del av den nordiska finanskoncernen Storebrand. Tillsammans skapar vi en framtid att glädjas åt genom att vägleda till ekonomiska beslut som gynnar individen, samhället och planeten långsiktigt på ett enkelt sätt. Vi sitter i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation och erbjuder en hybrid arbetsvardag, med majoriteten av tiden på kontoret. På SPP värdesätter vi de perspektiv och erfarenheter som en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald bidrar med, och välkomnar därför sökande oavsett kön, bakgrund eller livserfarenhet.

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen får du gärna höra av dig till Kim Wedenberg, Head of Data, kim.wedenberg@spp.se eller Clairy Zhao, Rekryteringsansvarig, clairy.zhao@spp.se.

Mattias Thunström, Finansförbundet, tel 070-864 41 11

Anna Peltovuori, Akademikerföreningen, tel 070-648 17 55

Title: Data Analyst (Fixed Term Employment)
Description:
Job Description



WHAT YOU’LL DO​

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team for a fixed-term duration of 14 months, covering a parental leave. You’ll bring a solid technical foundation, problem-solving aptitude, and a passion for contributing to a collaborative team environment within sustainability topics. The primary focus is developing high-quality analyses that meet our Resource Use and Circularity sustainability needs and technological standards.



You will be contributing to the short- and long-term priorities aligned with the PI roadmap. Some of your responsibilities will include



Understanding the added value of product / team’s work. Following up OKRs through setting and following up KPIs.
Data discovery, building data products, testing and evaluating model outputs, in collaboration closely with other roles in the product / team, i.e. DE, Business Expert, etc.
Solving complex problems by turning vast amounts of data into business insights through advanced analytics and effectively communicating findings to a variety of stakeholders.
Framing the problem together with stakeholders, exploring large data sets, preparing data for own analysis.
Creating and maintaining documentation related to your work to ensure that stakeholders have the necessary information to understand the data & analysis of input/outputs.
Sharing knowledge in Communities of Practice, thereby enriching collective understanding and fostering a culture of continuous learning.



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​



You will be part of Tech Sustainability team in Corporate Tech Domain. You will work closely with the data analysts from all sustainability areas and the program manager and data engineer from your scope.







WHO YOU ARE​



We are looking for people with…​



Academic degree in Statistics, Engineering or related field.
Proficiency in Power BI as data visualization and reporting tool.
High proficiency in SQL.
Proven ability to independently lead data projects, maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, and design technical solutions that address complex business requirements.
Strong experience with data modelling, and different connectors for data solutions (Big Query, SharePoint).
Experience with Google Cloud environment, data quality and testing.

It is also preferred to have...



Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis, automation, and statistical modelling.
Experience working with sustainability data or CSRD legal reporting.
Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, dbt, or similar cloud-based data transformation frameworks.
Knowledge of data governance, data lineage, metadata management, and master data management practices.
Understanding of sustainability reporting standards and regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS).

And people who have…​



Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments.
A Proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to manage ambiguity and adapt quickly to change.
Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.
A collaborative approach, always looking for ways to enhance the product and the team’s ways of working.





WHO WE ARE​



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​



We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​



​All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound.
A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where your insights directly influence strategic decisions.
A collaborative culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.





JOIN US​



Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​



Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
In Hearing Care, we are enhancing how data science supports commercial and operational decision-making. As our Data Scientist, you will work close to the business, shape meaningful use cases and help move machine learning from idea to scalable, production-ready solutions.

Making data science matter in business

At Demant, our purpose is to improve people’s lives through hearing health. In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business use data and machine learning more effectively – not as an isolated technical exercise, but as a practical capability that supports better decisions and creates measurable value.

Turn business challenges into scalable machine learning solutions

You will join Commercial Excellence in a business-facing data science role. Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, you will learn how they work, understand their challenges and decision-making processes, and translate those needs into clear data science and machine learning cases.

You will manage the end-of-the-end data science lifecycle: exploring and preparing data, feature engineering, modelling, experimentation and evaluation. You will build, validate and continuously improve machine learning models, often in data environments that are imperfect, fragmented or still evolving.

A key part of the role is making sure solutions can live beyond the prototype. Together with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architecture, you will help move models into scalable production solutions and follow their performance over time, including model drift, retraining needs and continued business relevance.

The role gives you the opportunity to help shape how data science is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to shape ways of working, build closer collaboration between business and technology, and build solutions that are practical, governed and adopted in the organisation.

Bring technical depth and business curiosity

You are an experienced data scientist who enjoys getting close to business problems and finding a pragmatic path from data to value. To be effective in the role, we expect that you:



Have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematical Modelling, IT or a similar relevant field.
Bring 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modelling and predictive analytics.
Are comfortable across the model development lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, training, validation, production handover, monitoring and retraining.
Have solid Python and SQL skills and can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-development practices.
Can work with imperfect or fragmented data and identify what is needed to make a use case feasible.
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Are familiar with MLOps practices, CI/CD, model monitoring and production handover.
Have experience working with cloud-based data platforms; we use GCP.
Are fluent in English, as it is our company language.



Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interviews during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare group that offers solutions and services to help people with hearing loss connect and communicate with the world around them. The Demant Group operates in a global market with companies in more than 30 countries, employs more than 14,000 staff and generates annual revenue of DKK 14 billion. Demant is the parent company behind the commercial successes of such world-renowned brands as Oticon, Bernafon, Sonic, Audika, Oticon Medical, MAICO, Interacoustics, Amplivox, Grason-Stadler, MedRx and Sennheiser Communications.

The Group’s products are sold in more than 130 countries where we create life-changing differences through hearing health.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

A core value proposition of Trustpilot is Trust. We work hard to ensure that our platform has genuine content from real people with real experiences. That means eliminating fake reviews and acting on signs of suspicious behavior to protect our platform from fraudulent activity. Our Trust Applied AI team’s mission is to use advanced modeling to safeguard the integrity of online reviews, and we have several cross-functional teams devoted to Trust where Applied AI is integral to achieving our goals.

 

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Trust team. You and your team will work to develop, deploy, and maintain innovative models at scale, alongside a cross-functional team of software developers, product managers, ML engineers, and designers. You will have the opportunity to collaborate widely across the business with our Technology and Product teams. You will also work closely with stakeholders in Legal and Platform Integrity.

To succeed in this role, you should have proven experience in developing and deploying ML models, ideally using graph data. You need a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience in all stages of data preparation, exploration, and modeling. An adaptable mindset and understanding of the interface between Applied AI and engineering are essential as you will be working in cross-disciplinary teams. Experience with deploying solutions into production is expected, as you will be responsible for implementing end-to-end solutions—from data preprocessing to serving predictions.

 

What you will do:

Be hands-on in delivering the Applied AI / Data Science component of key strategic projects in Trust, from building and fine-tuning language models to sequence modeling, graph-based models, etc.
Develop, maintain, and deploy production-ready ML models, with tooling support from ML engineers
Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to the Trust roadmap
Seize the chance to meaningfully influence our business through the latest advancements in Applied AI and keep Trustpilot on the edge of innovation when it comes to fake review detection
The opportunity to work with market-standard data engineering and deployment technologies including Google Agent Platform tools and Google BigQuery, and with leading Data Science tools and emerging technologies for model building and deployment
Opportunities to develop your career in a friendly, diverse, international team and workplace

 

Who you are:

Experience with analytical and quantitative problem-solving using advanced statistical techniques and machine learning methods. Particularly relevant experience: high-precision classification focus, graph neural networks, graph algorithms used within machine learning, fine tuning of large language models, working with large label sets with varying label quality, and adversarial machine learning.
Experience in building and deploying production-ready ML models at scale, and solid data engineering skills, ideally in GCP
Ability in Python and SQL for data manipulation, modeling, and scripting
Experience in working with large datasets, ideally from tech platforms, e-commerce, or SaaS-type businesses. Knowledge of behavioral data, detecting misbehavior and/or fraud at scale is a big plus
Knowledge of data pipelining and prior experience with cloud-based ML model deployments
Great communication skills - both with technical colleagues and with business stakeholders 
2-3 years or more of technical experience in a Data Science role, preferably in the technology sector or in a technical consultancy

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops 






Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.
