Title: Lead AI Developer
Description:
Hos Envidan udvikler vi softwareløsninger, der gør en forskel for vandforsyning, spildevand og klimatilpasning. Nu tager vi næste skridt og integrerer AI direkte i vores produkter – og derfor søger vi en dygtig person, der kan lede den rejse.

Om rollen

Du bliver vores primære drivkraft på AI og dataanalyse. Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores softwareudviklere, produktteam, data arkitekt og rådgivere om at identificere, designe og implementere AI-funktionalitet, der skaber reel forskel for vores kunder i forsyningssektoren.

Du er ikke typen, der venter på at få opgaver stukket i hånden. Du opsøger aktivt nye muligheder – i dialog med kunder, kollegaer og potentielle eksterne partnere indenfor AI – og du forstår vigtigheden af at sætte AI i produktion på en ansvarlig og bæredygtig måde.

Det er en rolle med stor frihed og bred indflydelse – du er med fra idé til deployment og drift.

Dine ansvarsområder


Proaktivt opsøge og kvalificere relevante AI use cases i tæt dialog med kunder og resten af forretningen
Integrere LLM-baserede løsninger i vores eksisterende softwareplatform, fx intelligente søgefunktioner, automatiske opsummeringer og smarte assistenter til brugerne
Opbygge og forvalte en solid AI governance-ramme for løsninger, der sættes i produktion – herunder ansvarlig AI, datakvalitet og monitorering
Samarbejde tæt med vores data arkitekt om datamodeller, infrastruktur og arkitektur der understøtter AI-løsningerne
Udvikle og vedligeholde AI-pipelines og dataflows i et produktionsmiljø
Samarbejde med produktteamet om brugervenlig AI-integration der føles naturlig, ikke påklistret
Vurdere og implementere eksterne analysemoduler fra partnere, og sikre at de integreres på en ansvarlig og bæredygtig måde i vores platform
Bidrage til vores dataanalysekapacitet – herunder datavisualisering og simple forecast modeller, eksplorative analyser og sparringspartner.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse indenfor datalogi, software engineering, matematik/statistik eller data science, men har du den rette erfaring og et stærkt teknisk fundament, er din formelle baggrund dog ikke afgørende.

Du har 3–5 års erfaring inden for data science, ML‑engineering eller AI‑produktudvikling og har:


Solid erfaring med LLMs og generativ AI – herunder prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning eller API- integration (fx OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)
Praktisk erfaring med at integrere AI i eksisterende softwaresystemer og produktionsmiljøer og herunder gerne erfaring med softwareudvikling
Kendskab til eller erfaring med AI governance, ansvarlig AI og best practices for AI i produktion
Stærke Python-færdigheder og kendskab til relevante frameworks (LangChain, FastAPI, Pandas, m.fl.)
Erfaring med cloud (gerne Azure) og gerne erfaring med Infrastructure as Code; du er tryg ved at deployere og drifte løsninger i et cloud-miljø
Interesse for eller erfaring fra forsynings-, industri- eller infrastruktursektoren er et plus


Som person trives du i et miljø hvor du tænker både strategisk og skriver kode. Du er proaktiv og opsøgende af natur – du finder selv mulighederne og bringer dem i spil. Som ansvarlig for AI i Envidan Software, evner du at kommunikere tekniske løsninger klart til både kunder og ikke-tekniske kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?


En nøglerolle i et team på 28 engagerede kollegaer, hvor vi er i gang med at re-designe vores eksisterende applikationer – og nu også integrere AI som centralt element
En arbejdskultur præget af samarbejde, tillid og faglig sparring – vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, både i dagligdagen og gennem fælles learning sessions
Tæt samarbejde med erfarne softwareudviklere og direkte adgang til produktbeslutninger
Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på produkter, der bruges i kritisk infrastruktur


Vi har interesse i hinanden og vægter et godt socialt miljø højt – udlevet gennem teamarrangementer, faglige klubber og en aktiv personaleforening på tværs af hele organisationen



Stillingen er fuldtid. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår når mennesker mødes – og vi lægger vægt på at skabe en stærk sammenhængskraft i teamet. Derfor ser vi gerne, at du er på kontoret i Silkeborg 2–3 dage om ugen. De resterende dage er der fuld fleksibilitet til at arbejde hjemmefra.

Har du spørgsmål til rollen er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef Thorben Føns på +45 4117 7627 eller thf@envidan.dk. Henvendelser fra rekrutteringsbureauer frabedes.

Ansøgning

Vil du med ombord, så send din ansøgning snarest muligt. Vi behandler ansøgninger fortroligt og løbende, og vi lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Om os

Envidan er Nordens ledende vand- og spildevandsspecialist med tre selvstændige forretningsområder: rådgivning, entreprise og software.

Vi hjælper forsyninger, kommuner og industri inden for vandets kredsløb. Og uanset om vi rådgiver om klimatilpasning, leverer færdige anlæg eller udvikler innovative softwareløsninger, er vandfaglighed og digital tænkning altid omdrejningspunktet.

Fra vores kontorer i Norge, Sverige og Danmark bidrager +500 medarbejdere til at løse nogle af vandsektorens største udfordringer: Bæredygtig vandhåndtering, klimatilpasning og sikring af rent drikkevand.

På den måde er vores forretning født med et bæredygtigt DNA. Men vores ambitioner rækker videre. Via vores stærke, tekniske faglighed kan vi anvise praktiske, bæredygtige løsninger på vores kunders konkrete problemer.

Envidan – en del af Rambøll

Hos Envidan bliver du en del af Nordens stærkeste hold af specialister inden for vandets kredsløb. I partnerskab med forsyninger, kommuner og industrier yder vi rådgivning, leverer anlæg og skaber software. Disse tre forretningsområder samlet gør os stærkere, fordi vores kunder får bedre software af en leverandør, der forstår sektoren. Og bedre rådgivning af en leverandør, der også forstår at bygge anlæg.

Du får sektorens skarpeste hoveder som kolleger. Det kan vi tilbyde, fordi vi hvert år allokerer 20 procent af vores overskud i forskning og udvikling.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Trifork Digital Health
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Hos Trifork designer, bygger og driver vi digitale løsninger til både den offentlige sundhedssektor og private medtech-virksomheder. Vores mål er at udvikle teknologi, der styrker både arbejdsgange og den enkelte patient og brugers møde med sundhedsvæsenet og sundhedsløsninger.

Vi søger nu 1-2 erfarne data scientists med stærkt forretningsfokus til vores Digital Health division i København. Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team og får mulighed for at omsætte kunstig intelligens til praktiske, værdiskabende løsninger.

Om rollen

Som senior data scientist hos Trifork Digital Health kræver arbejdet lige dele teknisk ekspertise og forståelse for kundens forretning. Vores projekter spænder bredt – fra samfundskritisk sundheds-infrastruktur til innovativ og teknisk avanceret software inden for medtech. Fælles for dem er, at kvalitet, sikkerhed og driftsstabilitet er afgørende.

Vi arbejder med hele paletten af moderne AI – fra klassisk machine learning og prædiktive modeller til generativ og agentic AI – og anvender det både til at automatisere og løfte interne arbejdsgange og i kundevendte produkter og løsninger.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med vores kunder – også fysisk. Du skal derfor trives med at være en synlig og nærværende del af kundens hverdag.

Du Kommer Til At


Tage end-to-end ansvar for data science- og AI-løsninger – fra behovsafklaring og løsningsdesign til implementering og drift
Anvende avancerede machine learning- og AI-teknikker til at løse komplekse forretningsproblemer for vores kunder
Designe og bygge robuste, skalerbare ML-løsninger og MLOps-pipelines, der kan sættes i produktion og vedligeholdes
Evaluere modeller og løsninger systematisk – det er mindst lige så vigtigt, at du kan forstå, hvordan og hvorfor et system fejler, og hvordan man undersøger det, som hvordan man bygger det
Arbejde med følsomme sundhedsdata under høje krav til sikkerhed, dokumentation og compliance – og sikre ansvarlig anvendelse af AI gennem solid AI governance
Samarbejde tæt med kunder, sundhedsfaglige eksperter og kolleger – og formidle resultater, muligheder og begrænsninger klart til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske modtagere
Bidrage til den strategiske retning for vores data science- og AI-initiativer, spotte nye muligheder og være med til at forme best practices
Dele din viden og være faglig sparringspartner for mindre erfarne kolleger


Vi søger dig, der har

Erfaring og baggrund


En kandidatgrad i data science, cognitive science, statistik, datalogi, matematik, fysik, ingeniørvidenskab eller lignende
Solid praktisk erfaring med data science og machine learning – gerne minimum 5 år
Erfaring fra sundhedssektoren, pharma eller medtech – eller stor interesse for området
Erfaring som konsulent eller med at arbejde tæt sammen med kunder
Erfaring med at sætte modeller i produktion – herunder MLOps og cloud-platforme
Erfaring med Docker/Kubernetes
Erfaring med LLM'er, generativ AI og gerne agentic AI
Forståelse for AI governance – herunder ansvarlig og etisk anvendelse af AI/ML-modeller i praksis


Personlige egenskaber


Er nysgerrig og løsningsorienteret
Trives med at arbejde tæt på kunden og tager gerne ansvar for både den faglige løsning og samarbejdet omkring den
Har blik for, at den bedste løsning ikke altid er den mest avancerede – men den, der skaber værdi for kunden
Kan formidle komplekse analyser, så de skaber et klart beslutningsgrundlag
Har styr på din AI-værktøjskasse og bruger den som en naturlig del af din egen arbejdsproces


Sprog


Flydende dansk og engelsk, mundtligt og skriftligt


Værktøjskassen


Python og det moderne ML-økosystem (fx scikit-learn, PyTorch)
LLM'er og frameworks til generativ og agentic AI
MLOps og cloud-platforme (Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud)
SQL og datamodellering
Docker


Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Vores hverdag er præget af en åben og ærlig atmosfære. Vi lægger vægt på at skabe et udfordrende, men også sjovt, arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder i agile og tværfaglige teams med fokus på at hjælpe hinanden, og vi samarbejder tæt med vores kunder for at forstå deres behov og udfordringer. Trifork ligger i top 10 på Ingeniørens IT-Profilanalyse 2025 – en landsdækkende undersøgelse af Danmarks mest attraktive arbejdspladser for it-professionelle.

Vi tilbyder gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling gennem projekter, interne tech-møder, Trifork Hackerdays, konferencer, sociale arrangementer og vores årlige teamtur.

Udover Dette Får Du


Et åbent og uformelt arbejdsmiljø
Mulighed for at tage initiativ
Frokostordning
Frisklavet italiensk kaffe
Kontor med nem adgang til offentlig transport

Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vil du udvikle og lede leverancen af avancerede AI- og machine learning-løsninger, der bliver sat i produktion og skaber reel værdi hos kunden?




Vi søger en hands-on Senior Data Scientist med erfaring fra konsulentbranchen. Du har stærk teknisk dybde inden for machine learning, generativ AI eller begge områder og kan tage ansvar for komplekse tekniske leverancer hos kunden.




Du samarbejder direkte med kunden, afklarer tekniske behov og skaber fremdrift i leverancen. Det afgørende er, at du både kan bygge løsningerne selv, sætte teknisk retning og løfte kvaliteten omkring dig.




Du bliver en del af et større fagligt miljø i vores AI, Apps & Automation-capability. Her arbejder du tæt sammen med data scientists samt software- og automationsspecialister og samarbejder på tværs af capabilities med data engineers, arkitekter, forretningskonsulenter m.fl.




Om rollen

Som Senior Data Scientist leder du det tekniske arbejde og er samtidig selv en aktiv del af udførelsen. Du arbejder hands-on med kode, modeller, eksperimenter, løsningsdesign og produktionsmodning.

Du tager ansvar for de svære tekniske valg og hjælper teamet med at fastholde kvalitet og fremdrift.




Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Lede tekniske AI- og machine learning-projekter fra problemforståelse til produktionsklar løsning
Omsætte uklare forretningsbehov til konkrete tekniske problemstillinger og løsningsdesign
Sætte teknisk retning og træffe valg om modeller, metoder, arkitektur og platforme
Drive tekniske afklaringer med relevante stakeholders hos kunden
Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknisk kvalitet, anvendelighed, governance og forretningsværdi
Bidrage til scoping, estimering og kvalificering af nye kundeopgaver
Mentorere kolleger og udvikle genanvendelige metoder, komponenter og accelerators




Afhængigt af din specialisering kan du eksempelvis arbejde med forecasting, optimering, recommendation engines og MLOps eller med RAG, dokumentintelligens, copilots, agentic AI og intelligente workflows.




Sådan skaber du succes i rollen

Du omsætter komplekse AI- og machine learning-problemstillinger til løsninger med tydelig forretningsværdi
Du skaber struktur og fremdrift, også når rammerne eller løsningen ikke er givet på forhånd
Du bygger løsninger, der kan implementeres, anvendes, monitoreres og videreudvikles
Du skaber tillid gennem faglig tyngde, tydelig kommunikation og kvalificerede tekniske anbefalinger
Du løfter kvaliteten omkring dig gennem sparring, mentoring og genanvendelige metoder




Din profil

Konsulenterfaring er et krav.

Du har erfaring fra et konsulenthus, hvor du har arbejdet direkte med kunder og taget ansvar for komplekse data science-, machine learning- eller AI-leverancer.




Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

Har haft en ledende teknisk rolle eller taget tydeligt ansvar i komplekse kundeprojekter
Har udviklet og implementeret produktionsorienterede løsninger inden for machine learning og/eller generativ AI
Har stærke kompetencer i Python, kan arbejde sikkert med SQL og har forståelse for moderne software engineering
Har erfaring med Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric eller tilsvarende cloudplatforme
Forstår deployment, test, CI/CD, monitorering, governance og driftsoverdragelse
Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger og kommunikere valg, risici og trade-offs til kunden
Har erfaring med at sparre med kolleger og gerne bidraget til scoping, estimering eller genanvendelige løsninger




Du behøver ikke være ekspert i både machine learning og generativ AI. Det afgørende er, at du har dokumenteret dybde inden for mindst ét område og kan samarbejde troværdigt med andre specialister om den samlede løsning.




Det tilbyder vi

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:

Ansvar for komplekse AI- og machine learning-leverancer med synlig kundeværdi
Mulighed for at sætte teknisk retning og påvirke, hvordan vi udvikler vores AI-løsninger
Et stærkt fagligt miljø på tværs af data science, software, automation og Data Platform
Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og videre specialisering
Fleksible arbejdsforhold og mulighed for hybridarbejde
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork




Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Lystrup ved Aarhus eller Kgs. Lyngby. Arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret, kunderne og hjemmearbejdspladsen.




Rejseaktivitet

Som konsulent må du forvente en vis rejseaktivitet. Omfanget afhænger af projekterne og planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.




Ansøg

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Forventet opstart er den 1. oktober 2026.




Har du spørgsmål til rollen eller processen, kan du kontakte Talent Acquisition Director Steffen Krogsgaard på krog@inspari.dk.

Title: Product Manager, Data Insights
Description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You think like a product manager and work like a data scientist. You have shipped ML-powered products to real customers and can point to the decisions you made, not just the ones made around you. Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.

You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.

You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.

Purpose of role

The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.

The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.

The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and own the data driven product strategy


Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.



Build and validate before engineering commits


Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.



Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams


Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.



Govern the data responsibly


Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?



What You'll Bring

Must-have


Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.



Nice to have


Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.

The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and own the data driven product strategy

  • Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
  • Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
  • Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
  • Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
  • Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
  • Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.


Build and validate before engineering commits

  • Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
  • Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
  • Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
  • Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.


Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
  • Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
  • Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
  • Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.


Govern the data responsibly

  • Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
  • Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
  • Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?


What You'll Bring

Must-have

  • Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
  • Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
  • PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
  • Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
  • Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
  • Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.


Nice to have

  • Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
  • Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
  • Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
  • Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
  • Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
  • Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.

Title: Principal Data Scientist
Place: Ballerup Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Location - Ballerup

Your new department

The Principal Data Scientist in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms to process and analyse structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. You will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our three areas; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.

Your Key Responsibilities Include


Define Data Science Strategy
Develop and influence the organization's data science vision and roadmap.
Collaborate with senior leaders and executives to align AI/ML initiatives with business priorities.
Help determine where data science can create the greatest strategic value.
Lead Innovation and Advanced Analytics
Design and champion innovative AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.
Solve highly complex business problems through advanced statistical and computational methods.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and methodologies.
Serve as a Technical Authority
Act as the organization’s subject matter expert for data science.
Establish best practices, standards, and frameworks for model development and deployment.
Provide expert guidance on methodologies, tools, and architectural decisions.
Shape Business Decisions
Translate business opportunities and challenges into data-driven strategies.
Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
Influence investment decisions and enterprise-wide initiatives using evidence-based approaches.
Mentor and Develop Talent
Coach senior data scientists and technical leaders.
Build organizational capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and establishing communities of practice.
Help develop future leaders in data science.
Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work across business functions, technology, engineering, analytics, product, compliance, and external partners.
Lead large-scale initiatives that span multiple teams and organizational boundaries.
Represent the IT Organization across the Stakeholders’ communities
Bring stakeholders together on the DS strategy and vision
Build external networks and stay at the forefront of AI and data science advancements.
Position the Enterprise AI org. as a leader in data-driven innovation.

Skills & Qualifications.


Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. Ph.D. is preferred.
A proven track record of innovation and thought leadership.
Minimum 10 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI, with a focus on developing and applying advanced algorithms.
Deep expertise in cutting-edge data science methodologies and technologies
Strong research capabilities and the ability to translate research into business value
Experience developing enterprise-scale data strategies and AI roadmaps.
Ability to provide visionary leadership for the data science function
Broad understanding of pharma industry and Commercial business processes
Strong awareness of ethical and responsible AI practices

In-depth knowledge of machine learning concepts, data modeling techniques and AI solution design.
Experience working with cross-functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations).

In‑depth understanding and practical experience with architecture, implementation, DevOps and support for AI solutions.
Experience working with cross‑functional teams (data engineering, ML engineering, analytics, product, operations) and external vendors.
Experience in pharmaceutical or regulated industries is beneficial but not mandatory.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Sønderborg, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to work for a company with solutions that contributes to Saab’s mission of keeping people and society safe?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the Future of Digital Engineering and building the Future of Engineering?

Engineering is evolving rapidly. Model Based Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, connected engineering data, and digital collaboration are transforming how complex systems are designed and delivered.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build the data foundation that enables modern engineering. You will connect engineering data, improve digital workflows, and prepare the organization for AI enabled engineering.

Your role

You will:


Develop data pipelines and system integrations across engineering tools
Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability
Support Digital Thread and MBSE initiatives
Prepare engineering data for AI and advanced analytics
Design scalable data models and dashboards
Identify opportunities to automate engineering processes
Collaborate with engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver practical solutions



Your Profile

You have experience in one or more of the following areas:


Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Systems Engineering
Data Science
Computer Science
Information Technology



Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, cloud platforms, Power BI, graph databases, engineering lifecycle tools, or AI technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

More important than your exact background is your ability to solve complex problems, connect information, and turn data into business value.

We Are Looking For Someone Who


Thinks analytically and works in a structured way
Enjoys collaborating across technical disciplines
Is curious about new technologies and continuous improvement
Can translate engineering challenges into digital solutions
Takes ownership and delivers pragmatic results



Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, data, and emerging technologies.

Your work will help accelerate Digital Engineering, strengthen MBSE adoption, improve engineering efficiency, and establish the foundation for future AI capabilities.

If you want to build solutions that will influence how engineering is performed in the years ahead, we would like to hear from you.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and you will therefore experience a company that is dynamic and able to adapt. In the Saab group we have a saying” Business is done between people”, and this is also the environment you can expect here. We offer:


Initial learning process with mentorship and support
Good career and development opportunities in a professional company
A vibrant and international atmosphere with colleagues from all over the world
Benefits that support our employees’ wellbeing
A variety of social activities, lunch scheme, pension as well as flexible work conditions
Focus on our teams, good cooperation and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.



Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

Title: Data Analytics Lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Please note: This is a full-time office-based role (5 days/week).




About the Role

As a Platform Data Analyst, you will own analytical workstreams end-to-end — from scoping and data modelling through to communicating findings and driving stakeholder action. You will work with large, complex datasets spanning customer orders, supplier transactions, asset utilisation, and operational data, contributing to KPI frameworks, experiment design, and AI/ML use case development — using AI tools where they genuinely accelerate work, not as a default. This is an individual contributor role: your impact comes from analytical craft, clarity of thinking, and your ability to influence decisions through insight rather than through line management or product ownership. You will sit close to platform product and engineering teams, but your remit is analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Insight

Identify and quantify opportunities in platform data; translate findings into clear recommendations for product and business teams.
Design and maintain decision-oriented KPI frameworks accessible to front-line teams and senior management alike.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on product adoption, user behaviour, performance trends, and business impact — and design experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, significance testing) to test hypotheses that emerge.
Support benefit estimation and validation for platform product initiatives.

Data Craft & Self-Sufficiency

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, transform, and model data from multiple source systems.
Build reusable analytical datasets that support recurring analysis and reporting — working independently or alongside data engineering colleagues as needed.
Work within our Azure/Databricks cloud infrastructure, treating analytical datasets as data products: clear ownership, documented SLAs, versioning, and a feedback loop with end users.
Proactively identify data quality issues and work with upstream teams to resolve them.

Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery

Partner with product owners, Business users, and engineering teams to translate analytical needs into well-defined workstreams and communicate findings through data storytelling that connects insight to business priorities and drives action.
Own your analytical backlog — prioritise, set realistic expectations, and manage delivery independently.
Flag potential bias, fairness issues, or unintended consequences in analytical outputs and model inputs before they reach decisions.

AI/ML & GenAI

Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks that enable AI/ML model development.
Use tools like Copilot (code completion) and Claude or ChatGPT (summarisation, documentation, data exploration) to accelerate analytical tasks — anchored to specific, validated workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure analytical outputs meet model input requirements (schema, distribution, data quality).

Skills & Experience

Education

Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3–6 years in business analytics or data analysis, ideally in a complex, large-scale data environment.
Proven track record delivering end-to-end analytical projects — from scoping through to stakeholder action.
Experience working in or alongside product or platform teams.
Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, LLM-based analysis, prompt engineering) as part of analytical or engineering workflows is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL proficiency for extraction, transformation, and modelling across large datasets.
Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation (pandas, numpy, and similar libraries).
Azure and Databricks experience; familiarity with data pipeline development, data modelling concepts, and data quality best practices.
Power BI or equivalent, with the ability to build clear, decision-oriented dashboards.
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and how analytical pipelines feed into model development; practical use of AI coding tools (Copilot) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for analytical tasks — with the judgement to validate outputs and know their limits.

Behaviours & Mindset

Proactive and self-directed — you identify problems before being asked and take ownership.
Structured problem-solver — you break ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical tasks and communicate findings to diverse audiences without losing rigour.
Collaborative and stakeholder-savvy — you understand that great analytics only creates value when trusted and acted upon, and balance high standards with pragmatism about what fits the decision at hand.
AI-critical — you use GenAI tools effectively but validate outputs, flag governance concerns, and apply your own judgement before acting on recommendations.

Are you passionate about solving complex challenges with real-world impact using state-of-the-art models and algorithms? We are seeking a Data Science Manager to join our team. In this high-impact role you will lead a team of data scientists and engineers to architect, deploy and operationalize advanced algorithms and machine learning models that drive our state-of-the-art route planning capability. You will guide your team to deliver accurate, scalable and efficient solutions for thousands of drivers every day. As our Data Science Manager, you will shape how the function grows, and have a truly outsized impact on our product and the value we bring to our customers.

What You'll Be Doing


Lead and manage a team of Data Scientists and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, scientific rigor, and operational excellence
Define the data science roadmap, and help decide where the team can create the most value for the product and our customers
Dive deep into the work as a player-coach to guide hard technical calls and unblock the team
Drive architecture decisions including model selection, feature engineering from product catalogs, and evaluation metric frameworks
Translate ambiguous customer problems into well-scoped data science and ML workstreams
Establish and monitor classification metrics, model performance KPIs, and production health dashboards to ensure continuous improvement
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical customers, stakeholders and leadership
Mentor and develop team members through career coaching, technical guidance, and structured growth plans
Drive operational rigor ensuring zero-disruption deployments, data quality standards, and robust experimentation practices


ABOUT YOU


A Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field
8+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, with 3+ years in a people management role
Proven track record of leading, mentoring and managing other data scientists and/or engineers
Knowledge of Computer Science and Machine Learning fundamentals, including training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques. You have a large tool-box
Practical skill and experience applying your knowledge to messy, real-world problems
Comfort switching between hands-on technical work and people leadership
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Genuine curiosity about customers and product
Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL, and preferably familiarity with airflow, docker, duckdb, dbt, spark, mlflow.

After 6 months at Mover Systems you have launched a new data product.

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality. Technical colleagues are not kept at arm's length from customers - you will talk to them directly, and use what you learn to decide what to build next.

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

Title: Research Informatics Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Build the digital foundation for scientific discovery

Every day, researchers rely on digital technologies to design experiments, generate data, and make scientific decisions.

We are looking for a Research Informatics Engineer who enjoys combining scientific understanding with technical expertise to build practical digital solutions that help researchers make better use of their data.

Your new role

At Lundbeck, Research Informatics works at the intersection of science, data and technology. We collaborate closely with researchers, colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT, and technology partners to implement, integrate and continuously improve the scientific systems, research data and digital workflows that support modern drug discovery.

As research becomes increasingly digital and data-driven, our role is to ensure that scientific systems evolve with the science, research data becomes a trusted asset, and digital technologies create real value for researchers.

You will join the Research Informatics team within Global Research. Working closely with researchers, colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT and technology vendors, you will help implement, configure and improve the digital platforms used across Research. You will contribute to scientific applications, research data and digital workflows that enable researchers to work more efficiently and make better use of their data.

This is a hands-on role where you will combine scientific understanding with technical skills to deliver practical digital solutions that support discovery research.

What you will do:

Support scientific applications


Work with researchers to gather, analyse and document business and scientific requirements for new digital capabilities.
Implement, configure and maintain scientific applications supporting Global Research.
Work with researchers to understand scientific workflows and translate research needs into practical digital solutions.
Support application lifecycle management, testing, documentation and user support.
Collaborate with colleagues across Lundbeck Global IT (EDE) and technology vendors to continuously improve the scientific application landscape.



Connect research data


Contribute to connecting research data across the digital research landscape.
Implement and support data flows, metadata models and integrations between scientific applications.
Apply FAIR data principles to improve the quality, accessibility and reuse of research data.
Help establish trusted research data that supports today's science and tomorrow's advanced analytics and AI.



Improve digital research


Identify opportunities to improve scientific workflows through better digital solutions.
Participate in implementation of new technologies and enhancements to existing platforms.
Contribute to testing, training and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate across Research, Lundbeck Global IT (EDE) and external partners to continuously improve the digital research environment.



Your future team

Research Informatics is a collaborative team with expertise spanning life sciences, laboratory informatics, research data management and digital technologies.

Together we build and continuously improve the scientific systems, research data and digital workflows that underpin discovery research. We combine scientific understanding with technical expertise to ensure our digital capabilities evolve alongside the science they support.

The position is based at Lundbeck Headquarters in Valby.

What You Bring To The Team

You are curious about science and motivated by solving practical problems through technology. You enjoy understanding how research is performed and using that understanding to build better systems, better research data and better digital workflows.

Required Qualifications


MSc in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Computer Science or another relevant scientific discipline.
Strong understanding of scientific research workflows.
Experience from pharmaceutical, biotechnology or academic research.



You Have Experience With Several Of The Following

You have experience working with scientific systems, research data and digital workflows and enjoy translating scientific needs into practical technical solutions. Experience with requirements gathering and using modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, including large language models (LLMs) for coding and technical problem solving, is an advantage.


Business and scientific requirements gathering
Using large language models (LLMs) and AI-assisted development tools to support coding, scripting and technical problem solving
FAIR data principles and research data management
Metadata and scientific data models
Scientific applications and laboratory informatics
Configuration of commercial scientific software
Systems integration and APIs
Python or other scripting languages
SQL, relational databases and modern data platforms
Cloud-based scientific platforms



Experience with in vivo research and biologics, including antibody discovery, is an advantage.

Personal qualities


Enjoys solving problems in collaboration with others.
Is curious and eager to learn.
Takes a structured approach to your work.
Communicates effectively with both scientific and technical colleagues.
Enjoys working across scientific and technical disciplines.



Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

Annual base salary range: (582 000 - 799 700) DKK gross

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

Apply now

Upload your CV and include a few lines about your motivation for applying. We ask you not to include a photo or personal information that does not relate to your professional experience.

Title: Scientific Software Developer — Data Reduction Team
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Scientific Software Developer — Data Reduction Team




The European Spallation Source (ESS) is building the world’s most powerful neutron source, enabling research in materials science, energy, health, and the environment. ESS is expanding the Data Reduction Team at the Data Management and Scientific Computing Centre (DMSC), located just north of Copenhagen in Denmark. We are seeking outstanding candidates for one scientific software developer position.




About the team




We are six developers responsible for the software that turns raw detector data into scientifically usable datasets. This process, known as data reduction, produces structured datasets for downstream analysis software. We develop Scipp (scipp.github.io) and related libraries, working primarily in Python. With ten new ESS instruments coming online next year, our software will play an important role in supporting their scientific commissioning and operations. As a small team, we work on problems that are both technically challenging and central to the success of the facility.




About the role




The work spans library development, scientific workflow design, performance engineering, and user interfaces. You will work closely with neutron scientists, distil requirements from them, determine what belongs in the core library versus a downstream package, and frequently decide what not to build. There is room to specialize over time, but in your first year you should expect to touch various parts of the codebase.




Our team uses AI coding tools heavily but tries to be smart about it. To us, using AI is about amplifying human thought, not outsourcing it. We see these tools as aids for exploration, iteration, and productivity — not replacements for engineering judgement.




About you




We care more about how you think than which tools you have used. We do not have a fixed technology checklist. What matters:




You have shipped software that real users depend on.
You think critically about code quality and welcome constructive discussion and alternative ideas
You can engage with scientific problems on their own terms — a physics background is welcome but not required.
You can take ownership of an area, work with scientists to gather requirements, and make decisions with incomplete information.
You are comfortable working in English in an international team.




Experience with the scientific Python ecosystem, performance engineering, or work at neutron/photon sources is beneficial but not required. Familiarity with technologies and practices such as Jupyter, C++, CI/CD, integration testing, or systems architecture would also be valuable.




What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.




You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.




Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.




This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.




Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living-working-scandinavia.

For further information




For information about the position, contact the Group Leader for Research Software Engineering (RSE), Fredrik Bolmsten, at fredrik.bolmsten@ess.eu




For recruitment-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.




How to apply

Please submit your application, with cover letter and CV, no later than 26 August 2026.

As part of your cover letter, please pick one of these two questions and answer it in your application:




Tell us about a technical decision you made that you would make differently today, and what changed your mind.
Tell us about a piece of software you admire, not because of what it does, but because of how it is built, and what you learned from looking at it closely.




We’re genuinely interested in your response; it helps us understand your technical judgement and curiosity.




We look forward to receiving your application.

At Stibo Systems, we are accelerating our AI journey and looking for an AI Solutions Engineer who can help transform business opportunities into scalable solutions that create measurable value.
 

You will join our Data & Digitalization team and become part of a group of specialists working across data, analytics, integrations, applications, enterprise architecture, governance and business enablement. Together, we are responsible for delivering on Stibo Systems' Data Strategy and helping the organization unlock value from data, technology and AI in close collaboration with our AI Centre of Excellence and Process Excellence. Supported by senior leadership and working closely with our AI Centre of Excellence and Process Excellence capability, you will play a key role in advancing Stibo Systems' Data and AI ambitions.
 
The role
In this new role as our AI Solutions Engineer, you will work closely with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and create measurable business value.

Working alongside Process Excellence, Data & Digitalization, and the AI Centre of Excellence, you will translate business challenges into practical solutions ranging from AI agents and automations to workflow improvements and enhanced access to information.

Your success will be measured by the value your solutions create and the adoption they achieve.
 
What you'll do
  • Analyze business processes and uncover opportunities to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions, automations, and agents.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, engineers, and integration specialists to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Move initiatives from experimentation to operational use and measurable impact.
  • Establish reusable AI patterns and best practices across the organization.
  • Contribute to the continued development of Stibo Systems’ AI capabilities and ways of working.
  • Ensure solutions align with governance, security, and responsible AI principles.
     


The Team
You will join our Data & Digitalization team based primarily in Aarhus, working alongside specialists in data, analytics, integrations, enterprise architecture, governance, and business enablement.

Together with the AI Centre of Excellence and Process Excellence, we help the business unlock value from data, technology, and AI. In this role, you will collaborate with stakeholders across our global business, helping drive AI adoption, process optimization, and operational excellence across functions and regions.
 
What you bring
You are a hands-on AI professional who combines technical expertise with strong business understanding. You enjoy turning complex challenges into practical solutions and working closely with stakeholders to create measurable business value.
 

Moreover, you:
  • Hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI, Engineering, or a related field – or bring equivalent practical experience.
  • Have experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI-enabled solutions in business environments.
  • Have hands-on experience with APIs, system integrations, Git, and modern software development practices.
  • Understand technologies and concepts such as LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, Prompt Engineering, and Vector Databases.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Take ownership from idea to implementation and enjoy turning business needs into scalable solutions.




We offer

At Stibo Systems, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  • We care about our colleague’s work-life balance, and we offer flexibility through a hybrid work model. We offer “MindFUL” and “MindFuel” days which are global days off and learning days, volunteer days and much more
  • International: A growing global company, worldwide career opportunities, multicultural teams and access to learning platforms like Udemy
  • Well-being: A caring and inspiring environment, promoting a happy and healthy lifestyle through a wide range of facilities and activities
  • We create our own Software products and have a proven record of adding significant business value for our customers.




Join Stibo Systems, where we embrace 'All Kinds of Data Minds'

Stibo Systems is a global company with Danish heritage. We empower businesses to become digital leaders through our AI-powered, SaaS-based multidomain master data management solutions. By connecting data across products, customers, suppliers and more, we drive growth, efficiency, and sustainability for our customers.
 

At Stibo Systems, our people are key to our success and you will find an environment that values creativity, curiosity, and analytical thinking. We're committed to making you feel trusted, invested in, and connected, fostering a workplace where every data mind thrives.


Interested?

We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Due to the summer holiday period, response times may be longer than usual. We will review applications on an ongoing basis and expect to continue the recruitment process during August.
 

We value diverse perspectives and skills. Even if you don’t meet every qualification listed in the ad, we encourage you to apply - what matters is your potential and unique skills.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Title: Quant Infrastructure Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, designing robust and scalable software infrastructure, and collaborating with dedicated colleagues – all while playing a key role in scaling our business even further.




Does this sound exciting? Then you might be our new Quant Infrastructure Engineer at Alipes.




At Alipes, we have been a market leader in automating financial markets since our inception in 2008, pioneering fully automated natural language processing systems to read and interpret financial news. To accomplish our goal of being the best at what we do, we are focused on building a world-class ML engineering workflow, ensuring seamless training, deployment and monitoring of our predictive models.




As a core member of the Quant team, your work will be instrumental in developing the infrastructure enabling us to transform massive unstructured financial data sets into production-ready inference models that drive real-time trading decisions. You will work with technologies such as Python, Kubernetes, Ray and Airflow. In doing so, you will get a chance to develop and maintain the infrastructure needed for scalable, high-performance ML systems, ensuring a seamless pipeline from dataset generation through model prototyping to production deployment.




Key responsibilities include

Designing, optimizing and maturing our infrastructure to support distributed model training and experiment tracking, as well as further developing internal Python tools for smooth interaction.
Building and automating robust data pipelines for dataset generation and feature engineering, while enabling data version control.
Developing software for rapid experimentation and deployment, including automated testing, continuous integration, and delivery.
Improve feature generation system- develop a feature store with definition and automated generation.
Transitioning to a more structured table based dataset store.
Implementing best practices in software development, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and efficiency of ML systems through automated testing and real-time monitoring.
Improving model deployment workflows, focusing on minimizing latency, ensuring reproducibility, and enabling fast iterations.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.




About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the Quant team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.




We are a tight-knit modeling team with passionate quantitative researchers covering 9 nationalities – a mix of PhD’s and MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and are willing to engage on a deep, technical level of understanding.




About you

A scientific and inquisitive mind.
Fluency with computer science fundamentals, specifically data structures and algorithms.
Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience with Python, in particular the data pre-processing, ETL pipelines and distributed systems.
Familiarity with strongly typed languages like C# or C/C++ or Rust.
A few years of experience in production-grade environments working with Machine Learning based applications.
Experience with distributed computing frameworks (for example Spark, Ray or Dask).
Familiarity with containerization technologies (for example Docker Compose or Kubernetes).




Nice to have

Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack and a strong MLOps foundation, going from dataset generation through model training and real-life validation and monitoring.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Familiarity with algorithmic trading concepts.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.




If you have specific questions about the role, you are welcome to email us at quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please do not send in your applications to this email address, as our interview team will not have visibility to review.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to help build scalable and high-quality data solutions? Join us as a Data Engineer and contribute to the development of data products that support business decisions across DLG.

About The Position

As a Data Engineer, y ou will contribute to the development and maintenance of our data platform and data pipelines. Working closely with experienced engineers and stakeholders, you will help deliver reliable, scalable, and well-structured data solutions that support business needs.

You will be part of an environment where collaboration, continuous learning, and quality are highly valued. While working with an established architecture and engineering framework, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical skills and grow your expertise in data engineering and cloud-based data platforms.

In this role you will

As our Data Engineer, you will work with the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines and data products on Databricks. You will contribute to building solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with industry-leading engineering standards.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Develop and maintain data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and/or SQL
Support data ingestion processes across batch and streaming workloads
Implement data quality checks and validation processes within existing frameworks
Contribute to CI/CD processes and follow established data engineering development practices
Work with data governance principles, including data classification, access control, and compliance requirements
Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions and resolve technical challenges


About you

You are a data engineer with a focus on building reliable and well-structured data pipelines. You are comfortable working within an established architecture and contributing to the delivery of high-quality data solutions as part of a collaborative engineering team.

You have a curious mindset and take pride in delivering maintainable solutions. You communicate proactively, collaborate effectively with others, and are comfortable raising questions or challenges when needed.

We Imagine That You


Are proficient in Python and SQL
Have experience working with Lakehouse or medallion architecture principles
Have experience with data ingestion patterns, including batch and/or streaming workloads
Are comfortable using Git or similar version control tools
Have a solid understanding of CI/CD principles and data development practices
Have hands-on experience with Databricks and understand data quality and governance concepts
Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken


Furthermore, It Is An Advantage If You


Have experience with Databricks Asset Bundles / Declarative Automation Bundles (DABs) or similar deployment and configuration tooling
Have worked with streaming technologies such as Auto Loader, Kafka, Event Hubs, or similar solutions
Have experience working with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


What we offer

At DLG, you will join a collaborative and ambitious organisation where data plays an increasingly important role in supporting business decisions and creating value across the business.

We offer a flexible and supportive work environment with excellent opportunities for professional development, knowledge sharing, and career growth. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a culture characterized by collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.

Practical information

The position is full-time and based in either Fredericia or Flensburg. Start date is expected to be in October/November.

Please submit your CV - applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. We expect to invite for the first round of interviews in the beginning of August.

If you have any questions that are not answered in the above, please contact Head of Data Engineering, Thomas Nielsen, at

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.


The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.
