Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you a Data Engineer with 2-7 years of experience ready to take the next step? And would you like to work directly with clients while keeping up to date with the newest technologies? Then read on & apply to become part of a dynamic young team of 60 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools.


Contract: Full-time, permanent
Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station



Work Assignments

The role requires you to be both a hands-on builder and a point of contact for our clients' data challenges. Specifically, you will:


Build robust data pipelines and models that streamline the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data.
Implement and develop modern data platforms through DevOps & CI/CD practices.
Collaborate with our clients’ engineers, analysts, & business users to solve business issues and ensure lasting value.



You will learn from our many data engineers with 7-20 years of experience, while taking on a mentoring role for our less experienced consultants.

What You Bring To The Team

Ideally, you have:


2-7 years of experience working as a data engineer.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, APIs, and/or software development.
An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.
Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.
Experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP.
A relevant degree.
A current base near Copenhagen and fluency in Danish and/or English.



If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5146

The banking industry is undergoing a period of dynamic change and Transaction Banking (TxB) – the Payments, Cards and Trade Solution area – is at the heart of the digital, instant and open revolution. We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist / Analytics Engineer with high stakeholder management skills to create actionable customer insights, identify new revenue opportunities, improve execution on strategies utilising data and further develop or analytical platform.

About Our Team

Welcome to the TxB Analytics team; the data science team that enables TxB and our customers to become more data driven. We add value by creating actionable customer insights to optimise existing business while at the same time exploring new revenue opportunities and improving efficiency. To be successful we need a tech savvy and analytical mind with great business understanding. We aim to be courageous and explorative in our approach which means you’ll have many opportunities to learn and grow as you build your career with us. Will you help us take the next step with our use of data?

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Work closely with our most important stakeholders, understand their needs, capture requirements and conduct workshops with them.
Functional leadership of the area software engineering and ML/AI to strengthen the team in the area.
Utilise data analytics to build analytics products so our stakeholders can make important strategic decisions, grow income, improve operational efficiency and develop Nordea’s product offering.
Identify business opportunities (e.g. sales leads, merchant intelligence opportunities, etc) utilising internal and external data.
Apply data science techniques such as statistical modelling, machine learning and Artificial Intelligence.
Be responsible for the development of our technical analytical platform to make it fit for purpose for Data Science.
Support and collaborate closely with other team members.


Who You Are

Your background and skills include:


You have experience working as a Data Scientist or similar where you have experiences with analytical and quantitative problem solving using advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods and AI.
You have a business consulting mindset and are proactive working with stakeholders to understand their needs and how analytics can help them.
You have good end-to-end software engineering skills.
You have deep knowledge in SQL and programming, e.g. Python.
Solid experience in Airflow, dbt and Snowflake (or similar tools).
You are familiar with Power BI (or similar business intelligence tools).
You have data/analytics engineering experience.
You are business minded, analytical and have excellent communication skills in English (both in text and spoken).
You are a social, curious and a pragmatic team player.
Experience in Requirements Management and workshop facilitation would an advantage.
Experience in Transaction Banking or Payments/Cards would be an advantage.
You have a MSc/BSc/BA degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, physics or related quantitative degree.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 07/08/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Mikael Simonsson at mikael.simonsson@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Only for candidates in Sweden: For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Only for candidates in Finland: A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position

Title: Algorithm Developer in Mathematical modelling
Place: Hørsholm, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Do you want your engineering skills to directly shape how athletes understand and improve their movement? Are you excited by the opportunity of turning noisy, high-dimensional data into clean, actionable biomechanical metrics used by professionals and ambitious amateurs alike?

We are looking for an Algorithm Developer in Mathematical modelling to join our Motion Analysis team. You’ll work at the intersection of deep learning and real-world sports science, taking the raw output of our AI models and building the modelling and post-processing pipelines that make the data real. This is where the engineering meets the athlete.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for the key step between AI prediction and product output. Our deep learning models produce body key points from video. Your job is to turn those noisy, uncertain estimates into robust skeletal fits and reliable biomechanical metrics that our users can trust and act on.

We believe it takes careful post-processing and modelling to turn raw deep learning predictions into data that is real, reliable, and actionable. You will design and develop custom algorithms that handle outlier detection, optimization, and human body model fitting, often as one integrated modelling approach rather than separate steps. You will be part of an agile, collaborative team, contributing to solutions from prototype to production and helping shape our products. You will join a team of six, with diverse backgrounds spanning deep learning, computer vision, software engineering, and mathematical modelling.

We work in a collaborative environment where team members support each other and share responsibility for moving projects forward. We believe that strong solutions emerge through open dialogue across disciplines. We also value a positive and engaging work environment, where curiosity is encouraged and people can explore problems that interest them alongside supportive colleagues.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include


Designing and implementing mathematical models that fit skeletal structures to noisy key point data, balancing input uncertainty with anatomical constraints.
Developing robust outlier detection and rejection methods that work within the modelling framework, not just as a pre-processing step.
Building and refining optimization pipelines for post-processing deep learning outputs into accurate biomechanical metrics.
Conducting data analysis and statistical validation to understand model performance and propose improvements.
Collaborating closely with our deep learning engineers and software engineers to ensure your models integrate cleanly into the broader product pipeline.
Exploring and evaluating new approaches from research literature, adapting them to our specific problem domain and data characteristics.


Job Requirements


A master's degree or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related technical field with strong mathematical foundations.
Solid skills in mathematical modelling, you are comfortable formulating real-world problems as optimization, estimation, or fitting problems.
Strong foundations in linear algebra, statistics, and numerical methods.
Experience working with noisy, real-world data,you understand uncertainty and know how to handle it.
Programming skills in Python - Familiarity with C++ is a plus.
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and are driven by making your work matter in a real product, not just in a report.
Communication skills, with the ability to explain mathematical choices to colleagues from different technical backgrounds.


Preferably


Experience with signal processing methods such as filtering, smoothing, or time-series analysis.
Familiarity with constrained optimization techniques and solvers.
Experience with human body modelling, biomechanics, or motion capture data.
Exposure to deep learning, not necessarily training models, but understanding what they output and why they fail.
A genuine passion for applying mathematical thinking to solve real-world challenges.
An interest in sports like golf, baseball, or others is a bonus!


The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Title: Data Analytics Specialist
Description:
Job Description:

What the job is:

At Satair , data and analytics are among our most powerful levers for driving a culture of continuous improvement across the entire organization. They play a vital role in enhancing operational efficiency, boosting competitiveness, engaging employees, and most importantly, delivering outstanding customer satisfaction.

As a Data Analytics Specialist , you will join our dynamic Data & Infrastructure team , where we are dedicated to empowering the business with self-service tools, robust data foundations, and scalable cloud infrastructure solutions. Our mission also includes upskilling teams across the organization to build long-term capabilities and promote a data-driven mindset.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with functional teams across all areas of the Satair organization. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, partnering with business analysts and domain experts to provide technological insights, define data standards, conduct diagnostics, and apply advanced analytics to optimize processes and maximize value for our customers, as well as making sure the underlying infrastructure and pipelines are running smoothly and as effective as possible.

Our team is truly global, reflecting Satair’s international footprint with colleagues and offices all across the globe. This means you will work in small, agile, cross-functional teams, focused on delivering practical, high-impact solutions side-by-side with the business.

Task and responsibilities:


Improve and maintain our key pipelines running on the Airbus Skywise platform - a customized version of Palantir Foundry. Main tasks will be focusing on optimisation, automation and improving the backend pipelines and flows.
Support the business with in-depth data analysis and experimentation to uncover valuable business insights and support data-driven decision-making.
Engage with functional teams to understand end-to-end processes, identify pain points, and uncover opportunities for improvement through data and emerging technologies.
Translate analysis into actionable outcomes by developing automated tools, visual dashboards, reports, or workflows that enhance productivity and business value.
Design and deliver Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) to quickly test, validate, and address critical business challenges.
Act as a coach and advisor to cross-functional teams, guiding them on data quality improvement plans, and supporting them in developing their own MVPs and analytics use cases.


How will you contribute to the team:

We are looking for a dynamic, business-savvy individual who is passionate about data and technology, with a strong drive to deliver impactful results through collaboration and innovation.


You are a quick learner, passionate about your work and driven to get things done with a collaborative way of working.
You bring a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset-comfortable with rapid experimentation and iteration when building digital products and tools.
You understand the intersection of data and business processes and are passionate about solving real-world industrial and operational challenges.
Robust coding abilities (Python, SQL, Java) & experience in working with APIs, algorithms, data structures would be a plus.
Experience with DevOps tools / modern cloud stack & practices would be a plus.
Experience working with Data Mesh principles such as decentralized data ownership, domain-aligned data products, and self-serve data infrastructure would be a strong plus.
Prior experience with Patantir Foundry would be a big plu
A university degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
3-5 years of experience in an analytics, data science, or similar role within a complex business environment.
Strong knowledge of English, both orally and in writing


What does your next challenge look like?

At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

At Satair , data and analytics are among our most powerful levers for driving a culture of continuous improvement across the entire organization. They play a vital role in enhancing operational efficiency, boosting competitiveness, engaging employees, and most importantly, delivering outstanding customer satisfaction.

As a Data Analytics Specialist , you will join our dynamic Data & Infrastructure team , where we are dedicated to empowering the business with self-service tools, robust data foundations, and scalable cloud infrastructure solutions. Our mission also includes upskilling teams across the organization to build long-term capabilities and promote a data-driven mindset.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with functional teams across all areas of the Satair organization. Our team is truly global, reflecting Satair’s international footprint with colleagues and offices all across the globe. This means you will work in small, agile, cross-functional teams, focused on delivering practical, high-impact solutions side-by-side with the business.

Title: AI Engineer Consultant
Description:
Introduction

Vil du hjælpe nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder med at realisere deres AI-potentiale? Vi søger en nysgerrig og ambitiøs AI Engineer til vores konsulentteam, som brænder for at omsætte data og AI til konkrete forretningsresultater. Rollen spænder bredt - fra klassisk data science og machine learning til de nyeste muligheder inden for Generativ AI og AI-agenter.

IBM Client Innovation Center er en del af IBM Consulting og leverer rådgivning, udvikling og implementering af innovative teknologiløsninger til både danske og internationale virksomheder. Vi kombinerer dyb teknisk ekspertise med stærk forretningsforståelse og hjælper vores kunder med at accelerere digital transformation, innovation og værdiskabelse.

Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med de nyeste AI-teknologier og være med til at udvikle løsninger, der skaber reel værdi for nogle af Danmarks mest spændende organisationer.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Som AI Engineer hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor vi hjælper kunderne med at løfte deres tekniske fundament og skabe målbar værdi gennem AI. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kunderne om at designe, udvikle og implementere løsninger, der spænder fra dataplatforme og Databricks-pipelines til machine learning-modeller, AI-løsninger og LLM-baserede AI-agenter.

Hos os får du det bedste fra begge verdener. Mange af vores projekter løber over flere år og giver mulighed for at skabe langsigtet værdi for kunden, mens andre er kortere og mere intensive. Det betyder, at du løbende bliver eksponeret for nye brancher, teknologier og forretningsudfordringer - og udvikler dig hurtigt både fagligt og personligt.

Dine Opgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være At


Arbejde med de nyeste teknologier inden for AI, Generativ AI og Agentic AI.
Designe, udvikle og operationalisere machine learning- og AI-løsninger i produktionsmiljøer.
Udvikle intelligente applikationer ved hjælp af LLM’er, RAG, AI-agenter og Copilot-teknologier.
Bygge robuste data- og AI-pipelines på moderne cloud-platforme som Azure og Databricks.
Samarbejde tæt med kunder om at omsætte forretningsmæssige udfordringer til skalerbare tekniske løsninger.
Bidrage til arkitektur, teknologivalg og best practices inden for moderne AI-udvikling.
Holde dig opdateret på nye teknologier og aktivt bidrage til at styrke vores AI-kompetencer og innovationsarbejde.


Required Technical And Professional Expertise

For at få succes i rollen forestiller vi os at du:


Har erfaring inden for data engineering, data science eller AI – typisk 3-4 års erfaring eller er en stærk profil med potentiale til hurtigt at udvikle sig mod seniorniveau.
Har solid forståelse for machine learning, deep learning, AI (herunder Generativ og Agentic AI) samt stærke kompetencer i Python og SQL.
Har kendskab til Databricks og moderne data- og AI-arkitekturer.
Har praktisk erfaring med Azure Data & AI-platformen og trives med at bygge robuste løsninger i pro-code miljøer fremfor low-code/no-code.
Er nysgerrig, læringsorienteret og motiveres af tæt samarbejde med både kunder og kolleger.
Kommunikerer klart og professionelt på både dansk og engelsk.


Vi tilbyder

Hos IBM får du mulighed for at arbejde i frontlinjen af teknologi og innovation. Du bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor læring, videndeling og personlig udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Samtidig får du adgang til et stærkt netværk og mulighed for at lære af nogle af branchens mest erfarne specialister og ledere.

Desuden Tilbyder Vi


Et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor ekspertise går hånd i hånd med et inkluderende og socialt fællesskab.
Adgang til et af branchens stærkeste læringsmiljøer med træning, certificeringer og kontinuerlig kompetenceudvikling gennem IBMs globale læringsplatform for mere end 250.000 IBM-medarbejdere, så du hele tiden kan udvikle dig i takt med nye teknologier, markeder og kundebehov.
Spændende projekter, der giver variation, ansvar og mulighed for at skabe reel værdi fra dag ét.
Dygtige kolleger og en ledelse, der prioriterer både faglig udvikling, trivsel og arbejdsglæde.
Fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar i et dynamisk og tillidsbaseret arbejdsmiljø.
En arbejdsplads med base på Aarhus Ø samt mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med kunder på tværs af brancher og lokationer.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Data & AI Practice Lead, Anders Schaumann på anders.schauman@ibm.com.

Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Denmark - BCG X
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

As a Data Scientist and Senior Data Scientist, you'll be part of our rapidly growing team. You'll have the chance to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across a variety of industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, scrappy, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Talented Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Transforming Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills


What You'll Bring

Technologies

Programming Languages: Python

Title: Specialist, Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Specialist | Full-Time

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > AI/ML Chapter

Do you enjoy creating and scaling AI/ML solutions that deliver meaningful business results? Do you have experience in designing, developing and deploying AI/ML solutions and want to advance your career? Do you enjoy working at the intersection of product, engineering and business to turn advanced AI capabilities into production-ready solutions? Then you might be our new AI/ML Engineer. We are hiring across multiple seniority levels, and the role will be aligned to your experience, technical skills, and demonstrated impact.

At the core of Digital Development Platform organization, AI/ML Chapter serves as the capability home for AI/ML specialization, supporting engineering excellence, skills development, and scalable delivery across Vestas. You will be part of a global team spanning Denmark and India, partnering closely with product owners, AI/ML engineers and business stakeholders to design, build, and scale AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic solutions across Vestas value chain.

As part of the broader Autonomous Flows area, the team contributes to building next-generation intelligent systems and agentic workflows that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new business value. We collaborate closely with platform, product and governance teams to ensure scalable, responsible, and impactful adoption of AI across Vestas. With disciplined engineering practices, data-focused methods, and close collaboration with business partners, the team continually raises AI/ML delivery standards and enables meaningful solutions that improve visibility, optimization, and innovation across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will collaborate with product owners, ML engineers, application developers and business SMEs to build and scale advanced ML/GenAI and agent-based systems embedded in digital products. This role emphasizes reasoning-driven AI, self-directed execution and significant informal leadership to deliver results across the organization.


Contribute to validating and conducting technical feasibility assessments of high-impact ML/GenAI use cases
Build, productize and scale ML/GenAI and agentic systems capable of reasoning, planning and carrying out complex tasks
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications, enabling seamless, human-in-the-loop and self-directed decision-making
Work with cross-functional product teams in delivering AI/ML initiatives while advising stakeholders on responsible AI adoption balancing experimentation with production considerations such as performance, cost, reliability and governance
Establish and promote reusable patterns and engineering standards for scalable delivery, AI-ready data, and trusted AI automation


Qualifications

You have a solid foundation in machine learning and software engineering, combined with clear communication and stakeholder engagement skills. You bring extensive experience in designing and scaling production-grade AI/ML systems, with experience leading solutions across the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous improvement. 


A master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, data science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
You have demonstrated depth in one of the fields such as NLP, generative AI, agentic systems, computer vision, ML engineering or large-scale AI systems
5+ years of experience in ML engineering, including design, delivery and scaling of production-grade AI/ML solutions; the role can be aligned to different seniority levels based on skill level and demonstrated impact
Deep knowledge of Python, ability to develop production grade code, solid experience with ML frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, Tensorflow, Pytorch) and GenAI/Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI)
Deep experience with AI experimentation and modeling, as well as designing robust, scalable training and inference pipelines on cloud platforms including Azure and Snowflake, deployed through CI/CD within an IaC environment
Solid experience with RESTful API design, Docker-based containerization, and Kubernetes-based deployment, scaling, and operations


Competencies


Productionize ML, LLM/GenAI models and agentic systems into reliable, high-performance services with optimized latency, throughput and cost efficiency
Design and operate scalable batch and real-time ML pipelines with high reproducibility across training and deployment
Establish robust monitoring and observability for model performance, data quality, system health and data drift detection
Manage the full ML lifecycle with clear versioning, governance, automated retraining and resilient deployment strategies
Effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate prototyping, improve engineering quality and enhance developer productivity in building AI/ML and GenAI solutions


 Global Collaboration & Enablement


Effective collaboration across geographically distributed teams (Denmark, India, Portugal), with high cross-cultural awareness and communication
Ability to align product, AI/ML engineering, platform and MLOps teams to deliver shared engineering outcomes
Demonstrated experience in mentoring and enabling teams through knowledge sharing, best practices and informal leadership


What We Offer

Purpose. An opportunity to help address climate change and support future generations through building AI/ML, GenAI and agentic solutions that power the future of renewable energy and sustainable operations.

Accelerated learning and growth. Join a high-caliber global team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and GenAI practitioners, with clear focus on continuous learning, knowledge sharing and expanding into agentic autonomous flows.

Global collaboration & collaborative team culture. Work within a multicultural Denmark-India setup that values trust, collaboration and mutual support to deliver meaningful impact.

Opportunity to shape your role. Play a key role in scaling agentic autonomous flows and high-value AI/ML solutions, with the freedom to shape direction, approaches, and outcomes.

Supportive and inclusive environment. Thrive in a diverse, inclusive workplace that promotes well-being, work-life balance and enables individuals to bring their full potential to work.

Career growth in a global organization. Join a global organization that supports ongoing skill development and career advancement

Overall, we offer you the opportunity to contribute meaningfully while growing your career in a global, multicultural environment that promotes continuous learning and development.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Data Science Manager
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, cutting waste and making deliveries smoother for everyone involved.

Are you passionate about solving complex challenges with real-world impact using state-of-the-art models and algorithms? We are seeking a Data Science Manager to join our team. In this high-impact role you will lead a team of data scientists and engineers to architect, deploy and operationalize advanced algorithms and machine learning models that drive our state-of-the-art route planning capability. You will guide your team to deliver accurate, scalable and efficient solutions for thousands of drivers every day. As our Data Science Manager, you will shape how the function grows, and have a truly outsized impact on our product and the value we bring to our customers.

What You'll Be Doing


Lead and manage a team of Data Scientists and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, scientific rigor, and operational excellence
Define the data science roadmap, and help decide where the team can create the most value for the product and our customers
Dive deep into the work as a player-coach to guide hard technical calls and unblock the team
Drive architecture decisions including model selection, feature engineering from product catalogs, and evaluation metric frameworks
Translate ambiguous customer problems into well-scoped data science and ML workstreams
Establish and monitor classification metrics, model performance KPIs, and production health dashboards to ensure continuous improvement
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical customers, stakeholders and leadership
Mentor and develop team members through career coaching, technical guidance, and structured growth plans
Drive operational rigor ensuring zero-disruption deployments, data quality standards, and robust experimentation practices


ABOUT YOU


A Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field
8+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, with 3+ years in a people management role
Proven track record of leading, mentoring and managing other data scientists and/or engineers
Knowledge of Computer Science and Machine Learning fundamentals, including training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques. You have a large tool-box
Practical skill and experience applying your knowledge to messy, real-world problems
Comfort switching between hands-on technical work and people leadership
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Genuine curiosity about customers and product
Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL, and preferably familiarity with airflow, docker, duckdb, dbt, spark, mlflow.


What Does Success Look Like?


After 6 months at Mover Systems you have launched a new data product.


Our Culture

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality. Technical colleagues are not kept at arm's length from customers - you will talk to them directly, and use what you learn to decide what to build next.

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

Mover is a Danish transport and tech-company providing a unique combination of flexible logistics solutions and state-of-the-art technology that can increase efficiency, improve customer experiences and reduce the environmental footprint of transportation. This is how we meet the increasing demands for fast, low-cost and extraordinary transport experiences. For the benefit of businesses, consumers and the environment.

We are experiencing a movement towards companies and customers expecting transparency and control of how their goods are transported and delivered. It has to be easy, low-cost and in consideration of the environment. Mover’s business model supports this by combining flexible logistics solutions with the newest technology.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
On Behalf of Hobbii we are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer




About Hobbii




Hobbii is Denmark's fastest-growing e-commerce company within yarn and handicrafts. From our base in Copenhagen, we've built a global brand serving passionate makers in more than 12 markets, with an ambition to become the world's leading online yarn universe. Driven by scalable technology, creative energy, and data-driven commerce, we're turning our passion for craftsmanship into a global success story.

This is a rare chance to join a small, dedicated data team at Hobbii and turn raw, complex data into trusted, business-ready answers the whole company relies on.




About the role

You’ll work with stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Tech, serving the business with their data needs and helping users make the most of our customer-centric data. You’ll have full ownership of your data products end to end, as well as talking to and educating the business.




Key responsibilities




• Work closely with Finance, Product and Commercial to understand what they need, and translate it into clear, trustworthy answers

• Own shared KPI definitions such as AOV, CLV, and Margin in our Cube semantic layer, so the business measures things consistently

• Contribute to maintaining and building SQL models and dashboards, and help key stakeholders understand the implementation

• Build useful Metabase dashboards and utilise coding and AI tools to help answer business questions effectively

• Contribute to the Data Dictionary so non-technical users understand what they are measuring and can explore data with confidence




Your profile

You’ve probably been the data person somewhere small before, so you’re used to owning things end to end and figuring them out yourself. You’re as curious about the business as the tech, you’d rather answer a real question than build something clever no one asked for, and you’re comfortable talking to stakeholders.




We imagine you bring:

• Genuine business curiosity and the instinct to translate stakeholder questions into practical solutions, this matters as much as the tech

• Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Redshift

• Interest in semantic modelling, KPI logic, or reusable business definitions. Cube, dbt, or LookML experience is a plus

• Curiosity about using AI and MCP for SQL support, documentation, or data exploration

• English fluency, written and spoken, our company language

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical background




Why join Hobbii?

At Hobbii you’ll join a tight-knit team building something global from Copenhagen, and as one of the first data hires, you’ll have unusual ownership and room to shape how we work. You’ll see the impact of your work across the business every week, with real room to grow as the data function grows. We move fast, support each other, and have a lot of fun along the way.




We offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and skills
Flexible work setup – hybrid (HQ in Nordvest, Copenhagen)
6 weeks of paid vacation
Health insurance and paid parental leave
Catered lunch, great coffee, and lively Friday bars
Legendary company events and a welcoming, informal culture
A great staff discount on yarn




Interested?

FACTOR 7 is managing the recruitment process. For more information, please contact Recruitment Manager Omar Kamel at omar@factor7.dk or on +45 30 22 09 02.

Title: AI Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Om rollen

DRIVR søger en AI-ingeniør, der vil være med til at forme fremtidens mobilitetsløsninger. Rollen er to-delt: 1) du implementerer applikationer som en del af vores tech-team, og 2) du er med til at opbygge AI-kapabiliteter på tværs af DRIVRs organisation.




Du bygger AI-systemer, der forvandler DRIVRs data til daglig værdi DRIVRs datawarehouse, i mobilapps, i backend og i de GenAI-værktøjer, som andre teams bygger videre på. Det er en praktisk ingeniørrolle med reelt ejerskab: du får ansvar for features fra ende til anden, fra prototype til produktion, og ser dem taget i brug på tværs af forretningen inden for få uger.




Du arbejder tæt sammen med data, produkt og drift og er med til at sætte rammerne for, hvordan AI bygges hos DRIVR, i takt med at funktionen vokser.




Dine opgaver

Du designer og udvikler LLM-drevne applikationer oven på vores eksisterende tech-stack.
Du bygger og vedligeholder den fælles GenAI-platform, herunder DRIVRs datawarehouse, agent framework, guardrails, skills og dataforbindelser, der gør det muligt for andre teams at bygge AI-features hurtigt og sikkert.
Du automatiserer operationelle arbejdsgange ved hjælp af retrieval, agenter og integrationer med de systemer, vi allerede kører.




Hvem vi søger

Vi hører gerne fra dig, hvis du har erfaring med software- eller ML-udvikling og er tryg ved at eje en feature fra idé til produktion. Mere konkret:

Solide softwareudviklingsprincipper: SDLC, MCP-/API-drevet arkitektur, test, versionsstyring og code review.
Erfaring med at bygge applikationer med LLM'er, herunder RAG, function calling, agenter og evaluering.
Praktisk erfaring med at bygge og idriftsætte applikationer.
Tryg ved at arbejde med data i stor skala: SQL og gerne Databricks, Spark eller en tilsvarende warehouse/lakehouse-stack.
En pragmatisk og produktorienteret tilgang. Vi går op i resultatet for brugeren, og ikke teknologi for teknologiens skyld.




Det er et plus

Erfaring med agentic coding-workflows, Databricks, mobiludvikling, Python og JavaScript.




Det tilbyder vi

En rolle med stort ejerskab i en virksomhed, hvor AI er en prioritet, og ikke et sideprojekt, samt hvor dit arbejde hurtigt når ud til rigtige brugere.
En moderne data-stack og et samarbejdende on-site team i København.
Reel mulighed for at forme, hvordan AI bygges hos DRIVR, i takt med at teamet vokser.




Praktisk tilbyder vi

• Gode og sociale rammer på vores kontor i København.

• En spændende og varient hverdag med frihed under ansvar.

• En nøglerolle i en virksomhed i rivende udvikling

• En god frokostordning

• Pension efter 9 måneders ansættelse.




Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par ord om noget, du har bygget med AI, til andreas@drivr.com. Vi vurderer ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.




Om DRIVR

DRIVR er Danmarks største taxaselskab, der kører 100 % på el. Vi er landsdækkende og brænder for at gøre hverdagen lettere og grønnere for alle danskere. Vi mener, det skal være trygt og enkelt at komme fra A til B, uanset hvor man skal hen. Vi tager aktivt ansvar for miljøet og vores fælles fremtid og arbejder hver dag på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores passagerer og gøre den moderne, bæredygtige taxatur tilgængelig for alle.

Title: Data Analytics Lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Please note: This is a full-time office-based role (5 days/week).




About the Role

As a Platform Data Analyst, you will own analytical workstreams end-to-end — from scoping and data modelling through to communicating findings and driving stakeholder action. You will work with large, complex datasets spanning customer orders, supplier transactions, asset utilisation, and operational data, contributing to KPI frameworks, experiment design, and AI/ML use case development — using AI tools where they genuinely accelerate work, not as a default. This is an individual contributor role: your impact comes from analytical craft, clarity of thinking, and your ability to influence decisions through insight rather than through line management or product ownership. You will sit close to platform product and engineering teams, but your remit is analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Insight

Identify and quantify opportunities in platform data; translate findings into clear recommendations for product and business teams.
Design and maintain decision-oriented KPI frameworks accessible to front-line teams and senior management alike.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on product adoption, user behaviour, performance trends, and business impact — and design experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, significance testing) to test hypotheses that emerge.
Support benefit estimation and validation for platform product initiatives.

Data Craft & Self-Sufficiency

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, transform, and model data from multiple source systems.
Build reusable analytical datasets that support recurring analysis and reporting — working independently or alongside data engineering colleagues as needed.
Work within our Azure/Databricks cloud infrastructure, treating analytical datasets as data products: clear ownership, documented SLAs, versioning, and a feedback loop with end users.
Proactively identify data quality issues and work with upstream teams to resolve them.

Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery

Partner with product owners, Business users, and engineering teams to translate analytical needs into well-defined workstreams and communicate findings through data storytelling that connects insight to business priorities and drives action.
Own your analytical backlog — prioritise, set realistic expectations, and manage delivery independently.
Flag potential bias, fairness issues, or unintended consequences in analytical outputs and model inputs before they reach decisions.

AI/ML & GenAI

Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks that enable AI/ML model development.
Use tools like Copilot (code completion) and Claude or ChatGPT (summarisation, documentation, data exploration) to accelerate analytical tasks — anchored to specific, validated workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure analytical outputs meet model input requirements (schema, distribution, data quality).

Skills & Experience

Education

Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3–6 years in business analytics or data analysis, ideally in a complex, large-scale data environment.
Proven track record delivering end-to-end analytical projects — from scoping through to stakeholder action.
Experience working in or alongside product or platform teams.
Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, LLM-based analysis, prompt engineering) as part of analytical or engineering workflows is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL proficiency for extraction, transformation, and modelling across large datasets.
Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation (pandas, numpy, and similar libraries).
Azure and Databricks experience; familiarity with data pipeline development, data modelling concepts, and data quality best practices.
Power BI or equivalent, with the ability to build clear, decision-oriented dashboards.
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and how analytical pipelines feed into model development; practical use of AI coding tools (Copilot) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for analytical tasks — with the judgement to validate outputs and know their limits.

Behaviours & Mindset

Proactive and self-directed — you identify problems before being asked and take ownership.
Structured problem-solver — you break ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical tasks and communicate findings to diverse audiences without losing rigour.
Collaborative and stakeholder-savvy — you understand that great analytics only creates value when trusted and acted upon, and balance high standards with pragmatism about what fits the decision at hand.
AI-critical — you use GenAI tools effectively but validate outputs, flag governance concerns, and apply your own judgement before acting on recommendations.

Description:
Job Description

As a Manager for Data Science consulting, you operate at the intersection of business strategy, data, and emerging AI technologies. You work closely with clients to shape their data and AI agendas—translating business challenges into actionable opportunities, advising on the right approaches, and guiding initiatives from idea through to value realization.

You bring a strong technical foundation, but your primary focus is on understanding client needs, framing problems, and designing impactful solutions. You are a trusted advisor who can connect strategy, data, technology, and organizational change—while staying hands-on enough to explore data, prototype solutions, and leverage modern AI tools.

Qualifications


Strong experience in data, AI, or analytics roles, with exposure to both technical implementation and business-facing work
Proven ability to engage clients, structure problems, and translate business needs into data/AI solutions
Proven experience in developing and deploying AI models at scale, including natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and reinforcement learning.
Expertise in machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn, as well as experience with cloud-based AI platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Strong understanding of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines and big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, SQL, and NoSQL.
Experience working with modern AI ecosystems (e.g., cloud platforms, LLMs, AI tools, or data platforms)
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, exploring new problem spaces, and expanding into adjacent domains
Demonstrated curiosity and eagerness to learn and apply new technologies, especially within the rapidly evolving AI landscape
Experience in consulting, digital transformation, or cross-functional environments is a strong plus


Additional Information

Set Yourself Apart With


Experience defining AI or data strategies for organizations
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools (e.g., generative AI, copilots, automation platforms)
Exposure to data architecture, data engineering, or product development
Track record of driving AI adoption or innovation initiatives within organizations
Advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., data science, engineering, business, or similar)


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:


Equally comfortable in the boardroom and with a dataset
A translator between business ambition and technical reality
Curious, adaptable, and excited about the fast-moving AI landscape
Motivated to go beyond pure data science into broader problem-solving and innovation

Title: Advanced Pricing Analyst
Place: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join AutoProff – Help Build Trust in the Price Models Powering Our European Growth! 🚗

We’re looking for an Advanced Pricing Analyst to join our team, based out of our Vejle headquarters.

At AutoProff, pricing is at the heart of how we serve customers and drive commercial performance. As our pricing capabilities continue to evolve, we need stronger ownership of how our price models perform in production. This role will be central to creating transparency around pricing quality, spotting issues before they become escalations, and ensuring we understand why our models behave the way they do.

As Advanced Pricing Analyst, you will own the reporting, monitoring, and investigation of price model performance across our production setup. You will help define the right benchmarks and reporting views to evaluate performance over time, identify weakspots or unusual behaviour, and support both existing and new model evaluations. You will also take the lead on investigating specific pricing cases raised by Pricing teams, using data and system-level understanding to determine whether issues stem from data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or whether the model output is in fact well supported by market observations.

This role sits at the intersection of pricing, analytics, and technical investigation. You will work closely with Pricing, Data Science, and other stakeholders to ensure that pricing behaviour is monitored, understood, and communicated clearly across the organisation. You will also contribute to building and strengthening the pricing setup that supports AutoProff’s continued growth across Europe.

Let’s dive into your key responsibilities, you will


Own the reporting and monitoring framework for price model performance in production, including defining the KPIs, benchmarks, and views needed to create a clear overview of model quality and behaviour.
Analyse model performance across segments, markets, and versions to identify weakspots, anomalies, drift, and other signals of deteriorating quality before they become business issues.
Lead investigations into unusual price outcomes and determine whether the underlying cause relates to data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or stakeholder interpretation.
Build a strong understanding of how price models are productionised and consumed through APIs, and validate that models are being supplied with the correct data, format, and values.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to Pricing, Data Science, and management, while supporting the quality assurance and benchmarking of existing and new price models.


The need-to-have skills


Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large datasets to build reporting, monitor performance, and investigate pricing behaviour.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and visualisation skills, with the ability to structure investigations and turn complex findings into clear and actionable insights.
Hands-on Python experience for data investigation, exploratory analysis, and technical debugging.
A good understanding of how machine learning models work in practice, including how input quality, feature behaviour, formatting issues, or drift can affect outputs.
Comfort working with APIs, payloads, and technical system flows, combined with strong communication skills and confidence in challenging assumptions with data and evidence.


The nice-to-have skills


Experience working with pricing models, recommendation models, or other predictive models in production.
Experience investigating model-serving issues, feature quality issues, or data pipeline issues affecting live model outputs.
Familiarity with model monitoring concepts such as drift detection, segmentation analysis, and performance benchmarking over time.
Ability to reproduce or inspect price requests locally through technical tools, services, or APIs.
Experience working closely with Data Science teams and translating between analytical, technical, and business perspectives.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 with the aim to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Title: Scientific Software Developer — Data Reduction Team
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Scientific Software Developer — Data Reduction Team




The European Spallation Source (ESS) is building the world’s most powerful neutron source, enabling research in materials science, energy, health, and the environment. ESS is expanding the Data Reduction Team at the Data Management and Scientific Computing Centre (DMSC), located just north of Copenhagen in Denmark. We are seeking outstanding candidates for one scientific software developer position.




About the team




We are six developers responsible for the software that turns raw detector data into scientifically usable datasets. This process, known as data reduction, produces structured datasets for downstream analysis software. We develop Scipp (scipp.github.io) and related libraries, working primarily in Python. With ten new ESS instruments coming online next year, our software will play an important role in supporting their scientific commissioning and operations. As a small team, we work on problems that are both technically challenging and central to the success of the facility.




About the role




The work spans library development, scientific workflow design, performance engineering, and user interfaces. You will work closely with neutron scientists, distil requirements from them, determine what belongs in the core library versus a downstream package, and frequently decide what not to build. There is room to specialize over time, but in your first year you should expect to touch various parts of the codebase.




Our team uses AI coding tools heavily but tries to be smart about it. To us, using AI is about amplifying human thought, not outsourcing it. We see these tools as aids for exploration, iteration, and productivity — not replacements for engineering judgement.




About you




We care more about how you think than which tools you have used. We do not have a fixed technology checklist. What matters:




You have shipped software that real users depend on.
You think critically about code quality and welcome constructive discussion and alternative ideas
You can engage with scientific problems on their own terms — a physics background is welcome but not required.
You can take ownership of an area, work with scientists to gather requirements, and make decisions with incomplete information.
You are comfortable working in English in an international team.




Experience with the scientific Python ecosystem, performance engineering, or work at neutron/photon sources is beneficial but not required. Familiarity with technologies and practices such as Jupyter, C++, CI/CD, integration testing, or systems architecture would also be valuable.




What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.




You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.




Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.




This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.




Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living-working-scandinavia.

For further information




For information about the position, contact the Group Leader for Research Software Engineering (RSE), Fredrik Bolmsten, at fredrik.bolmsten@ess.eu




For recruitment-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.




How to apply

Please submit your application, with cover letter and CV, no later than 26 August 2026.

As part of your cover letter, please pick one of these two questions and answer it in your application:




Tell us about a technical decision you made that you would make differently today, and what changed your mind.
Tell us about a piece of software you admire, not because of what it does, but because of how it is built, and what you learned from looking at it closely.




We’re genuinely interested in your response; it helps us understand your technical judgement and curiosity.




We look forward to receiving your application.

At Alipes, we have been a market leader in automating financial markets since our inception in 2008, pioneering fully automated natural language processing systems to read and interpret financial news. To accomplish our goal of being the best at what we do, we are focused on building a world-class ML engineering workflow, ensuring seamless training, deployment and monitoring of our predictive models.




As a core member of the Quant team, your work will be instrumental in developing the infrastructure enabling us to transform massive unstructured financial data sets into production-ready inference models that drive real-time trading decisions. You will work with technologies such as Python, Kubernetes, Ray and Airflow. In doing so, you will get a chance to develop and maintain the infrastructure needed for scalable, high-performance ML systems, ensuring a seamless pipeline from dataset generation through model prototyping to production deployment.




Key responsibilities include

Designing, optimizing and maturing our infrastructure to support distributed model training and experiment tracking, as well as further developing internal Python tools for smooth interaction.
Building and automating robust data pipelines for dataset generation and feature engineering, while enabling data version control.
Developing software for rapid experimentation and deployment, including automated testing, continuous integration, and delivery.
Improve feature generation system- develop a feature store with definition and automated generation.
Transitioning to a more structured table based dataset store.
Implementing best practices in software development, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and efficiency of ML systems through automated testing and real-time monitoring.
Improving model deployment workflows, focusing on minimizing latency, ensuring reproducibility, and enabling fast iterations.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.




About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the Quant team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.




We are a tight-knit modeling team with passionate quantitative researchers covering 9 nationalities – a mix of PhD’s and MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and are willing to engage on a deep, technical level of understanding.




About you

A scientific and inquisitive mind.
Fluency with computer science fundamentals, specifically data structures and algorithms.
Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience with Python, in particular the data pre-processing, ETL pipelines and distributed systems.
Familiarity with strongly typed languages like C# or C/C++ or Rust.
A few years of experience in production-grade environments working with Machine Learning based applications.
Experience with distributed computing frameworks (for example Spark, Ray or Dask).
Familiarity with containerization technologies (for example Docker Compose or Kubernetes).




Nice to have

Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack and a strong MLOps foundation, going from dataset generation through model training and real-life validation and monitoring.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Familiarity with algorithmic trading concepts.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.




If you have specific questions about the role, you are welcome to email us at quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please do not send in your applications to this email address, as our interview team will not have visibility to review.

Title: Uopfordret ansøgning til Software Engineering, Tech. Management & Data Intelligence
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Sopra Steria er en IT-konsulentforretning med fokus på softwareudvikling, projektledelse og data/analyse. Vi hjælper i dag særligt finansielle institutioner og den offentlige sektor med at nå deres ambitioner. Vi kombinerer moderne teknologi og en solid forretningsforståelse for at sikre, at vi finder løsninger, som både er attraktive, værdiskabende og er teknisk mulige at gennemføre samt implementere. Vi er med fra start til slut.

Siden 2015 har vi været i top-10 som ”Danmarks bedste it-virksomhed” i ”Great Place To Works” årlige undersøgelse, og vi er i høj grad drevet af at skabe et godt, socialt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på resultater og det gode arbejdsliv i balance. Det er fundamentalt for os, at vores medarbejdere har det godt, og syntes at det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, det er sådan vi skaber de bedste resultater.

Lyder det interessant så bliv en del af vores talent pipeline (søg uopfordret), da vi igennem året løbende søger konsulenter indenfor vores tre kompetenceområder...

Technology management


Projektleder, produktleder, business analyst, enterprise arkitekt og forretningskonsulent.


Data Intelligence


Data engineer, data analyst, automation specialist, RPA specialist, AI/ML Engineer og data scientist.


Software udvikling


.Net og Java udviklere


Vi tilbyder:


Lækre kontorlokaler i hjertet af København.
Søde og dedikerede kollegaer, som glæder sig til at arbejde sammen med dig.
En uformel og sjov hverdag på en spændende arbejdsplads med en hyggelig omgangstone
Gode muligheder med fokus på både personlig og faglig udvikling.
Regelmæssige sociale arrangementer som fredagsbar, onsdagstræning, sommerfest etc.
Fleksibel arbejdsplads med mulighed for både at arbejde fra vores kontor, hos kunden eller hjemmefra.


Bliv en del af en arbejdsplads hvor der er god mulighed personlig og faglig udvikling. Vi vækster hele tiden, hvilket giver gode muligheder for at få mere ansvar i takt med at virksomheden vokser.

Interesseret i at blive en del af Sopra Steria?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV, så vi kontakter dig, hvis vi ser, at vi har muligheder, der passer til dig. Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

OBS! Ansøgninger besvares kun i så fald vi åbner en matchende rolle til din profil. Undersøg derfor gerne nuværende åbninger før du søger.

Yderligere oplysninger

Vi er en af nordens førende konsulentvirksomheder inden for digitalisering, innovation og moderne teknologi og gennem mange år har vi været rangeret som en af Danmarks bedste IT-arbejdspladser.

Som en af nordens største konsulentvirksomheder bistår vi store private virksomheder og offentlige organisationer med deres digitale omstilling.

Vi lægger vægt på at skabe værdi for vores kunder og samfundet og har som mål at skabe en bedre og mere bæredygtig fremtid.
